Require Import AmberBase.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Program.Equality.

Definition env_mode := list ( Mode).

Definition eqMode (a b: Mode)  : bool :=
  match a,b with
  | Pos, Pos => true
  | Neg, Neg => true
  | _,_ => false
  end.

Fixpoint amber_cov (Ea : env_amber) (Em : env_mode) (T:typ) (m:Mode) : typ :=
  match Ea, Em with
  | (X,Y)::E, m'::Em' => if (eqMode m' m) then amber_cov E Em' (subst_tt X Y T) m
                         else amber_cov E Em' T m
  | _,_ => T
  end.

Theorem amber_complete: forall  A B,
    sub nil A B ->
    sub_amber nil (amber_cov nil nil A Neg) (amber_cov nil nil B Pos) .

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Program.Equality.

Require Export Rules.

Require Export infra.

Require Export DoubleUnfolding.

Definition env_amber := list (atom * atom).

Fixpoint domA (E : env_amber) : atoms :=
  match E with
  | nil => {}
  | (X,Y)::E' => {{X}} \u {{Y}} \u domA E'
  end.

Inductive wfe_amber: env_amber -> Prop :=
| wfea_base:
    wfe_amber nil
| wfea_cons: forall X Y E,
    X \notin domA E ->
    Y \notin {{X}} \u domA E ->
    wfe_amber E ->
    wfe_amber ((X,Y)::E).

Inductive wf_amber: env_amber -> typ -> Prop :=
| wfa_nat: forall E,
    wfe_amber E ->
    wf_amber E typ_nat
| wfa_top: forall E,
    wfe_amber E ->
    wf_amber E typ_top
| wfa_fvarl: forall E X Y,
    In (X,Y) E ->
    wfe_amber E ->
    wf_amber E X
| wfa_fvarr: forall E X Y,
    In (X,Y) E ->
    wfe_amber E ->
    wf_amber E Y
| wfa_arrow: forall E A1 A2,
    wf_amber E A1 ->
    wf_amber E A2 ->
    wf_amber E (typ_arrow A1 A2)
| wfa_rec: forall E A L,
    (forall X Y,
        X \notin L -> Y \notin L \u {{X}} ->
        wf_amber (X ~ Y ++ E) (open_tt A X)) ->
    wf_amber E (typ_mu A).

Inductive sub_amber: env_amber -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| sam_nat: forall E,
    wfe_amber E ->
    sub_amber E typ_nat typ_nat
| sam_top: forall E A,
    wf_amber E A ->
    wfe_amber E ->
    sub_amber E A typ_top
| sam_fvar: forall E X Y,
    In (X, Y) E ->
    wfe_amber E ->
    sub_amber E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar Y)
| sam_arrow: forall E A1 A2 B1 B2,
    sub_amber E B1 A1 ->
    sub_amber E A2 B2 ->
    sub_amber E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
| sam_rec: forall E A B L,
    (forall X Y,
        X \notin L -> Y \notin {{X}} \u L ->
        sub_amber ((X,Y)::E) (open_tt A X) (open_tt B Y)) ->
    sub_amber E (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)
| sam_refl: forall E A,
    wfe_amber E ->
    wf_amber E (typ_mu A) ->
    sub_amber E (typ_mu A) (typ_mu A)
.

1	Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.
2	
3	Require Import Program.Equality.
4	
5	Inductive typ : Set :=
6	| typ_top   : typ
7	| typ_nat   : typ
8	| typ_bvar  : nat -> typ
9	| typ_fvar  : var -> typ
10	| typ_mu :    typ -> typ
11	| typ_arrow : typ -> typ -> typ
12	.
13	
14	Coercion typ_bvar : nat >-> typ.
15	
16	Coercion typ_fvar : atom >-> typ.
17	
18	Fixpoint open_tt_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
19	  match T with
20	  | typ_nat         => typ_nat
21	  | typ_top         => typ_top
22	  | typ_bvar J      => if K === J then U else (typ_bvar J)
23	  | typ_fvar X      => typ_fvar X
24	  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec K U T2)
25	  | typ_mu T        => typ_mu (open_tt_rec (S K) U T)
26	  end.
27	
28	Definition open_tt T U := open_tt_rec 0 U T.
29	
30	Inductive type : typ -> Prop :=
31	  | type_top :
32	      type typ_top
33	  | type_nat :
34	      type typ_nat
35	  | type_var : forall X,
36	      type (typ_fvar X)
37	  | type_arrow : forall T1 T2,
38	      type T1 ->
39	      type T2 ->
40	      type (typ_arrow T1 T2)
41	  | type_mu : forall L T,
42	      (forall X, X \notin L -> type (open_tt T (typ_fvar X))) ->
43	      type (typ_mu T)
44	.
45	
46	Fixpoint subst_tt (Z : atom) (U : typ) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
47	  match T with
48	  | typ_top => typ_top
49	  | typ_nat => typ_nat
50	  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
51	  | typ_fvar X => if X == Z then U else (typ_fvar X)
52	  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (subst_tt Z U T1) (subst_tt Z U T2)
53	  | typ_mu T => typ_mu (subst_tt Z U T)
54	  end.
55	
56	Fixpoint fv_tt (T : typ) {struct T} : atoms :=
57	  match T with
58	  | typ_top => {}
59	  | typ_nat => {}
60	  | typ_bvar J => {}
61	  | typ_fvar X => {{ X }}
62	  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => (fv_tt T1) `union` (fv_tt T2)
63	  | typ_mu T => (fv_tt T)
64	  end.
65	
66	Inductive binding : Set :=
67	  | bind_sub : binding
68	  | bind_typ : typ -> binding.
69	
70	Definition env := list (atom * binding).
71	
72	Notation empty := (@nil (atom * binding)).
73	
74	Fixpoint unfoldT (A : typ) X (n : nat) :=
75	  match n with
76	  | 0 => open_tt A (typ_fvar X)
77	  | (S i) => open_tt A (unfoldT A X i)
78	  end.
79	
80	Inductive WFS : env -> typ -> Prop :=
81	| WFS_top : forall E, WFS E typ_top
82	| WFS_nat : forall E, WFS E typ_nat
83	| WFS_fvar : forall X E,
84	    binds X bind_sub E ->
85	    WFS E (typ_fvar X)
86	| WFS_arrow : forall E A B,
87	    WFS E A ->
88	    WFS E B ->
89	    WFS E (typ_arrow A B)
90	| WFS_rec : forall L E A,
91	      (forall n X, X \notin L ->
92	        WFS (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (unfoldT A X n)) ->
93	      WFS E (typ_mu A).
94	
95	Inductive wf_env : env -> Prop :=
96	  | wf_env_empty :
97	      wf_env empty
98	  | wf_env_sub : forall (E : env) (X : atom),
99	      wf_env E ->
100	      X \notin dom E ->
101	      wf_env (X ~ bind_sub ++ E)
102	  | wf_env_typ : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (T : typ),
103	      wf_env E ->
104	      WFS E T ->
105	      x `notin` dom E ->
106	      wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E).
107	
108	Inductive exp : Set :=
109	  | exp_bvar : nat -> exp
110	  | exp_fvar : atom -> exp
111	  | exp_abs : typ -> exp -> exp
112	  | exp_app : exp -> exp -> exp
113	  | exp_nat : exp
114	  | exp_unfold : typ -> exp -> exp
115	  | exp_fold : typ -> exp -> exp
116	.
117	
118	Coercion exp_bvar : nat >-> exp.
119	
120	Coercion exp_fvar : atom >-> exp.
121	
122	Fixpoint open_ee_rec (k : nat) (f : exp) (e : exp)  {struct e} : exp :=
123	  match e with
124	  | exp_bvar i => if k == i then f else (exp_bvar i)
125	  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
126	  | exp_abs t e1 => exp_abs t (open_ee_rec (S k) f e1)
127	  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec k f e2)
128	  | exp_nat => exp_nat
129	  | exp_unfold T e => exp_unfold T (open_ee_rec k f e)
130	  | exp_fold T e => exp_fold T (open_ee_rec k f e)
131	  end.
132	
133	Notation open_ee e1 e2     := (open_ee_rec 0 e2 e1).
134	
135	Fixpoint subst_ee (y:atom) (u:exp) (e:exp) {struct e} : exp :=
136	  match e with
137	  | (exp_bvar n)   => exp_bvar n
138	  | (exp_fvar x)   => (if x == y then u else (exp_fvar x))
139	  | (exp_abs T e1)    => exp_abs T (subst_ee y u e1)
140	  | (exp_app e1 e2) => exp_app (subst_ee y u e1) (subst_ee y u e2)
141	  | exp_nat => exp_nat
142	  | exp_unfold T e => exp_unfold T (subst_ee y u e)
143	  | exp_fold T e => exp_fold T (subst_ee y u e)
144	  end.
145	
146	Fixpoint fv_exp (e_5:exp) : vars :=
147	  match e_5 with
148	  | (exp_bvar nat)   => {}
149	  | (exp_fvar x)   => {{x}}
150	  | (exp_abs T e)     => fv_exp e
151	  | (exp_app e1 e2) => fv_exp e1 \u fv_exp e2
152	  | exp_nat => {}
153	  | exp_unfold T e => fv_exp e
154	  | exp_fold T e => fv_exp e
155	  end.
156	
157	Inductive expr : exp -> Prop :=
158	 | lc_fvar : forall (x:var),
159	     expr (exp_fvar x)
160	 | lc_abs : forall (e:exp) L T,
161	     (forall x, x \notin L -> expr (open_ee e (exp_fvar x)))  ->
162	     type T ->
163	     expr (exp_abs T e)
164	 | lc_app : forall (e1 e2:exp),
165	     expr e1 ->
166	     expr e2 ->
167	     expr (exp_app e1 e2)
168	 | lc_nat :
169	     expr exp_nat
170	 | lc_unfold: forall T e,
171	     type T ->
172	     expr e ->
173	     expr (exp_unfold T e)
174	 | lc_fold: forall T e,
175	     type T ->
176	     expr e ->
177	     expr (exp_fold T e).
178	
179	Inductive Sub : env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
180	| SA_nat: forall E,
181	    wf_env E ->
182	    Sub E typ_nat typ_nat
183	| SA_fvar: forall E X,
184	    wf_env E ->
185	    binds X bind_sub E ->
186	    Sub E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
187	| SA_top : forall E A,
188	    wf_env E ->
189	    WFS E A ->
190	    Sub E A typ_top
191	| SA_arrow: forall E A1 A2 B1 B2,
192	    Sub E B1 A1 ->
193	    Sub E A2 B2 ->
194	    Sub E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
195	| SA_rec: forall L A1 A2 E,
196	    (forall n X,
197	        X \notin L ->
198	        Sub ((X ~ bind_sub) ++ E)  (unfoldT A1 X n) (unfoldT A2 X n)) ->
199	    Sub E (typ_mu A1) (typ_mu A2).
200	
201	Inductive typing : env -> exp -> typ -> Prop :=
202	| typing_nat: forall G,
203	    wf_env G ->
204	    typing G (exp_nat) (typ_nat)
205	| typing_var : forall (G:env) (x:var) (T:typ),
206	     wf_env G ->
207	     binds x (bind_typ T) G  ->
208	     typing G (exp_fvar x) T
209	 | typing_abs : forall (L:vars) (G:env) (T1:typ) (e:exp) (T2:typ),
210	     (forall x , x \notin L -> typing ((x ~ bind_typ T1) ++ G) (open_ee e x) T2)  ->
211	     typing G (exp_abs T1 e) (typ_arrow T1 T2)
212	 | typing_app : forall (G:env) (e1 e2:exp) (T2 T1:typ),
213	     typing G e1 (typ_arrow T1 T2) ->
214	     typing G e2 T1 ->
215	     typing G (exp_app e1 e2) T2
216	 | typing_fold : forall G A e ,
217	     typing G e  (open_tt A  (typ_mu A))    ->
218	     WFS G (typ_mu A) ->
219	     typing G (exp_fold (typ_mu A) e) (typ_mu A)
220	 | typing_unfold : forall G T e,
221	     typing G e (typ_mu T) ->
222	     typing G (exp_unfold (typ_mu T) e)  (open_tt T  (typ_mu T))
223	 | typing_sub: forall G T e S ,
224	     typing G e S ->
225	     Sub G S T ->
226	     typing G e T.
227	
228	Inductive value : exp -> Prop :=
229	  | value_abs : forall t1 T,
230	      expr (exp_abs T t1) ->
231	      value (exp_abs T t1)
232	  | value_nat:
233	      value exp_nat
234	  | value_fold: forall T e,
235	      type T ->
236	      value e ->
237	      value (exp_fold T e).
238	
239	Inductive step : exp -> exp -> Prop :=
240	 | step_beta : forall (e1 e2:exp) T,
241	     expr (exp_abs T e1) ->
242	     value e2 ->
243	     step (exp_app  (exp_abs T e1) e2)  (open_ee e1 e2)
244	 | step_app1 : forall (e1 e2 e1':exp),
245	     expr e2 ->
246	     step e1 e1' ->
247	     step (exp_app e1 e2) (exp_app e1' e2)
248	 | step_app2 : forall v1 e2 e2',
249	     value v1 ->
250	     step e2 e2' ->
251	     step (exp_app v1 e2) (exp_app v1 e2')
252	 | step_fld: forall S T v,
253	     value v ->
254	     type T ->
255	     type S ->
256	     step (exp_unfold S (exp_fold T v)) v
257	 | step_fold: forall e e' T,
258	     step e e' ->
259	     type T ->
260	     step (exp_fold T e) (exp_fold T e')
261	 | step_unfold: forall e e' T,
262	     step e e' ->
263	     type T ->
264	     step (exp_unfold T e) (exp_unfold T e').
265	
266	Inductive WFA : env -> typ -> Prop :=
267	| WFA_top : forall E, WFA E typ_top
268	| WFA_nat : forall E, WFA E typ_nat
269	| WFA_fvar : forall X E,
270	    binds X bind_sub E ->
271	    WFA E (typ_fvar X)
272	| WFA_arrow : forall E A B,
273	    WFA E A ->
274	    WFA E B ->
275	    WFA E (typ_arrow A B)
276	| WFA_rec : forall L E A,
277	      (forall X, X \notin L ->
278	                 WFA (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X)) ->
279	      WFA E (typ_mu A).
280	
281	Inductive WF : env -> typ -> Prop :=
282	| WF_top : forall E, WF E typ_top
283	| WF_nat : forall E, WF E typ_nat
284	| WF_fvar : forall X E,
285	    binds X bind_sub E ->
286	    WF E (typ_fvar X)
287	| WF_arrow : forall E A B,
288	    WF E A ->
289	    WF E B ->
290	    WF E (typ_arrow A B)
291	| WF_rec : forall L E A,
292	      (forall X, X \notin L ->
293	                 WF (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X)) ->
294	      (forall X, X \notin L ->
295	                 WF (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A (open_tt A X))) ->
296	      WF E (typ_mu A).
297	
298	Inductive sub : env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
299	| sa_nat: forall E,
300	    wf_env E ->
301	    sub E typ_nat typ_nat
302	| sa_fvar: forall E X,
303	    wf_env E ->
304	    binds X bind_sub E ->
305	    sub E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
306	| sa_top : forall E A,
307	    wf_env E ->
308	    WF E A ->
309	    sub E A typ_top
310	| sa_arrow: forall E A1 A2 B1 B2,
311	    sub E B1 A1 ->
312	    sub E A2 B2 ->
313	    sub E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
314	| sa_rec: forall L A1 A2 E,
315	    (forall X,
316	        X \notin L ->
317	        sub (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A1 X) (open_tt A2 X)) ->
318	    (forall X,
319	        X \notin L ->
320	        sub (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A1 (open_tt A1 X)) (open_tt A2 (open_tt A2 X))) ->
321	    sub E (typ_mu A1) (typ_mu A2).
322	
323	Inductive Mode := Neg | Pos.
324	
325	Definition flip (m : Mode) : Mode :=
326	  match m with
327	  | Neg => Pos
328	  | Pos => Neg
329	  end.
330	
331	Fixpoint UnfoldS n X A :=
332	  match n with
333	  | 0   => A
334	  | S i => subst_tt X (UnfoldS i X A) A

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Program.Equality.

Inductive typ : Set :=
| typ_top   : typ
| typ_nat   : typ
| typ_bvar  : nat -> typ
| typ_fvar  : var -> typ
| typ_mu :    typ -> typ
| typ_arrow : typ -> typ -> typ
.

Coercion typ_bvar : nat >-> typ.

Coercion typ_fvar : atom >-> typ.

Fixpoint open_tt_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_nat         => typ_nat
  | typ_top         => typ_top
  | typ_bvar J      => if K === J then U else (typ_bvar J)
  | typ_fvar X      => typ_fvar X
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec K U T2)
  | typ_mu T        => typ_mu (open_tt_rec (S K) U T)
  end.

Definition open_tt T U := open_tt_rec 0 U T.

Inductive type : typ -> Prop :=
  | type_top :
      type typ_top
  | type_nat :
      type typ_nat
  | type_var : forall X,
      type (typ_fvar X)
  | type_arrow : forall T1 T2,
      type T1 ->
      type T2 ->
      type (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | type_mu : forall L T,
      (forall X, X \notin L -> type (open_tt T (typ_fvar X))) ->
      type (typ_mu T)
.

Fixpoint subst_tt (Z : atom) (U : typ) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_nat => typ_nat
  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar X => if X == Z then U else (typ_fvar X)
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (subst_tt Z U T1) (subst_tt Z U T2)
  | typ_mu T => typ_mu (subst_tt Z U T)
  end.

Fixpoint fv_tt (T : typ) {struct T} : atoms :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => {}
  | typ_nat => {}
  | typ_bvar J => {}
  | typ_fvar X => {{ X }}
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => (fv_tt T1) `union` (fv_tt T2)
  | typ_mu T => (fv_tt T)
  end.

Inductive binding : Set :=
  | bind_sub : binding
  | bind_typ : typ -> binding.

Definition env := list (atom * binding).

Notation empty := (@nil (atom * binding)).

Fixpoint unfoldT (A : typ) X (n : nat) :=
  match n with
  | 0 => open_tt A (typ_fvar X)
  | (S i) => open_tt A (unfoldT A X i)
  end.

Inductive WFS : env -> typ -> Prop :=
| WFS_top : forall E, WFS E typ_top
| WFS_nat : forall E, WFS E typ_nat
| WFS_fvar : forall X E,
    binds X bind_sub E ->
    WFS E (typ_fvar X)
| WFS_arrow : forall E A B,
    WFS E A ->
    WFS E B ->
    WFS E (typ_arrow A B)
| WFS_rec : forall L E A,
      (forall n X, X \notin L ->
        WFS (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (unfoldT A X n)) ->
      WFS E (typ_mu A).

Inductive wf_env : env -> Prop :=
  | wf_env_empty :
      wf_env empty
  | wf_env_sub : forall (E : env) (X : atom),
      wf_env E ->
      X \notin dom E ->
      wf_env (X ~ bind_sub ++ E)
  | wf_env_typ : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      WFS E T ->
      x `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E).

Inductive exp : Set :=
  | exp_bvar : nat -> exp
  | exp_fvar : atom -> exp
  | exp_abs : typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_app : exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_nat : exp
  | exp_unfold : typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_fold : typ -> exp -> exp
.

Coercion exp_bvar : nat >-> exp.

Coercion exp_fvar : atom >-> exp.

Fixpoint open_ee_rec (k : nat) (f : exp) (e : exp)  {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar i => if k == i then f else (exp_bvar i)
  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
  | exp_abs t e1 => exp_abs t (open_ee_rec (S k) f e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec k f e2)
  | exp_nat => exp_nat
  | exp_unfold T e => exp_unfold T (open_ee_rec k f e)
  | exp_fold T e => exp_fold T (open_ee_rec k f e)
  end.

Notation open_ee e1 e2     := (open_ee_rec 0 e2 e1).

Fixpoint subst_ee (y:atom) (u:exp) (e:exp) {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | (exp_bvar n)   => exp_bvar n
  | (exp_fvar x)   => (if x == y then u else (exp_fvar x))
  | (exp_abs T e1)    => exp_abs T (subst_ee y u e1)
  | (exp_app e1 e2) => exp_app (subst_ee y u e1) (subst_ee y u e2)
  | exp_nat => exp_nat
  | exp_unfold T e => exp_unfold T (subst_ee y u e)
  | exp_fold T e => exp_fold T (subst_ee y u e)
  end.

Fixpoint fv_exp (e_5:exp) : vars :=
  match e_5 with
  | (exp_bvar nat)   => {}
  | (exp_fvar x)   => {{x}}
  | (exp_abs T e)     => fv_exp e
  | (exp_app e1 e2) => fv_exp e1 \u fv_exp e2
  | exp_nat => {}
  | exp_unfold T e => fv_exp e
  | exp_fold T e => fv_exp e
  end.

Inductive expr : exp -> Prop :=
 | lc_fvar : forall (x:var),
     expr (exp_fvar x)
 | lc_abs : forall (e:exp) L T,
     (forall x, x \notin L -> expr (open_ee e (exp_fvar x)))  ->
     type T ->
     expr (exp_abs T e)
 | lc_app : forall (e1 e2:exp),
     expr e1 ->
     expr e2 ->
     expr (exp_app e1 e2)
 | lc_nat :
     expr exp_nat
 | lc_unfold: forall T e,
     type T ->
     expr e ->
     expr (exp_unfold T e)
 | lc_fold: forall T e,
     type T ->
     expr e ->
     expr (exp_fold T e).

Inductive Sub : env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| SA_nat: forall E,
    wf_env E ->
    Sub E typ_nat typ_nat
| SA_fvar: forall E X,
    wf_env E ->
    binds X bind_sub E ->
    Sub E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
| SA_top : forall E A,
    wf_env E ->
    WFS E A ->
    Sub E A typ_top
| SA_arrow: forall E A1 A2 B1 B2,
    Sub E B1 A1 ->
    Sub E A2 B2 ->
    Sub E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
| SA_rec: forall L A1 A2 E,
    (forall n X,
        X \notin L ->
        Sub ((X ~ bind_sub) ++ E)  (unfoldT A1 X n) (unfoldT A2 X n)) ->
    Sub E (typ_mu A1) (typ_mu A2).

Inductive typing : env -> exp -> typ -> Prop :=
| typing_nat: forall G,
    wf_env G ->
    typing G (exp_nat) (typ_nat)
| typing_var : forall (G:env) (x:var) (T:typ),
     wf_env G ->
     binds x (bind_typ T) G  ->
     typing G (exp_fvar x) T
 | typing_abs : forall (L:vars) (G:env) (T1:typ) (e:exp) (T2:typ),
     (forall x , x \notin L -> typing ((x ~ bind_typ T1) ++ G) (open_ee e x) T2)  ->
     typing G (exp_abs T1 e) (typ_arrow T1 T2)
 | typing_app : forall (G:env) (e1 e2:exp) (T2 T1:typ),
     typing G e1 (typ_arrow T1 T2) ->
     typing G e2 T1 ->
     typing G (exp_app e1 e2) T2
 | typing_fold : forall G A e ,
     typing G e  (open_tt A  (typ_mu A))    ->
     WFS G (typ_mu A) ->
     typing G (exp_fold (typ_mu A) e) (typ_mu A)
 | typing_unfold : forall G T e,
     typing G e (typ_mu T) ->
     typing G (exp_unfold (typ_mu T) e)  (open_tt T  (typ_mu T))
 | typing_sub: forall G T e S ,
     typing G e S ->
     Sub G S T ->
     typing G e T.

Inductive value : exp -> Prop :=
  | value_abs : forall t1 T,
      expr (exp_abs T t1) ->
      value (exp_abs T t1)
  | value_nat:
      value exp_nat
  | value_fold: forall T e,
      type T ->
      value e ->
      value (exp_fold T e).

Inductive step : exp -> exp -> Prop :=
 | step_beta : forall (e1 e2:exp) T,
     expr (exp_abs T e1) ->
     value e2 ->
     step (exp_app  (exp_abs T e1) e2)  (open_ee e1 e2)
 | step_app1 : forall (e1 e2 e1':exp),
     expr e2 ->
     step e1 e1' ->
     step (exp_app e1 e2) (exp_app e1' e2)
 | step_app2 : forall v1 e2 e2',
     value v1 ->
     step e2 e2' ->
     step (exp_app v1 e2) (exp_app v1 e2')
 | step_fld: forall S T v,
     value v ->
     type T ->
     type S ->
     step (exp_unfold S (exp_fold T v)) v
 | step_fold: forall e e' T,
     step e e' ->
     type T ->
     step (exp_fold T e) (exp_fold T e')
 | step_unfold: forall e e' T,
     step e e' ->
     type T ->
     step (exp_unfold T e) (exp_unfold T e').

Inductive WFA : env -> typ -> Prop :=
| WFA_top : forall E, WFA E typ_top
| WFA_nat : forall E, WFA E typ_nat
| WFA_fvar : forall X E,
    binds X bind_sub E ->
    WFA E (typ_fvar X)
| WFA_arrow : forall E A B,
    WFA E A ->
    WFA E B ->
    WFA E (typ_arrow A B)
| WFA_rec : forall L E A,
      (forall X, X \notin L ->
                 WFA (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X)) ->
      WFA E (typ_mu A).

Inductive WF : env -> typ -> Prop :=
| WF_top : forall E, WF E typ_top
| WF_nat : forall E, WF E typ_nat
| WF_fvar : forall X E,
    binds X bind_sub E ->
    WF E (typ_fvar X)
| WF_arrow : forall E A B,
    WF E A ->
    WF E B ->
    WF E (typ_arrow A B)
| WF_rec : forall L E A,
      (forall X, X \notin L ->
                 WF (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X)) ->
      (forall X, X \notin L ->
                 WF (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A (open_tt A X))) ->
      WF E (typ_mu A).

Inductive sub : env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| sa_nat: forall E,
    wf_env E ->
    sub E typ_nat typ_nat
| sa_fvar: forall E X,
    wf_env E ->
    binds X bind_sub E ->
    sub E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
| sa_top : forall E A,
    wf_env E ->
    WF E A ->
    sub E A typ_top
| sa_arrow: forall E A1 A2 B1 B2,
    sub E B1 A1 ->
    sub E A2 B2 ->
    sub E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
| sa_rec: forall L A1 A2 E,
    (forall X,
        X \notin L ->
        sub (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A1 X) (open_tt A2 X)) ->
    (forall X,
        X \notin L ->
        sub (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A1 (open_tt A1 X)) (open_tt A2 (open_tt A2 X))) ->
    sub E (typ_mu A1) (typ_mu A2).

Inductive Mode := Neg | Pos.

Definition flip (m : Mode) : Mode :=
  match m with
  | Neg => Pos
  | Pos => Neg
  end.

Fixpoint UnfoldS n X A :=
  match n with
  | 0   => A
  | S i => subst_tt X (UnfoldS i X A) A
  end.

Definition chooseD(n : nat) (m : Mode) X (C : typ) (D : typ) :=
  match m with
  | Pos => subst_tt X (subst_tt X (UnfoldS n X C) C)
  | Neg => subst_tt X (subst_tt X (UnfoldS n X D) D)
  end.

Definition chooseS (m : Mode) X (C : typ) (D : typ) :=
  match m with
  | Pos => subst_tt X C
  | Neg => subst_tt X D
  end.

Fixpoint def1 (X: atom) (A: typ) (n:nat): typ :=
  match n with
  | 0 => A
  | S n1 => subst_tt X (def1 X A n1) A
  end.

import sys,itertools
sys.setrecursionlimit(300000)

from sub import *
def iso2(E,A,B,depth=0):
    if depth>100: return False
    if A==NAT and B==NAT: return True
    if B==TOP and wf_iso(E,A): return True
    if A[0]=='fvar' and B[0]=='fvar': return A[1]==B[1] and A[1] in E
    if A[0]=='arrow' and B[0]=='arrow':
        return iso2(E,B[1],A[1],depth+1) and iso2(E,A[2],B[2],depth+1)
    if A[0]=='mu' and B[0]=='mu':
        a1,a2=A[1],B[1]
        used=set(E)|fvs(a1)|fvs(a2)
        Z=max(used,default=-1)+1
        E2=[Z]+E
        return iso2(E2,op(a1,fv_(Z)),op(a2,fv_(Z)),depth+1) and iso2(E2,op(a1,op(a1,fv_(Z))),op(a2,op(a2,fv_(Z))),depth+1)
    return False
def amber2(Ea,A,B,depth=0):
    if depth>150: return None
    if not wfe_amber(Ea): return False
    if A==NAT and B==NAT: return True
    if B==TOP and wf_amber(Ea,A): return True
    if A[0]=='fvar' and B[0]=='fvar' and (A[1],B[1]) in Ea: return True
    if A[0]=='arrow' and B[0]=='arrow' and amber2(Ea,B[1],A[1],depth+1) and amber2(Ea,A[2],B[2],depth+1): return True
    if A[0]=='mu' and B[0]=='mu':
        a1,a2=A[1],B[1]
        used=set(itertools.chain(*[(x,y) for x,y in Ea]))|fvs(a1)|fvs(a2)
        X=max(used,default=-1)+1; Y=X+1
        if amber2(Ea+[(X,Y)],op(a1,fv_(X)),op(a2,fv_(Y)),depth+1): return True
        if A==B and wf_amber(Ea,A): return True
        return False
    return False
def sh(T,d=0):
    t=T[0]

    if t=='nat': return 'Nat'
    if t=='bvar': return 'x%d'%T[1]

    if t=='arrow': return '(%s -> %s)'%(sh(T[1],d),sh(T[2],d))
    return str(T)

Require Import AmberBase.
Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.
Require Import Program.Equality.

Definition env_mode := list ( Mode).

Definition eqMode (a b: Mode)  : bool :=
  match a,b with
  | Pos, Pos => true
  | Neg, Neg => true
  | _,_ => false
  end.

Fixpoint amber_cov (Ea : env_amber) (Em : env_mode) (T:typ) (m:Mode) : typ :=
  match Ea, Em with
  | (X,Y)::E, m'::Em' => if (eqMode m' m) then amber_cov E Em' (subst_tt X Y T) m
                         else amber_cov E Em' T m
  | _,_ => T
  end.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Auxiliary definitions                                              *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Fixpoint bindsub_atoms (E : env) : atoms :=
  match E with
  | nil => empty
  | (X, bind_sub) :: E' => add X (bindsub_atoms E')
  | (_, bind_typ _) :: E' => bindsub_atoms E'
  end.

Fixpoint ren_tt (f : atom -> atom) (T : typ) : typ :=
  match T with

  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar X => typ_fvar (f X)
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (ren_tt f T1) (ren_tt f T2)

  end.

      * right; assumption.

Qed.

Require Import AmberBase.
Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.
Require Import Program.Equality.

Definition env_mode := list ( Mode).

Definition eqMode (a b: Mode)  : bool :=
  match a,b with
  | Pos, Pos => true
  | Neg, Neg => true
  | _,_ => false
  end.

Fixpoint amber_cov (Ea : env_amber) (Em : env_mode) (T:typ) (m:Mode) : typ :=
  match Ea, Em with
  | (X,Y)::E, m'::Em' => if (eqMode m' m) then amber_cov E Em' (subst_tt X Y T) m
                         else amber_cov E Em' T m
  | _,_ => T
  end.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Auxiliary definitions and lemmas                                   *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint bindsub_atoms (E : env) : atoms :=
  match E with
  | nil => empty
  | (X, bind_sub) :: E' => add X (bindsub_atoms E')
  | (_, bind_typ _) :: E' => bindsub_atoms E'
  end.

Lemma in_bindsub_atoms : forall E X,
  X \in bindsub_atoms E <-> binds X bind_sub E.
Proof.
  induction E as [| [Y b] E IH]; intros X; simpl.
  - unfold binds. simpl. split; intros H.
    + fsetdec.
    + contradiction.
  - destruct b; simpl.
    + unfold binds. simpl.
      rewrite add_iff. rewrite IH.
      split; intros [H|H].
      * left. inversion H. reflexivity.
      * right. assumption.
      * left. inversion H. reflexivity.
      * right. assumption.
    + unfold binds. simpl.
      rewrite IH. split; intros H.
      * right; assumption.
      * destruct H as [H|H]; auto. inversion H.
Qed.

(* renaming of free atoms *)
Definition ren_tt (f : atom -> atom) (T : typ) : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_nat => typ_nat
  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar X => typ_fvar (f X)
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (ren_tt f T1) (ren_tt f T2)
  | typ_mu T => typ_mu (ren_tt f T)
  end.

Lemma ren_tt_id : forall T, ren_tt (fun X => X) T = T.
Proof. induction T; simpl; congruence. Qed.

Lemma ren_tt_ext : forall f g T,
  (forall X, X \in fv_tt T -> f X = g X) ->
  ren_tt f T = ren_tt g T.
Proof.
  intros f g T; induction T; simpl; intros H; auto.
  - apply H. simpl. fsetdec.
  - rewrite IHT1, IHT2; auto.
    + intros X HX. apply H. simpl. fsetdec.
    + intros X HX. apply H. simpl. fsetdec.
  - rewrite IHT. auto.
Qed.

Lemma ren_tt_open_rec : forall f T K X,
  ren_tt f (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T) =
  open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar (f X)) (ren_tt f T).
Proof.
  intros f T; induction T; intros K X; simpl; auto.
  - destruct (K === n); reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHT. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ren_tt_open : forall f T X,
  ren_tt f (open_tt T (fvar X)) = open_tt (ren_tt f T) (fvar (f X)).
Proof.
  intros. unfold open_tt. apply ren_tt_open_rec.
Qed.

(* local closedness (all bvars bound) *)
Fixpoint lc_rec (d : nat) (T : typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_nat => True
  | typ_bvar J => J < d
  | typ_fvar X => True
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => lc_rec d T1 /\ lc_rec d T2
  | typ_mu T => lc_rec (S d) T
  end.

Definition lc_tt T := lc_rec 0 T.

Lemma lc_open_self : forall T X, lc_tt T -> lc_tt (open_tt T (fvar X)).

    - (* bvar *) unfold eq_nat_dec_atom. admit.
    - destruct Hlc. split; auto.
    - apply IHT. simpl. apply Hlc. }
  apply H. assumption.

Require Import AmberBase.
Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.
Require Import Program.Equality.

Definition env_mode := list ( Mode).

Definition eqMode (a b: Mode)  : bool :=
  match a,b with
  | Pos, Pos => true
  | Neg, Neg => true
  | _,_ => false
  end.

Fixpoint amber_cov (Ea : env_amber) (Em : env_mode) (T:typ) (m:Mode) : typ :=
  match Ea, Em with
  | (X,Y)::E, m'::Em' => if (eqMode m' m) then amber_cov E Em' (subst_tt X Y T) m
                         else amber_cov E Em' T m
  | _,_ => T
  end.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Auxiliary definitions                                              *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint bindsub_atoms (E : env) : atoms :=
  match E with
  | nil => empty
  | (X, bind_sub) :: E' => add X (bindsub_atoms E')
  | (_, bind_typ _) :: E' => bindsub_atoms E'
  end.

Lemma in_bindsub_atoms : forall E X,
  X \in bindsub_atoms E <-> binds X bind_sub E.
Proof.
  induction E as [| [Y b] E IH]; intros X; simpl.
  - unfold binds. simpl. split; intros H.
    + fsetdec.
    + contradiction.
  - destruct b; simpl.
    + unfold binds. simpl.
      rewrite add_iff. rewrite IH.
      split; intros [H|H].
      * left. inversion H. reflexivity.
      * right. assumption.
      * left. inversion H. reflexivity.
      * right. assumption.
    + unfold binds. simpl.
      rewrite IH. split; intros H.
      * right; assumption.
      * destruct H as [H|H]; auto. inversion H.
Qed.

Definition ren_tt (f : atom -> atom) (T : typ) : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_nat => typ_nat
  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar X => typ_fvar (f X)
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (ren_tt f T1) (ren_tt f T2)
  | typ_mu T => typ_mu (ren_tt f T)
  end.

Lemma ren_tt_id : forall T, ren_tt (fun X => X) T = T.
Proof. induction T; simpl; congruence. Qed.

Lemma ren_tt_ext : forall f g T,
  (forall X, X \in fv_tt T -> f X = g X) ->
  ren_tt f T = ren_tt g T.
Proof.
  intros f g T; induction T; simpl; intros H; auto.
  - apply H. simpl. fsetdec.
  - rewrite IHT1, IHT2; auto;
    intros X HX; apply H; simpl; fsetdec.
  - rewrite IHT. auto.
Qed.

Lemma ren_tt_open_rec : forall f T K X,
  ren_tt f (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T) =
  open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar (f X)) (ren_tt f T).
Proof.
  intros f T; induction T; intros K X; simpl; auto.
  - destruct (K === n); reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHT. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ren_tt_open : forall f T X,
  ren_tt f (open_tt T (typ_fvar X)) = open_tt (ren_tt f T) (typ_fvar (f X)).
Proof. intros. unfold open_tt. apply ren_tt_open_rec. Qed.

(* locally closed types *)
Fixpoint lc_rec (d : nat) (T : typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_nat => True
  | typ_bvar J => J < d
  | typ_fvar X => True
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => lc_rec d T1 /\ lc_rec d T2
  | typ_mu T => lc_rec (S d) T
  end.

Definition lc_tt T := lc_rec 0 T.

  - apply IHT. simpl. apply H.
Qed.

Lemma in_domA_cons : forall X Y E z,

(* ============== per-atom origin translation ======================= *)
Definition pick (o : atom -> bool) (f g : atom -> atom) : atom -> atom :=
  fun X => if o X then f X else g X.

Definition ren_pick (o : atom -> bool) (f g : atom -> atom) (T : typ) : typ :=
  ren_tt (pick o f g) T.

(* compatibility: for every matched atom occurrence, the origins must be
   (false,true) at negative polarity or (true,false) at positive polarity *)
Fixpoint compat (o1 o2 : atom -> bool) (pol : bool) (A B : typ) : Prop :=
  match A, B with
  | typ_fvar X, typ_fvar Y =>
      if X == Y then
        (if o1 X then (if o2 X then False else pol = true)
                   else (if o2 X then pol = false else False))
      else True
  | typ_arrow A1 A2, typ_arrow B1 B2 =>
      compat o1 o2 (negb pol) A1 B1 /\ compat o1 o2 pol A2 B2
  | typ_mu A1, typ_mu B1 => compat o1 o2 pol A1 B1
  | _,_ => True
  end.

Lemma compat_flip : forall A B o1 o2 pol,
  compat o1 o2 pol A B <-> compat o2 o1 (negb pol) B A.
Proof.
  induction A as [| |n|x|T IHT|A1 IHA1 A2 IHA2]; intros B o1 o2 pol.
  - destruct B; simpl; tauto.
  - destruct B; simpl; tauto.
  - destruct B; simpl; tauto.

      * tauto.
  - (* mu *) destruct B; simpl.
    + tauto. + tauto. + tauto. + tauto.
    + apply IHT.
    + tauto.
  - (* arrow *) destruct B as [| |m|y|BT|B1 B2]; simpl; auto.
    destruct (IHA1 B1 o1 o2 (negb pol)) as [Hl Hr].
    destruct (IHA2 B2 o1 o2 pol) as [Hl2 Hr2].
    rewrite negb_involutive.
    tauto.
Qed.

Lemma compat_flip_false : forall A B o1 o2,
  compat o1 o2 false A B -> compat o2 o1 true B A.
Proof. intros. apply compat_flip. rewrite negb_involutive. exact H. Qed.
EOF

(* ============== per-atom origin translation ======================= *)
Definition pick (o : atom -> bool) (f g : atom -> atom) : atom -> atom :=
  fun X => if o X then f X else g X.

Definition ren_pick (o : atom -> bool) (f g : atom -> atom) (T : typ) : typ :=
  ren_tt (pick o f g) T.

(* compatibility: for every matched atom occurrence, the origins must be
   (false,true) at negative polarity or (true,false) at positive polarity *)
Fixpoint compat (o1 o2 : atom -> bool) (pol : bool) (A B : typ) : Prop :=
  match A, B with
  | typ_fvar X, typ_fvar Y =>
      if X == Y then
        (if o1 X then (if o2 X then False else pol = true)
                   else (if o2 X then pol = false else False))
      else True
  | typ_arrow A1 A2, typ_arrow B1 B2 =>
      compat o1 o2 (negb pol) A1 B1 /\ compat o1 o2 pol A2 B2
  | typ_mu A1, typ_mu B1 => compat o1 o2 pol A1 B1
  | _,_ => True
  end.

Lemma compat_flip : forall A B o1 o2 pol,
  compat o1 o2 pol A B <-> compat o2 o1 (negb pol) B A.
Proof.
  induction A as [| |n|x|T IHT|A1 IHA1 A2 IHA2];
  intros B o1 o2 pol.
  - destruct B as [| |m|y|BT|B1 B2]; simpl; tauto.
  - destruct B as [| |m|y|BT|B1 B2]; simpl; tauto.
  - destruct B as [| |m|y|BT|B1 B2]; simpl; tauto.
  - destruct B as [| |m|y|BT|B1 B2]; simpl.
    + tauto. + tauto. + tauto.
    + destruct (x == y) as [Heq|Hneq].
      * subst y. rewrite !eq_dec_refl. simpl.
        destruct (o1 x); destruct (o2 x); destruct pol; simpl; try (split; intros H); try reflexivity; try (inversion H); try discriminate; tauto; tauto.
      * destruct (y == x) as [Heq|Hneq2].
        -- subst y. exfalso. apply Hneq. reflexivity.
        -- tauto.
    + tauto. + tauto.
  - (* A = mu T *) destruct B as [| |m|y|BT|B1 B2]; simpl.
    + tauto. + tauto. + tauto. + tauto.
    + apply IHT.
    + tauto.
  - (* A = arrow *) destruct B as [| |m|y|BT|B1 B2]; simpl.
    + tauto. + tauto. + tauto. + tauto. + tauto.
    + destruct (IHA1 B1 o1 o2 (negb pol)) as [Hl Hr].
      destruct (IHA2 B2 o1 o2 pol) as [Hl2 Hr2].
      split; intros [H1 H2]; split.
      * apply Hl. exact H1.
      * apply Hl2. exact H2.
      * apply Hr. exact H1.
      * apply Hr2. exact H2.
Qed.

Lemma compat_flip_false : forall A B o1 o2,
  compat o1 o2 false A B -> compat o2 o1 true B A.
Proof. intros A B o1 o2 H. apply compat_flip. exact H. Qed.


(* ============== opening injectivity =============================== *)

Lemma open_tt_rec_inj : forall T U K X,
  X \notin fv_tt T -> X \notin fv_tt U ->
  open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T = open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) U -> T = U.
Proof.
  induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2];
  intros U K X HT HU Heq;
  destruct U as [| |m|y|U0|U1 U2]; simpl in *;
  repeat match type of Heq with context [ if ?b then _ else _ ] => destruct b end;
  try discriminate; try reflexivity.
  - subst n. f_equal. exact e0.
  - inversion Heq. reflexivity.
  - exfalso. inversion Heq. subst y. apply HU. fsetdec.
  - exfalso. inversion Heq. subst x. apply HT. fsetdec.
  - inversion Heq. reflexivity.
  - injection Heq as Heq'. f_equal. apply IHT with (K:=S K) (X:=X).
    + exact HT.
    + exact HU.
    + exact Heq'.
  - injection Heq as E1 E2. f_equal.
    + apply IHT1 with (K:=K) (X:=X).
      * fsetdec. * fsetdec. * exact E1.
    + apply IHT2 with (K:=K) (X:=X).
      * fsetdec. * fsetdec. * exact E2.
Qed.

Lemma sub_antisym : forall E A B, sub E A B -> sub E B A -> A = B.
Proof.
  intros E A B H1. induction H1 as
    [ E0 wfE
    | E0 X wfE Hb
    | E0 A0 wfE WFA
    | E0 A1 A2 B1 B2 s1 IH1 s2 IH2
    | L A1 A2 E0 p1 IH1 p2 IH2 ]; intros H2.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - inversion H2. reflexivity.
  - inversion H2. pose proof (IH1 H4) as E1a. pose proof (IH2 H6) as E2a.
    subst. reflexivity.
  - inversion H2.
    destruct (atom_fresh (L \u L0 \u fv_tt A1 \u fv_tt A2)) as [X HX].
    assert (HXL : X \notin L) by fsetdec.
    assert (HXL0 : X \notin L0) by fsetdec.
    assert (HX1 : X \notin fv_tt A1) by fsetdec.
    assert (HX2 : X \notin fv_tt A2) by fsetdec.
    pose proof (IH1 X HXL (H3 X HXL0)) as Heq.
    assert (A1 = A2).
    { apply (open_tt_rec_inj A1 A2 0 X).
      - exact HX1.
      - exact HX2.
      - unfold open_tt in Heq. exact Heq. }
    subst. reflexivity.
Qed.

Theorem amber_complete: forall  A B,
    sub nil A B ->
    sub_amber nil (amber_cov nil nil A Neg) (amber_cov nil nil B Pos) .

Fixpoint ren_tt (f : atom -> atom) (T : typ) : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_nat => typ_nat
  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar X => typ_fvar (f X)
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (ren_tt f T1) (ren_tt f T2)
  | typ_mu T => typ_mu (ren_tt f T)
  end.

Lemma ren_tt_id : forall T, ren_tt (fun X => X) T = T.
Proof. induction T; simpl; congruence. Qed.

Lemma ren_tt_ext : forall f g T,
  (forall X, X \in fv_tt T -> f X = g X) ->
  ren_tt f T = ren_tt g T.
Proof.
  intros f g T; induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; simpl; intros H.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - f_equal. apply H. simpl. fsetdec.
  - f_equal. apply IHT. intros X HX. apply H. simpl. exact HX.
  - f_equal.
    + apply IHT1. intros X HX. apply H. simpl. fsetdec.
    + apply IHT2. intros X HX. apply H. simpl. fsetdec.
Qed.

Lemma ren_tt_open_rec : forall f T K X,
  ren_tt f (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T) =
  open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar (f X)) (ren_tt f T).
Proof.
  intros f T; induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros K X; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (K === n); reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHT. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHT1, IHT2. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ren_tt_open : forall f T X,
  ren_tt f (open_tt T (typ_fvar X)) = open_tt (ren_tt f T) (typ_fvar (f X)).
Proof. intros. unfold open_tt. apply ren_tt_open_rec. Qed.

Require Import AmberBase.
Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.
Require Import Program.Equality.
Require Import Lia.

Definition env_mode := list ( Mode).

Definition eqMode (a b: Mode)  : bool :=
  match a,b with
  | Pos, Pos => true
  | Neg, Neg => true
  | _,_ => false
  end.

Fixpoint amber_cov (Ea : env_amber) (Em : env_mode) (T:typ) (m:Mode) : typ :=
  match Ea, Em with
  | (X,Y)::E, m'::Em' => if (eqMode m' m) then amber_cov E Em' (subst_tt X Y T) m
                         else amber_cov E Em' T m
  | _,_ => T
  end.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Auxiliary definitions                                              *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint bindsub_atoms (E : env) : atoms :=
  match E with
  | nil => empty
  | (X, bind_sub) :: E' => add X (bindsub_atoms E')
  | (_, bind_typ _) :: E' => bindsub_atoms E'
  end.

Lemma in_bindsub_atoms : forall E X,
  X \in bindsub_atoms E <-> binds X bind_sub E.
Proof.
  induction E as [| [Y b] E IH]; intros X; simpl.
  - unfold binds. simpl. split; intros H.
    + fsetdec.
    + contradiction.
  - destruct b; simpl.
    + unfold binds. simpl.
      rewrite add_iff. rewrite IH.
      split; intros [H|H].
      * left. inversion H. reflexivity.
      * right. assumption.
      * left. inversion H. reflexivity.
      * right. assumption.
    + unfold binds. simpl.
      rewrite IH. split; intros H.
      * right; assumption.
      * destruct H as [H|H]; auto. inversion H.
Qed.

Fixpoint ren_tt (f : atom -> atom) (T : typ) : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_nat => typ_nat
  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar X => typ_fvar (f X)
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (ren_tt f T1) (ren_tt f T2)
  | typ_mu T => typ_mu (ren_tt f T)
  end.

Lemma ren_tt_id : forall T, ren_tt (fun X => X) T = T.
Proof. induction T; simpl; congruence. Qed.

Lemma ren_tt_ext : forall f g T,
  (forall X, X \in fv_tt T -> f X = g X) ->
  ren_tt f T = ren_tt g T.
Proof.

  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - f_equal. apply H. simpl. fsetdec.

  - f_equal.
    + apply IHT1. intros X HX. apply H. simpl. fsetdec.
    + apply IHT2. intros X HX. apply H. simpl. fsetdec.

    + intros X HX. exact (proj1 (IH1 X HX)).
    + intros X HX. exact (proj1 (IH2 X HX)).
    + intros X HX. exact (proj2 (IH1 X HX)).
    + intros X HX. exact (proj2 (IH2 X HX)).
Qed.

(* ============== WF renames to wf_amber ============================ *)
Lemma wf_amber_ren : forall E A, WF E A ->
  forall (f : atom -> atom) (Ea : env_amber),
  wfe_amber Ea ->
  (forall X, binds X bind_sub E -> f X \in domA Ea) ->
  AtomSetImpl.Subset (fv_tt A) (bindsub_atoms E) ->
  wf_amber Ea (ren_tt f A).
Proof.
  intros E A H. induction H as
    [ E
    | E
    | X E Hb
    | E A1 A2 WF1 IH1 WF2 IH2
    | L E A0 p1 IH1 p2 IH2 ]; intros f Ea Hwe Hcorr Hfv.
  - apply wfa_top. exact Hwe.
  - apply wfa_nat. exact Hwe.
  - simpl. pose proof (Hcorr X Hb) as Hd.
    pose proof (domA_member Ea (f X) Hd) as [Y [HY|HY]].
    + exact (wfa_fvarl Ea (f X) Y HY Hwe).
    + exact (wfa_fvarr Ea Y (f X) HY Hwe).
  - simpl. apply wfa_arrow.
    + apply IH1; auto. intros z Hz. apply Hfv. simpl. fsetdec.
    + apply IH2; auto. intros z Hz. apply Hfv. simpl. fsetdec.
  - simpl.
    apply wfa_rec with (L := domA Ea).
    intros X Y HX HY.
    destruct (atom_fresh (L \u fv_tt A0)) as [Z HZ].
    assert (HZL : Z \notin L) by (fsetdec).
    assert (HZfv : Z \notin fv_tt A0) by (fsetdec).
    assert (Hwe' : wfe_amber ((X,Y)::Ea)).
    { apply wfea_cons. exact HX. fsetdec. exact Hwe. }
    set (f' := fun W => if W == Z then X else f W).
    assert (Hcorr' : forall W, binds W bind_sub (Z ~ bind_sub ++ E) -> f' W \in domA ((X,Y)::Ea)).
    { intros W HW. unfold f'. destruct (W == Z) as [Heq|Hneq].
      - subst W. apply in_domA_cons. left. reflexivity.
      - apply in_domA_cons. right. right. apply Hcorr. unfold binds in *.
        simpl in HW. destruct HW as [HW|HW].
        + inversion HW. subst. exfalso. apply Hneq. reflexivity.
        + exact HW. }
    assert (Hfv' : AtomSetImpl.Subset (fv_tt (open_tt A0 (typ_fvar Z))) (bindsub_atoms (Z ~ bind_sub ++ E))).
    { intros w Hw. pose proof (fv_tt_open A0 Z w Hw) as Hw2.
      apply union_iff in Hw2 as [Hw2|Hw2].
      - simpl. rewrite add_iff. right. apply Hfv. exact Hw2.
      - assert (w = Z) by fsetdec. subst w. simpl. rewrite add_iff. left. reflexivity. }
    pose proof (IH1 Z HZL f' ((X,Y)::Ea) Hwe' Hcorr' Hfv') as Hwf.
    assert (Hren : ren_tt f' (open_tt A0 (typ_fvar Z)) = open_tt (ren_tt f A0) (typ_fvar X)).
    { rewrite ren_tt_open. f_equal.
      - apply ren_tt_ext. intros W HW. unfold f'.
        destruct (W == Z) as [Heq|Hneq].
        + subst W. exfalso. apply HZfv. exact HW.
        + reflexivity.
      - unfold f'. rewrite eq_dec_refl. reflexivity. }
    rewrite Hren in Hwf. exact Hwf.
Qed.
(* ============== per-atom origin translation ======================= *)
Definition pick (o : atom -> bool) (f g : atom -> atom) : atom -> atom :=
  fun X => if o X then f X else g X.

Definition ren_pick (o : atom -> bool) (f g : atom -> atom) (T : typ) : typ :=
  ren_tt (pick o f g) T.

(* compatibility: for every matched atom occurrence, the origins must be
   (false,true) at negative polarity or (true,false) at positive polarity *)
Fixpoint compat (o1 o2 : atom -> bool) (pol : bool) (A B : typ) : Prop :=
  match A, B with
  | typ_fvar X, typ_fvar Y =>
      if X == Y then
        (if o1 X then (if o2 X then False else pol = true)
                   else (if o2 X then pol = false else False))
      else True
  | typ_arrow A1 A2, typ_arrow B1 B2 =>
      compat o1 o2 (negb pol) A1 B1 /\ compat o1 o2 pol A2 B2
  | typ_mu A1, typ_mu B1 => compat o1 o2 pol A1 B1
  | _,_ => True
  end.

Lemma compat_flip : forall A B o1 o2 pol,
  compat o1 o2 pol A B <-> compat o2 o1 (negb pol) B A.
Proof.
  induction A as [| |n|x|T IHT|A1 IHA1 A2 IHA2];
  intros B o1 o2 pol.
  - destruct B as [| |m|y|BT|B1 B2]; simpl; tauto.
  - destruct B as [| |m|y|BT|B1 B2]; simpl; tauto.
  - destruct B as [| |m|y|BT|B1 B2]; simpl; tauto.
  - destruct B as [| |m|y|BT|B1 B2]; simpl.
    + tauto. + tauto. + tauto.
    + destruct (x == y) as [Heq|Hneq].
      * subst y. rewrite !eq_dec_refl. simpl.
        destruct (o1 x); destruct (o2 x); destruct pol; simpl; try (split; intros H); try reflexivity; try (inversion H); try discriminate; tauto; tauto.
      * destruct (y == x) as [Heq|Hneq2].
        -- subst y. exfalso. apply Hneq. reflexivity.
        -- tauto.
    + tauto. + tauto.
  - (* A = mu T *) destruct B as [| |m|y|BT|B1 B2]; simpl.
    + tauto. + tauto. + tauto. + tauto.
    + apply IHT.
    + tauto.
  - (* A = arrow *) destruct B as [| |m|y|BT|B1 B2]; simpl.
    + tauto. + tauto. + tauto. + tauto. + tauto.
    + destruct (IHA1 B1 o1 o2 (negb pol)) as [Hl Hr].
      destruct (IHA2 B2 o1 o2 pol) as [Hl2 Hr2].
      split; intros [H1 H2]; split.
      * apply Hl. exact H1.
      * apply Hl2. exact H2.
      * apply Hr. exact H1.
      * apply Hr2. exact H2.
Qed.

Lemma compat_flip_false : forall A B o1 o2,
  compat o1 o2 false A B -> compat o2 o1 true B A.
Proof. intros A B o1 o2 H. apply compat_flip. exact H. Qed.


(* ============== opening injectivity =============================== *)

Lemma open_tt_rec_inj : forall T U K X,
  X \notin fv_tt T -> X \notin fv_tt U ->
  open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T = open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) U -> T = U.
Proof.
  induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2];
  intros U K X HT HU Heq;
  destruct U as [| |m|y|U0|U1 U2]; simpl in *;
  repeat match type of Heq with context [ if ?b then _ else _ ] => destruct b end;
  try discriminate; try reflexivity.
  - subst n. f_equal. exact e0.
  - inversion Heq. reflexivity.
  - exfalso. inversion Heq. subst y. apply HU. fsetdec.
  - exfalso. inversion Heq. subst x. apply HT. fsetdec.
  - inversion Heq. reflexivity.
  - injection Heq as Heq'. f_equal. apply IHT with (K:=S K) (X:=X).
    + exact HT.
    + exact HU.
    + exact Heq'.
  - injection Heq as E1 E2. f_equal.
    + apply IHT1 with (K:=K) (X:=X).
      * fsetdec. * fsetdec. * exact E1.
    + apply IHT2 with (K:=K) (X:=X).
      * fsetdec. * fsetdec. * exact E2.
Qed.

Lemma sub_antisym : forall E A B, sub E A B -> sub E B A -> A = B.
Proof.
  intros E A B H1. induction H1 as
    [ E0 wfE
    | E0 X wfE Hb
    | E0 A0 wfE WFA
    | E0 A1 A2 B1 B2 s1 IH1 s2 IH2
    | L A1 A2 E0 p1 IH1 p2 IH2 ]; intros H2.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - inversion H2. reflexivity.
  - inversion H2. pose proof (IH1 H4) as E1a. pose proof (IH2 H6) as E2a.
    subst. reflexivity.
  - inversion H2.
    destruct (atom_fresh (L \u L0 \u fv_tt A1 \u fv_tt A2)) as [X HX].
    assert (HXL : X \notin L) by fsetdec.
    assert (HXL0 : X \notin L0) by fsetdec.
    assert (HX1 : X \notin fv_tt A1) by fsetdec.
    assert (HX2 : X \notin fv_tt A2) by fsetdec.
    pose proof (IH1 X HXL (H3 X HXL0)) as Heq.
    assert (A1 = A2).
    { apply (open_tt_rec_inj A1 A2 0 X).
      - exact HX1.
      - exact HX2.
      - unfold open_tt in Heq. exact Heq. }
    subst. reflexivity.
Qed.

Theorem amber_complete: forall  A B,
    sub nil A B ->
    sub_amber nil (amber_cov nil nil A Neg) (amber_cov nil nil B Pos) .

Require Import AmberBase.
Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.
Require Import Program.Equality.
Require Import Lia.

Definition env_mode := list ( Mode).

Definition eqMode (a b: Mode)  : bool :=
  match a,b with
  | Pos, Pos => true
  | Neg, Neg => true
  | _,_ => false
  end.

Fixpoint amber_cov (Ea : env_amber) (Em : env_mode) (T:typ) (m:Mode) : typ :=
  match Ea, Em with
  | (X,Y)::E, m'::Em' => if (eqMode m' m) then amber_cov E Em' (subst_tt X Y T) m
                         else amber_cov E Em' T m
  | _,_ => T
  end.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Auxiliary definitions                                              *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint bindsub_atoms (E : env) : atoms :=
  match E with
  | nil => empty
  | (X, bind_sub) :: E' => add X (bindsub_atoms E')
  | (_, bind_typ _) :: E' => bindsub_atoms E'
  end.

Lemma in_bindsub_atoms : forall E X,
  X \in bindsub_atoms E <-> binds X bind_sub E.
Proof.
  induction E as [| [Y b] E IH]; intros X; simpl.
  - unfold binds. simpl. split; intros H.
    + fsetdec.
    + contradiction.
  - destruct b; simpl.
    + unfold binds. simpl.
      rewrite add_iff. rewrite IH.
      split; intros [H|H].
      * left. inversion H. reflexivity.
      * right. assumption.
      * left. inversion H. reflexivity.
      * right. assumption.
    + unfold binds. simpl.
      rewrite IH. split; intros H.
      * right; assumption.
      * destruct H as [H|H]; auto. inversion H.
Qed.

Fixpoint ren_tt (f : atom -> atom) (T : typ) : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_nat => typ_nat
  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar X => typ_fvar (f X)
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (ren_tt f T1) (ren_tt f T2)
  | typ_mu T => typ_mu (ren_tt f T)
  end.

Lemma ren_tt_id : forall T, ren_tt (fun X => X) T = T.
Proof. induction T; simpl; congruence. Qed.

Lemma ren_tt_ext : forall f g T,
  (forall X, X \in fv_tt T -> f X = g X) ->
  ren_tt f T = ren_tt g T.
Proof.
  intros f g T; induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; simpl; intros H.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - f_equal. apply H. simpl. fsetdec.
  - f_equal. apply IHT. intros X HX. apply H. simpl. exact HX.
  - f_equal.
    + apply IHT1. intros X HX. apply H. simpl. fsetdec.
    + apply IHT2. intros X HX. apply H. simpl. fsetdec.
Qed.

Lemma ren_tt_open_rec : forall f T K X,
  ren_tt f (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T) =
  open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar (f X)) (ren_tt f T).
Proof.
  intros f T; induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros K X; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (K === n); reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHT. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHT1, IHT2. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ren_tt_open : forall f T X,
  ren_tt f (open_tt T (typ_fvar X)) = open_tt (ren_tt f T) (typ_fvar (f X)).
Proof. intros. unfold open_tt. apply ren_tt_open_rec. Qed.

(* locally closed types *)
Fixpoint lc_rec (d : nat) (T : typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_nat => True
  | typ_bvar J => J < d
  | typ_fvar X => True
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => lc_rec d T1 /\ lc_rec d T2
  | typ_mu T => lc_rec (S d) T
  end.

Definition lc_tt T := lc_rec 0 T.

Lemma lc_open_rec : forall T K X d,
  lc_rec d T -> lc_rec d (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T).
Proof.
  induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros K X d H; simpl in *.
  - exact I.
  - exact I.
  - destruct (K === n).
    + simpl. exact I.
    + simpl. exact H.
  - simpl. exact I.
  - simpl. exact (IHT (S K) X (S d) H).
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. simpl. split.
    + exact (IHT1 K X d H1).
    + exact (IHT2 K X d H2).
Qed.

Lemma lc_open_mu_body : forall T d X,
  lc_rec (S d) T -> lc_rec d (open_tt_rec d (typ_fvar X) T).
Proof.
  induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros d X' H; simpl in *.
  - exact I.
  - exact I.
  - (* bvar *) destruct (d === n).
    + simpl. exact I.
    + simpl. unfold lt in *. lia.
  - exact I.
  - apply IHT. exact H.
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. split.
    + exact (IHT1 d X' H1).
    + exact (IHT2 d X' H2).
Qed.



Lemma lc_open_rec_any : forall T K X, lc_rec K T -> lc_rec K (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T).
Proof.
  induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros K X' H; simpl in *.
  - exact I.
  - exact I.
  - destruct (K === n).
    + simpl. exact I.
    + exact H.
  - exact I.
  - apply IHT. exact H.
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. split.
    + exact (IHT1 K X' H1).
    + exact (IHT2 K X' H2).
Qed.

Lemma lc_open_tt : forall T X, lc_tt T -> lc_tt (open_tt T (typ_fvar X)).
Proof.
  intros T X H. unfold lc_tt, open_tt.
  exact (lc_open_rec_any T 0 X H).
Qed.

(* fv of open *)
Lemma fv_tt_open_rec : forall T K X,
  AtomSetImpl.Subset (fv_tt (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T)) (union (fv_tt T) {{X}}).
Proof.
  induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros K X'; simpl.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - destruct (K === n); simpl; intros z Hz; fsetdec.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - simpl. intros z Hz. exact (IHT (S K) X' z Hz).
  - simpl. intros z Hz. apply union_iff in Hz as [Hz|Hz].
    + pose proof (IHT1 K X' _ Hz). fsetdec.
    + pose proof (IHT2 K X' _ Hz). fsetdec.
Qed.

Lemma fv_tt_open : forall T X,
  AtomSetImpl.Subset (fv_tt (open_tt T (typ_fvar X))) (union (fv_tt T) {{X}}).
Proof. intros. unfold open_tt. apply fv_tt_open_rec. Qed.

Lemma fv_tt_open_upper_rec : forall T K X,
  AtomSetImpl.Subset (fv_tt T) (fv_tt (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T)).
Proof.
  induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros K X'; simpl.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - intros z Hz. exact (IHT (S K) X' z Hz).
  - intros z Hz. apply union_iff in Hz as [Hz|Hz].
    + pose proof (IHT1 K X' z Hz). fsetdec.
    + pose proof (IHT2 K X' z Hz). fsetdec.
Qed.

Lemma fv_tt_open_upper : forall T X,
  AtomSetImpl.Subset (fv_tt T) (fv_tt (open_tt T (typ_fvar X))).
Proof. intros. unfold open_tt. apply fv_tt_open_upper_rec. Qed.

(* ===================== domA lemmas ================================= *)
Lemma in_domA_cons : forall X Y E z,
  z \in domA ((X,Y)::E) <-> z = X \/ z = Y \/ z \in domA E.
Proof.
  intros. simpl. split; intros H; fsetdec.
Qed.

Lemma in_domA_pair_1 : forall E X Y, In (X,Y) E -> X \in domA E.
Proof.
  induction E as [| [a b] E IH]; intros X Y Hin; simpl in *.
  - contradiction.
  - destruct Hin as [Hin|Hin].
    + inversion Hin; subst. apply in_domA_cons. left. reflexivity.
    + apply in_domA_cons. right. right. exact (IH X Y Hin).
Qed.

Lemma in_domA_pair_2 : forall E X Y, In (X,Y) E -> Y \in domA E.
Proof.
  induction E as [| [a b] E IH]; intros X Y Hin; simpl in *.
  - contradiction.
  - destruct Hin as [Hin|Hin].
    + inversion Hin; subst. apply in_domA_cons. right. left. reflexivity.
    + apply in_domA_cons. right. right. exact (IH X Y Hin).
Qed.

Lemma domA_member : forall E X,
  X \in domA E -> exists Y, In (X,Y) E \/ In (Y,X) E.
Proof.
  induction E as [| [a b] E IH]; intros X H; simpl in *.
  - fsetdec.
  - apply in_domA_cons in H. destruct H as [H|[H|H]].
    + subst. exists b. left. left. reflexivity.
    + subst. exists a. right. left. reflexivity.
    + apply IH in H. destruct H as [Y [HY|HY]].
      * exists Y. left. right. exact HY.
      * exists Y. right. right. exact HY.
Qed.

(* ===================== wf_amber from lc and fv ==================== *)


(* ============== sub implies WF on both sides ====================== *)
Lemma sub_wf : forall E A B, sub E A B -> WF E A /\ WF E B.
Proof.
  intros E A B H.
  induction H as
    [ E wfE
    | E X wfE Hb
    | E A0 wfE WFA
    | E A1 A2 B1 B2 s1 IH1 s2 IH2
    | L A1 A2 E p1 IH1 p2 IH2 ].
  - split; apply WF_nat.
  - split; apply WF_fvar; exact Hb.
  - split; [ exact WFA | apply WF_top ].
  - split; apply WF_arrow.
    + exact (proj2 IH1).
    + exact (proj1 IH2).
    + exact (proj1 IH1).
    + exact (proj2 IH2).
  - split; apply WF_rec with (L:=L).
    + intros X HX. exact (proj1 (IH1 X HX)).
    + intros X HX. exact (proj1 (IH2 X HX)).
    + intros X HX. exact (proj2 (IH1 X HX)).
    + intros X HX. exact (proj2 (IH2 X HX)).
Qed.

(* ============== WF renames to wf_amber ============================ *)
Lemma wf_amber_ren : forall E A, WF E A ->
  forall (f : atom -> atom) (Ea : env_amber),
  wfe_amber Ea ->
  (forall X, binds X bind_sub E -> f X \in domA Ea) ->
  AtomSetImpl.Subset (fv_tt A) (bindsub_atoms E) ->
  wf_amber Ea (ren_tt f A).
Proof.
  intros E A H. induction H as

(* compatibility: for every matched atom occurrence, the origins must be
   (false,true) at negative polarity or (true,false) at positive polarity *)
Fixpoint compat (o1 o2 : atom -> bool) (pol : bool) (A B : typ) : Prop :=
  match A, B with
  | typ_fvar X, typ_fvar Y =>
      if X == Y then
        (if o1 X then (if o2 X then False else pol = true)
                   else (if o2 X then pol = false else False))
      else True
  | typ_arrow A1 A2, typ_arrow B1 B2 =>
      compat o1 o2 (negb pol) A1 B1 /\ compat o1 o2 pol A2 B2
  | typ_mu A1, typ_mu B1 => compat o1 o2 pol A1 B1
  | _,_ => True
  end.

Lemma compat_flip : forall A B o1 o2 pol,
  compat o1 o2 pol A B <-> compat o2 o1 (negb pol) B A.
Proof.
  induction A as [| |n|x|T IHT|A1 IHA1 A2 IHA2];
  intros B o1 o2 pol.

  - destruct B as [| |m|y|BT|B1 B2]; simpl; tauto.
  - destruct B as [| |m|y|BT|B1 B2]; simpl; tauto.
  - destruct B as [| |m|y|BT|B1 B2]; simpl.
    + tauto. + tauto. + tauto.
    + destruct (x == y) as [Heq|Hneq].
      * subst y. rewrite !eq_dec_refl. simpl.
        destruct (o1 x); destruct (o2 x); destruct pol; simpl; try (split; intros H); try reflexivity; try (inversion H); try discriminate; tauto; tauto.
      * destruct (y == x) as [Heq|Hneq2].
        -- subst y. exfalso. apply Hneq. reflexivity.
        -- tauto.
    + tauto. + tauto.
  - (* A = mu T *) destruct B as [| |m|y|BT|B1 B2]; simpl.
    + tauto. + tauto. + tauto. + tauto.
    + apply IHT.
    + tauto.
  - (* A = arrow *) destruct B as [| |m|y|BT|B1 B2]; simpl.
    + tauto. + tauto. + tauto. + tauto. + tauto.
    + destruct (IHA1 B1 o1 o2 (negb pol)) as [Hl Hr].

      * apply Hl. exact H1.
      * apply Hl2. exact H2.
      * apply Hr. exact H1.
      * apply Hr2. exact H2.
Qed.

  compat o1 o2 false A B -> compat o2 o1 true B A.
Proof. intros A B o1 o2 H. apply compat_flip. exact H. Qed.

Require Import AmberBase.
Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.
Require Import Program.Equality.
Require Import Lia.

Definition env_mode := list ( Mode).

Definition eqMode (a b: Mode)  : bool :=
  match a,b with
  | Pos, Pos => true
  | Neg, Neg => true
  | _,_ => false
  end.

Fixpoint amber_cov (Ea : env_amber) (Em : env_mode) (T:typ) (m:Mode) : typ :=
  match Ea, Em with
  | (X,Y)::E, m'::Em' => if (eqMode m' m) then amber_cov E Em' (subst_tt X Y T) m
                         else amber_cov E Em' T m
  | _,_ => T
  end.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Auxiliary definitions                                              *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint bindsub_atoms (E : env) : atoms :=
  match E with
  | nil => empty
  | (X, bind_sub) :: E' => add X (bindsub_atoms E')
  | (_, bind_typ _) :: E' => bindsub_atoms E'
  end.

Lemma in_bindsub_atoms : forall E X,
  X \in bindsub_atoms E <-> binds X bind_sub E.
Proof.
  induction E as [| [Y b] E IH]; intros X; simpl.
  - unfold binds. simpl. split; intros H.
    + fsetdec.
    + contradiction.
  - destruct b; simpl.
    + unfold binds. simpl.
      rewrite add_iff. rewrite IH.
      split; intros [H|H].
      * left. inversion H. reflexivity.
      * right. assumption.
      * left. inversion H. reflexivity.
      * right. assumption.
    + unfold binds. simpl.
      rewrite IH. split; intros H.
      * right; assumption.
      * destruct H as [H|H]; auto. inversion H.
Qed.

Fixpoint ren_tt (f : atom -> atom) (T : typ) : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_nat => typ_nat
  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar X => typ_fvar (f X)
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (ren_tt f T1) (ren_tt f T2)
  | typ_mu T => typ_mu (ren_tt f T)
  end.

Lemma ren_tt_id : forall T, ren_tt (fun X => X) T = T.
Proof. induction T; simpl; congruence. Qed.

Lemma ren_tt_ext : forall f g T,
  (forall X, X \in fv_tt T -> f X = g X) ->
  ren_tt f T = ren_tt g T.
Proof.
  intros f g T; induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; simpl; intros H.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - f_equal. apply H. simpl. fsetdec.
  - f_equal. apply IHT. intros X HX. apply H. simpl. exact HX.
  - f_equal.
    + apply IHT1. intros X HX. apply H. simpl. fsetdec.
    + apply IHT2. intros X HX. apply H. simpl. fsetdec.
Qed.

Lemma ren_tt_open_rec : forall f T K X,
  ren_tt f (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T) =
  open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar (f X)) (ren_tt f T).
Proof.
  intros f T; induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros K X; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (K === n); reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHT. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHT1, IHT2. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ren_tt_open : forall f T X,
  ren_tt f (open_tt T (typ_fvar X)) = open_tt (ren_tt f T) (typ_fvar (f X)).
Proof. intros. unfold open_tt. apply ren_tt_open_rec. Qed.

(* locally closed types *)
Fixpoint lc_rec (d : nat) (T : typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_nat => True
  | typ_bvar J => J < d
  | typ_fvar X => True
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => lc_rec d T1 /\ lc_rec d T2
  | typ_mu T => lc_rec (S d) T
  end.

Definition lc_tt T := lc_rec 0 T.

Lemma lc_open_rec : forall T K X d,
  lc_rec d T -> lc_rec d (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T).
Proof.
  induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros K X d H; simpl in *.
  - exact I.
  - exact I.
  - destruct (K === n).
    + simpl. exact I.
    + simpl. exact H.
  - simpl. exact I.
  - simpl. exact (IHT (S K) X (S d) H).
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. simpl. split.
    + exact (IHT1 K X d H1).
    + exact (IHT2 K X d H2).

Lemma in_domA_cons : forall X Y E z,
  z \in domA ((X,Y)::E) <-> z = X \/ z = Y \/ z \in domA E.
Proof.
  intros. simpl. split; intros H; fsetdec.

Lemma in_domA_pair_1 : forall E X Y, In (X,Y) E -> X \in domA E.
Proof.
  induction E as [| [a b] E IH]; intros X Y Hin; simpl in *.
  - contradiction.
  - destruct Hin as [Hin|Hin].
    + inversion Hin; subst. apply in_domA_cons. left. reflexivity.
    + apply in_domA_cons. right. right. exact (IH X Y Hin).
Qed.

Lemma in_domA_pair_2 : forall E X Y, In (X,Y) E -> Y \in domA E.
Proof.
  induction E as [| [a b] E IH]; intros X Y Hin; simpl in *.
  - contradiction.
  - destruct Hin as [Hin|Hin].
    + inversion Hin; subst. apply in_domA_cons. right. left. reflexivity.
    + apply in_domA_cons. right. right. exact (IH X Y Hin).
Qed.

Lemma domA_member : forall E X,
  X \in domA E -> exists Y, In (X,Y) E \/ In (Y,X) E.
Proof.

  - fsetdec.
  - apply in_domA_cons in H. destruct H as [H|[H|H]].

    + subst. exists a. right. left. reflexivity.

Lemma sub_wf : forall E A B, sub E A B -> WF E A /\ WF E B.
Proof.
  intros E A B H.
  induction H as
    [ E wfE
    | E X wfE Hb
    | E A0 wfE WFA
    | E A1 A2 B1 B2 s1 IH1 s2 IH2
    | L A1 A2 E p1 IH1 p2 IH2 ].
  - split; apply WF_nat.
  - split; apply WF_fvar; exact Hb.
  - split; [ exact WFA | apply WF_top ].
  - split; apply WF_arrow.
    + exact (proj2 IH1).
    + exact (proj1 IH2).
    + exact (proj1 IH1).
    + exact (proj2 IH2).
  - split; apply WF_rec with (L:=L).
    + intros X HX. exact (proj1 (IH1 X HX)).
    + intros X HX. exact (proj1 (IH2 X HX)).
    + intros X HX. exact (proj2 (IH1 X HX)).
    + intros X HX. exact (proj2 (IH2 X HX)).

  - apply wfa_nat. exact Hwe.

      - subst W. apply in_domA_cons. left. reflexivity.

(* ============== per-atom origin translation ======================= *)
Definition pick (o : atom -> bool) (f g : atom -> atom) : atom -> atom :=
  fun X => if o X then f X else g X.

Definition ren_pick (o : atom -> bool) (f g : atom -> atom) (T : typ) : typ :=
  ren_tt (pick o f g) T.

(* compatibility: for every matched atom occurrence, the origins must be
   (false,true) at negative polarity or (true,false) at positive polarity *)
Fixpoint compat (o1 o2 : atom -> bool) (pol : bool) (A B : typ) : Prop :=
  match A, B with
  | typ_fvar X, typ_fvar Y =>
      if X == Y then
        (if o1 X then (if o2 X then False else pol = true)
                   else (if o2 X then pol = false else False))
      else True
  | typ_arrow A1 A2, typ_arrow B1 B2 =>
      compat o1 o2 (negb pol) A1 B1 /\ compat o1 o2 pol A2 B2
  | typ_mu A1, typ_mu B1 => compat o1 o2 pol A1 B1
  | _,_ => True
  end.

Lemma compat_flip : forall A B o1 o2 pol,
  compat o1 o2 pol A B <-> compat o2 o1 (negb pol) B A.
Proof.

  - destruct B as [| |m|y|BT|B1 B2]; simpl; tauto.
  - destruct B as [| |m|y|BT|B1 B2]; simpl; tauto.
  - destruct B as [| |m|y|BT|B1 B2]; simpl; tauto.
  - destruct B as [| |m|y|BT|B1 B2]; simpl.
    + tauto. + tauto. + tauto.
    + destruct (x == y) as [Heq|Hneq].
      * subst y. rewrite !eq_dec_refl. simpl.
        destruct (o1 x); destruct (o2 x); destruct pol; simpl; try (split; intros H); try reflexivity; try (inversion H); try discriminate; tauto; tauto.
      * destruct (y == x) as [Heq|Hneq2].
        -- subst y. exfalso. apply Hneq. reflexivity.
        -- tauto.
    + tauto. + tauto.
  - (* A = mu T *) destruct B as [| |m|y|BT|B1 B2]; simpl.
    + tauto. + tauto. + tauto. + tauto.
    + apply IHT.
    + tauto.
  - (* A = arrow *) destruct B as [| |m|y|BT|B1 B2]; simpl.
    + tauto. + tauto. + tauto. + tauto. + tauto.
    + destruct (IHA1 B1 o1 o2 (negb pol)) as [Hl Hr].

      split; intros [H1 H2]; split.
      * apply Hl. exact H1.
      * apply Hl2. exact H2.
      * apply Hr. exact H1.
      * apply Hr2. exact H2.
Qed.

  compat o1 o2 false A B -> compat o2 o1 true B A.

Definition eqMode (a b: Mode)  : bool :=

Fixpoint bindsub_atoms (E : env) : atoms :=
  match E with
  | nil => empty
  | (X, bind_sub) :: E' => add X (bindsub_atoms E')
  | (_, bind_typ _) :: E' => bindsub_atoms E'
  end.

Lemma in_bindsub_atoms : forall E X,
  X \in bindsub_atoms E <-> binds X bind_sub E.
Proof.
  induction E as [| [Y b] E IH]; intros X; simpl.
  - unfold binds. simpl. split; intros H.
    + fsetdec.
    + contradiction.
  - destruct b; simpl.
    + unfold binds. simpl.
      rewrite add_iff. rewrite IH.
      split; intros [H|H].
      * left. inversion H. reflexivity.
      * right. assumption.
      * left. inversion H. reflexivity.
      * right. assumption.
    + unfold binds. simpl.
      rewrite IH. split; intros H.
      * right; assumption.
      * destruct H as [H|H]; auto. inversion H.
Qed.

Fixpoint ren_tt (f : atom -> atom) (T : typ) : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_nat => typ_nat
  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar X => typ_fvar (f X)
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (ren_tt f T1) (ren_tt f T2)
  | typ_mu T => typ_mu (ren_tt f T)
  end.

Lemma ren_tt_id : forall T, ren_tt (fun X => X) T = T.
Proof. induction T; simpl; congruence. Qed.

Lemma ren_tt_ext : forall f g T,
  (forall X, X \in fv_tt T -> f X = g X) ->
  ren_tt f T = ren_tt g T.
Proof.
  intros f g T; induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; simpl; intros H.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - f_equal. apply H. simpl. fsetdec.
  - f_equal. apply IHT. intros X HX. apply H. simpl. exact HX.
  - f_equal.
    + apply IHT1. intros X HX. apply H. simpl. fsetdec.
    + apply IHT2. intros X HX. apply H. simpl. fsetdec.
Qed.

Lemma ren_tt_open_rec : forall f T K X,
  ren_tt f (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T) =
  open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar (f X)) (ren_tt f T).
Proof.
  intros f T; induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros K X; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (K === n); reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHT. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHT1, IHT2. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ren_tt_open : forall f T X,
  ren_tt f (open_tt T (typ_fvar X)) = open_tt (ren_tt f T) (typ_fvar (f X)).
Proof. intros. unfold open_tt. apply ren_tt_open_rec. Qed.

(* locally closed types *)
Fixpoint lc_rec (d : nat) (T : typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_nat => True
  | typ_bvar J => J < d
  | typ_fvar X => True
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => lc_rec d T1 /\ lc_rec d T2
  | typ_mu T => lc_rec (S d) T
  end.

Definition lc_tt T := lc_rec 0 T.

Lemma lc_open_rec : forall T K X d,
  lc_rec d T -> lc_rec d (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T).
Proof.
  induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros K X d H; simpl in *.
  - exact I.
  - exact I.
  - destruct (K === n).
    + simpl. exact I.
    + simpl. exact H.
  - simpl. exact I.
  - simpl. exact (IHT (S K) X (S d) H).
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. simpl. split.
    + exact (IHT1 K X d H1).
    + exact (IHT2 K X d H2).
Qed.

Lemma lc_open_mu_body : forall T d X,
  lc_rec (S d) T -> lc_rec d (open_tt_rec d (typ_fvar X) T).
Proof.
  induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros d X' H; simpl in *.
  - exact I.
  - exact I.
  - (* bvar *) destruct (d === n).
    + simpl. exact I.
    + simpl. unfold lt in *. lia.
  - exact I.
  - apply IHT. exact H.
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. split.
    + exact (IHT1 d X' H1).
    + exact (IHT2 d X' H2).
Qed.



Lemma lc_open_rec_any : forall T K X, lc_rec K T -> lc_rec K (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T).
Proof.
  induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros K X' H; simpl in *.
  - exact I.
  - exact I.
  - destruct (K === n).
    + simpl. exact I.
    + exact H.
  - exact I.
  - apply IHT. exact H.
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. split.
    + exact (IHT1 K X' H1).
    + exact (IHT2 K X' H2).
Qed.

Lemma lc_open_tt : forall T X, lc_tt T -> lc_tt (open_tt T (typ_fvar X)).
Proof.
  intros T X H. unfold lc_tt, open_tt.
  exact (lc_open_rec_any T 0 X H).
Qed.

(* fv of open *)
Lemma fv_tt_open_rec : forall T K X,
  AtomSetImpl.Subset (fv_tt (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T)) (union (fv_tt T) {{X}}).
Proof.
  induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros K X'; simpl.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - destruct (K === n); simpl; intros z Hz; fsetdec.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - simpl. intros z Hz. exact (IHT (S K) X' z Hz).
  - simpl. intros z Hz. apply union_iff in Hz as [Hz|Hz].
    + pose proof (IHT1 K X' _ Hz). fsetdec.
    + pose proof (IHT2 K X' _ Hz). fsetdec.
Qed.

Lemma fv_tt_open : forall T X,
  AtomSetImpl.Subset (fv_tt (open_tt T (typ_fvar X))) (union (fv_tt T) {{X}}).
Proof. intros. unfold open_tt. apply fv_tt_open_rec. Qed.

Lemma fv_tt_open_upper_rec : forall T K X,
  AtomSetImpl.Subset (fv_tt T) (fv_tt (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T)).
Proof.
  induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros K X'; simpl.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - intros z Hz. exact (IHT (S K) X' z Hz).
  - intros z Hz. apply union_iff in Hz as [Hz|Hz].
    + pose proof (IHT1 K X' z Hz). fsetdec.
    + pose proof (IHT2 K X' z Hz). fsetdec.

Lemma fv_tt_open_upper : forall T X,
  AtomSetImpl.Subset (fv_tt T) (fv_tt (open_tt T (typ_fvar X))).
Proof. intros. unfold open_tt. apply fv_tt_open_upper_rec. Qed.

(* ===================== domA lemmas ================================= *)
Lemma in_domA_cons : forall X Y E z,
  z \in domA ((X,Y)::E) <-> z = X \/ z = Y \/ z \in domA E.
Proof.
  intros. simpl. split; intros H; fsetdec.
Qed.

Lemma in_domA_pair_1 : forall E X Y, In (X,Y) E -> X \in domA E.
Proof.
  induction E as [| [a b] E IH]; intros X Y Hin; simpl in *.
  - contradiction.
  - destruct Hin as [Hin|Hin].
    + inversion Hin; subst. apply in_domA_cons. left. reflexivity.
    + apply in_domA_cons. right. right. exact (IH X Y Hin).
Qed.

Lemma in_domA_pair_2 : forall E X Y, In (X,Y) E -> Y \in domA E.
Proof.
  induction E as [| [a b] E IH]; intros X Y Hin; simpl in *.
  - contradiction.
  - destruct Hin as [Hin|Hin].
    + inversion Hin; subst. apply in_domA_cons. right. left. reflexivity.
    + apply in_domA_cons. right. right. exact (IH X Y Hin).
Qed.

Lemma domA_member : forall E X,
  X \in domA E -> exists Y, In (X,Y) E \/ In (Y,X) E.
Proof.
  induction E as [| [a b] E IH]; intros X H; simpl in *.
  - fsetdec.
  - apply in_domA_cons in H. destruct H as [H|[H|H]].
    + subst. exists b. left. left. reflexivity.
    + subst. exists a. right. left. reflexivity.
    + apply IH in H. destruct H as [Y [HY|HY]].
      * exists Y. left. right. exact HY.
      * exists Y. right. right. exact HY.
Qed.
