Require Import AmberBase.
Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.
Require Import Program.Equality.
Require Import Lia.

Definition env_mode := list ( Mode).

Definition eqMode (a b: Mode)  : bool :=
  match a,b with
  | Pos, Pos => true
  | Neg, Neg => true
  | _,_ => false
  end.

Fixpoint amber_cov (Ea : env_amber) (Em : env_mode) (T:typ) (m:Mode) : typ :=
  match Ea, Em with
  | (X,Y)::E, m'::Em' => if (eqMode m' m) then amber_cov E Em' (subst_tt X Y T) m
                         else amber_cov E Em' T m
  | _,_ => T
  end.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Auxiliary definitions                                              *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint bindsub_atoms (E : env) : atoms :=
  match E with
  | nil => empty
  | (X, bind_sub) :: E' => add X (bindsub_atoms E')
  | (_, bind_typ _) :: E' => bindsub_atoms E'
  end.

Lemma in_bindsub_atoms : forall E X,
  X \in bindsub_atoms E <-> binds X bind_sub E.
Proof.
  induction E as [| [Y b] E IH]; intros X; simpl.
  - unfold binds. simpl. split; intros H.
    + fsetdec.
    + contradiction.
  - destruct b; simpl.
    + unfold binds. simpl.
      rewrite add_iff. rewrite IH.
      split; intros [H|H].
      * left. inversion H. reflexivity.
      * right. assumption.
      * left. inversion H. reflexivity.
      * right. assumption.
    + unfold binds. simpl.
      rewrite IH. split; intros H.
      * right; assumption.
      * destruct H as [H|H]; auto. inversion H.
Qed.

Fixpoint ren_tt (f : atom -> atom) (T : typ) : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_nat => typ_nat
  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar X => typ_fvar (f X)
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (ren_tt f T1) (ren_tt f T2)
  | typ_mu T => typ_mu (ren_tt f T)
  end.

Lemma ren_tt_id : forall T, ren_tt (fun X => X) T = T.
Proof. induction T; simpl; congruence. Qed.

Lemma ren_tt_ext : forall f g T,
  (forall X, X \in fv_tt T -> f X = g X) ->
  ren_tt f T = ren_tt g T.
Proof.
  intros f g T; induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; simpl; intros H.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - f_equal. apply H. simpl. fsetdec.
  - f_equal. apply IHT. intros X HX. apply H. simpl. exact HX.
  - f_equal.
    + apply IHT1. intros X HX. apply H. simpl. fsetdec.
    + apply IHT2. intros X HX. apply H. simpl. fsetdec.
Qed.

Lemma ren_tt_ren : forall f g T,
  ren_tt f (ren_tt g T) = ren_tt (fun X => f (g X)) T.
Proof.
  intros f g T; induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IH1 T2 IH2]; simpl; try reflexivity.
  - f_equal. exact IHT.
  - f_equal; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma ren_tt_open_rec : forall f T K X,
  ren_tt f (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T) =
  open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar (f X)) (ren_tt f T).
Proof.
  intros f T; induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros K X; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (K === n); reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHT. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHT1, IHT2. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ren_tt_open : forall f T X,
  ren_tt f (open_tt T (typ_fvar X)) = open_tt (ren_tt f T) (typ_fvar (f X)).
Proof. intros. unfold open_tt. apply ren_tt_open_rec. Qed.

(* locally closed types *)
Fixpoint lc_rec (d : nat) (T : typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_nat => True
  | typ_bvar J => J < d
  | typ_fvar X => True
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => lc_rec d T1 /\ lc_rec d T2
  | typ_mu T => lc_rec (S d) T
  end.

Definition lc_tt T := lc_rec 0 T.

Lemma lc_open_rec : forall T K X d,
  lc_rec d T -> lc_rec d (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T).
Proof.
  induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros K X d H; simpl in *.
  - exact I.
  - exact I.
  - destruct (K === n).
    + simpl. exact I.
    + simpl. exact H.
  - simpl. exact I.
  - simpl. exact (IHT (S K) X (S d) H).
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. simpl. split.
    + exact (IHT1 K X d H1).
    + exact (IHT2 K X d H2).
Qed.

Lemma lc_open_mu_body : forall T d X,
  lc_rec (S d) T -> lc_rec d (open_tt_rec d (typ_fvar X) T).
Proof.
  induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros d X' H; simpl in *.
  - exact I.
  - exact I.
  - (* bvar *) destruct (d === n).
    + simpl. exact I.
    + simpl. unfold lt in *. lia.
  - exact I.
  - apply IHT. exact H.
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. split.
    + exact (IHT1 d X' H1).
    + exact (IHT2 d X' H2).
Qed.



Lemma lc_open_rec_any : forall T K X, lc_rec K T -> lc_rec K (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T).
Proof.
  induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros K X' H; simpl in *.
  - exact I.
  - exact I.
  - destruct (K === n).
    + simpl. exact I.
    + exact H.
  - exact I.
  - apply IHT. exact H.
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. split.
    + exact (IHT1 K X' H1).
    + exact (IHT2 K X' H2).
Qed.

Lemma lc_open_tt : forall T X, lc_tt T -> lc_tt (open_tt T (typ_fvar X)).
Proof.
  intros T X H. unfold lc_tt, open_tt.
  exact (lc_open_rec_any T 0 X H).
Qed.

(* fv of open *)
Lemma fv_tt_open_rec : forall T K X,
  AtomSetImpl.Subset (fv_tt (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T)) (union (fv_tt T) {{X}}).
Proof.
  induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros K X'; simpl.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - destruct (K === n); simpl; intros z Hz; fsetdec.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - simpl. intros z Hz. exact (IHT (S K) X' z Hz).
  - simpl. intros z Hz. apply union_iff in Hz as [Hz|Hz].
    + pose proof (IHT1 K X' _ Hz). fsetdec.
    + pose proof (IHT2 K X' _ Hz). fsetdec.
Qed.

Lemma fv_tt_open : forall T X,
  AtomSetImpl.Subset (fv_tt (open_tt T (typ_fvar X))) (union (fv_tt T) {{X}}).
Proof. intros. unfold open_tt. apply fv_tt_open_rec. Qed.

Lemma fv_tt_open_upper_rec : forall T K X,
  AtomSetImpl.Subset (fv_tt T) (fv_tt (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T)).
Proof.
  induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros K X'; simpl.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - intros z Hz. exact (IHT (S K) X' z Hz).
  - intros z Hz. apply union_iff in Hz as [Hz|Hz].
    + pose proof (IHT1 K X' z Hz). fsetdec.
    + pose proof (IHT2 K X' z Hz). fsetdec.
Qed.

Lemma fv_tt_open_upper : forall T X,
  AtomSetImpl.Subset (fv_tt T) (fv_tt (open_tt T (typ_fvar X))).
Proof. intros. unfold open_tt. apply fv_tt_open_upper_rec. Qed.

(* ===================== domA lemmas ================================= *)
Lemma in_domA_cons : forall X Y E z,
  z \in domA ((X,Y)::E) <-> z = X \/ z = Y \/ z \in domA E.
Proof.
  intros. simpl. split; intros H; fsetdec.
Qed.

Lemma in_domA_pair_1 : forall E X Y, In (X,Y) E -> X \in domA E.
Proof.
  induction E as [| [a b] E IH]; intros X Y Hin; simpl in *.
  - contradiction.
  - destruct Hin as [Hin|Hin].
    + inversion Hin; subst. apply in_domA_cons. left. reflexivity.
    + apply in_domA_cons. right. right. exact (IH X Y Hin).
Qed.

Lemma in_domA_pair_2 : forall E X Y, In (X,Y) E -> Y \in domA E.
Proof.
  induction E as [| [a b] E IH]; intros X Y Hin; simpl in *.
  - contradiction.
  - destruct Hin as [Hin|Hin].
    + inversion Hin; subst. apply in_domA_cons. right. left. reflexivity.
    + apply in_domA_cons. right. right. exact (IH X Y Hin).
Qed.

Lemma domA_member : forall E X,
  X \in domA E -> exists Y, In (X,Y) E \/ In (Y,X) E.
Proof.
  induction E as [| [a b] E IH]; intros X H; simpl in *.
  - fsetdec.
  - apply in_domA_cons in H. destruct H as [H|[H|H]].
    + subst. exists b. left. left. reflexivity.
    + subst. exists a. right. left. reflexivity.
    + apply IH in H. destruct H as [Y [HY|HY]].
      * exists Y. left. right. exact HY.
      * exists Y. right. right. exact HY.
Qed.

(* ===================== wf_amber from lc and fv ==================== *)


(* ============== sub implies WF on both sides ====================== *)
Lemma sub_wf : forall E A B, sub E A B -> WF E A /\ WF E B.
Proof.
  intros E A B H.
  induction H as
    [ E wfE
    | E X wfE Hb
    | E A0 wfE WFA
    | E A1 A2 B1 B2 s1 IH1 s2 IH2
    | L A1 A2 E p1 IH1 p2 IH2 ].
  - split; apply WF_nat.
  - split; apply WF_fvar; exact Hb.
  - split; [ exact WFA | apply WF_top ].
  - split; apply WF_arrow.
    + exact (proj2 IH1).
    + exact (proj1 IH2).
    + exact (proj1 IH1).
    + exact (proj2 IH2).
  - split; apply WF_rec with (L:=L).
    + intros X HX. exact (proj1 (IH1 X HX)).
    + intros X HX. exact (proj1 (IH2 X HX)).
    + intros X HX. exact (proj2 (IH1 X HX)).
    + intros X HX. exact (proj2 (IH2 X HX)).
Qed.

(* ============== WF renames to wf_amber ============================ *)
Lemma wf_amber_ren : forall E A, WF E A ->
  forall (f : atom -> atom) (Ea : env_amber),
  wfe_amber Ea ->
  (forall X, binds X bind_sub E -> f X \in domA Ea) ->
  AtomSetImpl.Subset (fv_tt A) (bindsub_atoms E) ->
  wf_amber Ea (ren_tt f A).
Proof.
  intros E A H. induction H as
    [ E
    | E
    | X E Hb
    | E A1 A2 WF1 IH1 WF2 IH2
    | L E A0 p1 IH1 p2 IH2 ]; intros f Ea Hwe Hcorr Hfv.
  - apply wfa_top. exact Hwe.
  - apply wfa_nat. exact Hwe.
  - simpl. pose proof (Hcorr X Hb) as Hd.
    pose proof (domA_member Ea (f X) Hd) as [Y [HY|HY]].
    + exact (wfa_fvarl Ea (f X) Y HY Hwe).
    + exact (wfa_fvarr Ea Y (f X) HY Hwe).
  - simpl. apply wfa_arrow.
    + apply IH1; auto. intros z Hz. apply Hfv. simpl. fsetdec.
    + apply IH2; auto. intros z Hz. apply Hfv. simpl. fsetdec.
  - simpl.
    apply wfa_rec with (L := domA Ea).
    intros X Y HX HY.
    destruct (atom_fresh (L \u fv_tt A0)) as [Z HZ].
    assert (HZL : Z \notin L) by (fsetdec).
    assert (HZfv : Z \notin fv_tt A0) by (fsetdec).
    assert (Hwe' : wfe_amber ((X,Y)::Ea)).
    { apply wfea_cons. exact HX. fsetdec. exact Hwe. }
    set (f' := fun W => if W == Z then X else f W).
    assert (Hcorr' : forall W, binds W bind_sub (Z ~ bind_sub ++ E) -> f' W \in domA ((X,Y)::Ea)).
    { intros W HW. unfold f'. destruct (W == Z) as [Heq|Hneq].
      - subst W. apply in_domA_cons. left. reflexivity.
      - apply in_domA_cons. right. right. apply Hcorr. unfold binds in *.
        simpl in HW. destruct HW as [HW|HW].
        + inversion HW. subst. exfalso. apply Hneq. reflexivity.
        + exact HW. }
    assert (Hfv' : AtomSetImpl.Subset (fv_tt (open_tt A0 (typ_fvar Z))) (bindsub_atoms (Z ~ bind_sub ++ E))).
    { intros w Hw. pose proof (fv_tt_open A0 Z w Hw) as Hw2.
      apply union_iff in Hw2 as [Hw2|Hw2].
      - simpl. rewrite add_iff. right. apply Hfv. exact Hw2.
      - assert (w = Z) by fsetdec. subst w. simpl. rewrite add_iff. left. reflexivity. }
    pose proof (IH1 Z HZL f' ((X,Y)::Ea) Hwe' Hcorr' Hfv') as Hwf.
    assert (Hren : ren_tt f' (open_tt A0 (typ_fvar Z)) = open_tt (ren_tt f A0) (typ_fvar X)).
    { rewrite ren_tt_open. f_equal.
      - apply ren_tt_ext. intros W HW. unfold f'.
        destruct (W == Z) as [Heq|Hneq].
        + subst W. exfalso. apply HZfv. exact HW.
        + reflexivity.
      - unfold f'. rewrite eq_dec_refl. reflexivity. }
    rewrite Hren in Hwf. exact Hwf.
Qed.
Lemma wf_fv_bindsub : forall E A, WF E A ->
  AtomSetImpl.Subset (fv_tt A) (bindsub_atoms E).
Proof.
  intros E A H. induction H as
    [ E
    | E
    | X E Hb
    | E A1 A2 WF1 IH1 WF2 IH2
    | L E A0 p1 IH1 p2 IH2 ].
  - simpl. intros x Hx. fsetdec.
  - simpl. intros x Hx. fsetdec.
  - simpl. intros x Hx.
    assert (x = X) by fsetdec.
    subst. apply in_bindsub_atoms. exact Hb.
  - simpl. intros x Hx. apply union_iff in Hx as [Hx|Hx].
    + apply IH1. exact Hx.
    + apply IH2. exact Hx.
  - simpl.
    destruct (atom_fresh (L \u fv_tt A0)) as [X HX].
    assert (HXL : X \notin L) by fsetdec.
    assert (HXfv : X \notin fv_tt A0) by fsetdec.
    intros Y HY.
    pose proof (IH1 X HXL) as Hsub.
    pose proof (fv_tt_open_upper A0 X Y HY) as HYopen.
    pose proof (Hsub Y HYopen) as HYenv.
    simpl in HYenv. rewrite add_iff in HYenv.
    destruct HYenv as [Heq|Hin].
    + exfalso. subst Y. exact (HXfv HY).
    + exact Hin.
Qed.

(* ============== per-atom origin translation ======================= *)
Definition pick (o : atom -> bool) (f g : atom -> atom) : atom -> atom :=
  fun X => if o X then f X else g X.

Definition ren_pick (o : atom -> bool) (f g : atom -> atom) (T : typ) : typ :=
  ren_tt (pick o f g) T.

Lemma ren_pick_id : forall o T,
  ren_pick o (fun X => X) (fun X => X) T = T.
Proof.
  intros o T. unfold ren_pick.
  transitivity (ren_tt (fun X => X) T).
  - apply ren_tt_ext.
    intros X HX. unfold pick. destruct (o X); reflexivity.
  - apply ren_tt_id.
Qed.

(* compatibility: for every matched atom occurrence, the origins must be
   (false,true) at negative polarity or (true,false) at positive polarity *)
Fixpoint compat (o1 o2 : atom -> bool) (pol : bool) (A B : typ) : Prop :=
  match A, B with
  | typ_fvar X, typ_fvar Y =>
      if X == Y then
        (if o1 X then (if o2 X then False else pol = true)
                   else (if o2 X then pol = false else False))
      else True
  | typ_arrow A1 A2, typ_arrow B1 B2 =>
      compat o1 o2 (negb pol) A1 B1 /\ compat o1 o2 pol A2 B2
  | typ_mu A1, typ_mu B1 => compat o1 o2 pol A1 B1
  | _,_ => True
  end.

Lemma compat_closed : forall A B o1 o2 pol,
  (forall X, X \notin fv_tt A) ->
  (forall X, X \notin fv_tt B) ->
  compat o1 o2 pol A B.
Proof.
  induction A as [| |n|x|T IHT|A1 IHA1 A2 IHA2];
    intros B o1 o2 pol HA HB;
    destruct B as [| |m|y|BT|B1 B2]; simpl; try tauto.
  - exfalso. apply (HA x). simpl. fsetdec.
  - split.
    + apply IHA1; auto. intros X HX. apply HA. simpl. fsetdec.
    + apply IHA2; auto. intros X HX. apply HA. simpl. fsetdec.
  - apply IHT; auto. intros X HX. apply HA. simpl. exact HX.
Qed.

Lemma compat_flip : forall A B o1 o2 pol,
  compat o1 o2 pol A B <-> compat o2 o1 (negb pol) B A.
Proof.
  induction A as [| |n|x|T IHT|A1 IHA1 A2 IHA2];
  intros B o1 o2 pol.
  - destruct B as [| |m|y|BT|B1 B2]; simpl; tauto.
  - destruct B as [| |m|y|BT|B1 B2]; simpl; tauto.
  - destruct B as [| |m|y|BT|B1 B2]; simpl; tauto.
  - destruct B as [| |m|y|BT|B1 B2]; simpl.
    + tauto. + tauto. + tauto.
    + destruct (x == y) as [Heq|Hneq].
      * subst y. rewrite !eq_dec_refl. simpl.
        destruct (o1 x); destruct (o2 x); destruct pol; simpl; try (split; intros H); try reflexivity; try (inversion H); try discriminate; tauto; tauto.
      * destruct (y == x) as [Heq|Hneq2].
        -- subst y. exfalso. apply Hneq. reflexivity.
        -- tauto.
    + tauto. + tauto.
  - (* A = mu T *) destruct B as [| |m|y|BT|B1 B2]; simpl.
    + tauto. + tauto. + tauto. + tauto.
    + apply IHT.
    + tauto.
  - (* A = arrow *) destruct B as [| |m|y|BT|B1 B2]; simpl.
    + tauto. + tauto. + tauto. + tauto. + tauto.
    + destruct (IHA1 B1 o1 o2 (negb pol)) as [Hl Hr].
      destruct (IHA2 B2 o1 o2 pol) as [Hl2 Hr2].
      split; intros [H1 H2]; split.
      * apply Hl. exact H1.
      * apply Hl2. exact H2.
      * apply Hr. exact H1.
      * apply Hr2. exact H2.
Qed.

Lemma compat_flip_false : forall A B o1 o2,
  compat o1 o2 false A B -> compat o2 o1 true B A.
Proof. intros A B o1 o2 H. apply compat_flip. exact H. Qed.


(* ============== opening injectivity =============================== *)

Lemma open_tt_rec_inj : forall T U K X,
  X \notin fv_tt T -> X \notin fv_tt U ->
  open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T = open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) U -> T = U.
Proof.
  induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2];
  intros U K X HT HU Heq;
  destruct U as [| |m|y|U0|U1 U2]; simpl in *;
  repeat match type of Heq with context [ if ?b then _ else _ ] => destruct b end;
  try discriminate; try reflexivity.

  - inversion Heq. reflexivity.

  - exfalso. inversion Heq. subst x. apply HT. fsetdec.
  - inversion Heq. reflexivity.

      * fsetdec. * fsetdec. * exact E1.
    + apply IHT2 with (K:=K) (X:=X).
      * fsetdec. * fsetdec. * exact E2.
Qed.

Lemma sub_antisym : forall E A B, sub E A B -> sub E B A -> A = B.
Proof.
  intros E A B H1. induction H1 as
    [ E0 wfE
    | E0 X wfE Hb

Require Import AmberBase.
Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.
Require Import Program.Equality.
Require Import Lia.

Definition env_mode := list ( Mode).

Definition eqMode (a b: Mode)  : bool :=
  match a,b with
  | Pos, Pos => true
  | Neg, Neg => true
  | _,_ => false
  end.

Fixpoint amber_cov (Ea : env_amber) (Em : env_mode) (T:typ) (m:Mode) : typ :=
  match Ea, Em with
  | (X,Y)::E, m'::Em' => if (eqMode m' m) then amber_cov E Em' (subst_tt X Y T) m
                         else amber_cov E Em' T m
  | _,_ => T
  end.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Auxiliary definitions                                              *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint bindsub_atoms (E : env) : atoms :=
  match E with
  | nil => empty
  | (X, bind_sub) :: E' => add X (bindsub_atoms E')
  | (_, bind_typ _) :: E' => bindsub_atoms E'
  end.

Lemma in_bindsub_atoms : forall E X,
  X \in bindsub_atoms E <-> binds X bind_sub E.
Proof.
  induction E as [| [Y b] E IH]; intros X; simpl.
  - unfold binds. simpl. split; intros H.
    + fsetdec.
    + contradiction.
  - destruct b; simpl.
    + unfold binds. simpl.
      rewrite add_iff. rewrite IH.
      split; intros [H|H].
      * left. inversion H. reflexivity.
      * right. assumption.
      * left. inversion H. reflexivity.
      * right. assumption.
    + unfold binds. simpl.
      rewrite IH. split; intros H.
      * right; assumption.
      * destruct H as [H|H]; auto. inversion H.
Qed.

Fixpoint ren_tt (f : atom -> atom) (T : typ) : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_nat => typ_nat
  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar X => typ_fvar (f X)
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (ren_tt f T1) (ren_tt f T2)
  | typ_mu T => typ_mu (ren_tt f T)
  end.

Lemma ren_tt_id : forall T, ren_tt (fun X => X) T = T.
Proof. induction T; simpl; congruence. Qed.

Lemma ren_tt_ext : forall f g T,
  (forall X, X \in fv_tt T -> f X = g X) ->
  ren_tt f T = ren_tt g T.
Proof.
  intros f g T; induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; simpl; intros H.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - f_equal. apply H. simpl. fsetdec.
  - f_equal. apply IHT. intros X HX. apply H. simpl. exact HX.
  - f_equal.
    + apply IHT1. intros X HX. apply H. simpl. fsetdec.
    + apply IHT2. intros X HX. apply H. simpl. fsetdec.
Qed.

Lemma ren_tt_ren : forall f g T,
  ren_tt f (ren_tt g T) = ren_tt (fun X => f (g X)) T.
Proof.
  intros f g T; induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IH1 T2 IH2]; simpl; try reflexivity.
  - f_equal. exact IHT.
  - f_equal; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma ren_tt_open_rec : forall f T K X,
  ren_tt f (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T) =
  open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar (f X)) (ren_tt f T).
Proof.
  intros f T; induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros K X; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (K === n); reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHT. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHT1, IHT2. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ren_tt_open : forall f T X,
  ren_tt f (open_tt T (typ_fvar X)) = open_tt (ren_tt f T) (typ_fvar (f X)).
Proof. intros. unfold open_tt. apply ren_tt_open_rec. Qed.

(* locally closed types *)
Fixpoint lc_rec (d : nat) (T : typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_nat => True
  | typ_bvar J => J < d
  | typ_fvar X => True
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => lc_rec d T1 /\ lc_rec d T2
  | typ_mu T => lc_rec (S d) T
  end.

Definition lc_tt T := lc_rec 0 T.

Lemma lc_open_rec : forall T K X d,
  lc_rec d T -> lc_rec d (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T).
Proof.
  induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros K X d H; simpl in *.
  - exact I.
  - exact I.
  - destruct (K === n).
    + simpl. exact I.
    + simpl. exact H.
  - simpl. exact I.
  - simpl. exact (IHT (S K) X (S d) H).
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. simpl. split.
    + exact (IHT1 K X d H1).
    + exact (IHT2 K X d H2).
Qed.

Lemma lc_open_mu_body : forall T d X,
  lc_rec (S d) T -> lc_rec d (open_tt_rec d (typ_fvar X) T).
Proof.
  induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros d X' H; simpl in *.
  - exact I.
  - exact I.
  - (* bvar *) destruct (d === n).
    + simpl. exact I.
    + simpl. unfold lt in *. lia.
  - exact I.
  - apply IHT. exact H.
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. split.
    + exact (IHT1 d X' H1).
    + exact (IHT2 d X' H2).
Qed.



Lemma lc_open_rec_any : forall T K X, lc_rec K T -> lc_rec K (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T).
Proof.
  induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros K X' H; simpl in *.
  - exact I.
  - exact I.
  - destruct (K === n).
    + simpl. exact I.
    + exact H.
  - exact I.
  - apply IHT. exact H.
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. split.
    + exact (IHT1 K X' H1).
    + exact (IHT2 K X' H2).
Qed.

Lemma lc_open_tt : forall T X, lc_tt T -> lc_tt (open_tt T (typ_fvar X)).
Proof.
  intros T X H. unfold lc_tt, open_tt.
  exact (lc_open_rec_any T 0 X H).
Qed.

(* fv of open *)
Lemma fv_tt_open_rec : forall T K X,
  AtomSetImpl.Subset (fv_tt (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T)) (union (fv_tt T) {{X}}).
Proof.
  induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros K X'; simpl.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - destruct (K === n); simpl; intros z Hz; fsetdec.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - simpl. intros z Hz. exact (IHT (S K) X' z Hz).
  - simpl. intros z Hz. apply union_iff in Hz as [Hz|Hz].
    + pose proof (IHT1 K X' _ Hz). fsetdec.
    + pose proof (IHT2 K X' _ Hz). fsetdec.
Qed.

Lemma fv_tt_open : forall T X,
  AtomSetImpl.Subset (fv_tt (open_tt T (typ_fvar X))) (union (fv_tt T) {{X}}).
Proof. intros. unfold open_tt. apply fv_tt_open_rec. Qed.

Lemma fv_tt_open_upper_rec : forall T K X,
  AtomSetImpl.Subset (fv_tt T) (fv_tt (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T)).
Proof.
  induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros K X'; simpl.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - intros z Hz. exact (IHT (S K) X' z Hz).
  - intros z Hz. apply union_iff in Hz as [Hz|Hz].
    + pose proof (IHT1 K X' z Hz). fsetdec.
    + pose proof (IHT2 K X' z Hz). fsetdec.
Qed.

Lemma fv_tt_open_upper : forall T X,
  AtomSetImpl.Subset (fv_tt T) (fv_tt (open_tt T (typ_fvar X))).
Proof. intros. unfold open_tt. apply fv_tt_open_upper_rec. Qed.

(* ===================== domA lemmas ================================= *)
Lemma in_domA_cons : forall X Y E z,
  z \in domA ((X,Y)::E) <-> z = X \/ z = Y \/ z \in domA E.
Proof.
  intros. simpl. split; intros H; fsetdec.
Qed.

Lemma in_domA_pair_1 : forall E X Y, In (X,Y) E -> X \in domA E.
Proof.
  induction E as [| [a b] E IH]; intros X Y Hin; simpl in *.
  - contradiction.
  - destruct Hin as [Hin|Hin].
    + inversion Hin; subst. apply in_domA_cons. left. reflexivity.
    + apply in_domA_cons. right. right. exact (IH X Y Hin).
Qed.

Lemma in_domA_pair_2 : forall E X Y, In (X,Y) E -> Y \in domA E.
Proof.
  induction E as [| [a b] E IH]; intros X Y Hin; simpl in *.
  - contradiction.
  - destruct Hin as [Hin|Hin].
    + inversion Hin; subst. apply in_domA_cons. right. left. reflexivity.
    + apply in_domA_cons. right. right. exact (IH X Y Hin).
Qed.

Lemma domA_member : forall E X,
  X \in domA E -> exists Y, In (X,Y) E \/ In (Y,X) E.
Proof.
  induction E as [| [a b] E IH]; intros X H; simpl in *.
  - fsetdec.
  - apply in_domA_cons in H. destruct H as [H|[H|H]].
    + subst. exists b. left. left. reflexivity.
    + subst. exists a. right. left. reflexivity.
    + apply IH in H. destruct H as [Y [HY|HY]].
      * exists Y. left. right. exact HY.
      * exists Y. right. right. exact HY.
Qed.

(* ===================== wf_amber from lc and fv ==================== *)


(* ============== sub implies WF on both sides ====================== *)
Lemma sub_wf : forall E A B, sub E A B -> WF E A /\ WF E B.
Proof.
  intros E A B H.
  induction H as
    [ E wfE
    | E X wfE Hb
    | E A0 wfE WFA
    | E A1 A2 B1 B2 s1 IH1 s2 IH2
    | L A1 A2 E p1 IH1 p2 IH2 ].
  - split; apply WF_nat.
  - split; apply WF_fvar; exact Hb.
  - split; [ exact WFA | apply WF_top ].
  - split; apply WF_arrow.
    + exact (proj2 IH1).
    + exact (proj1 IH2).
    + exact (proj1 IH1).
    + exact (proj2 IH2).
  - split; apply WF_rec with (L:=L).
    + intros X HX. exact (proj1 (IH1 X HX)).
    + intros X HX. exact (proj1 (IH2 X HX)).
    + intros X HX. exact (proj2 (IH1 X HX)).
    + intros X HX. exact (proj2 (IH2 X HX)).
Qed.

Lemma wf_amber_ren : forall E A, WF E A ->
  forall (f : atom -> atom) (Ea : env_amber),
  wfe_amber Ea ->
  (forall X, binds X bind_sub E -> f X \in domA Ea) ->

  - apply wfa_nat. exact Hwe.
  - simpl. pose proof (Hcorr X Hb) as Hd.

    + exact (wfa_fvarl Ea (f X) Y HY Hwe).

    + apply IH1; auto. intros z Hz. apply Hfv. simpl. fsetdec.
    + apply IH2; auto. intros z Hz. apply Hfv. simpl. fsetdec.
  - simpl.
    apply wfa_rec with (L := domA Ea).
    intros X Y HX HY.

    assert (HZL : Z \notin L) by (fsetdec).
    assert (HZfv : Z \notin fv_tt A0) by (fsetdec).
    assert (Hwe' : wfe_amber ((X,Y)::Ea)).

        simpl in HW. destruct HW as [HW|HW].

        + exact HW. }
    assert (Hfv' : AtomSetImpl.Subset (fv_tt (open_tt A0 (typ_fvar Z))) (bindsub_atoms (Z ~ bind_sub ++ E))).
    { intros w Hw. pose proof (fv_tt_open A0 Z w Hw) as Hw2.

      - simpl. rewrite add_iff. right. apply Hfv. exact Hw2.

Lemma wf_fv_bindsub : forall E A, WF E A ->
  AtomSetImpl.Subset (fv_tt A) (bindsub_atoms E).
Proof.
  intros E A H. induction H as
    [ E
    | E
    | X E Hb
    | E A1 A2 WF1 IH1 WF2 IH2
    | L E A0 p1 IH1 p2 IH2 ].

  - simpl. intros x Hx. fsetdec.
  - simpl. intros x Hx.

(* ============== per-atom origin translation ======================= *)
Definition pick (o : atom -> bool) (f g : atom -> atom) : atom -> atom :=
  fun X => if o X then f X else g X.

Definition ren_pick (o : atom -> bool) (f g : atom -> atom) (T : typ) : typ :=
  ren_tt (pick o f g) T.

Lemma ren_pick_id : forall o T,
  ren_pick o (fun X => X) (fun X => X) T = T.
Proof.
  intros o T. unfold ren_pick.
  transitivity (ren_tt (fun X => X) T).
  - apply ren_tt_ext.
    intros X HX. unfold pick. destruct (o X); reflexivity.
  - apply ren_tt_id.
Qed.

(* compatibility: for every matched atom occurrence, the origins must be
   (false,true) at negative polarity or (true,false) at positive polarity *)
Fixpoint compat (o1 o2 : atom -> bool) (pol : bool) (A B : typ) : Prop :=
  match A, B with
  | typ_fvar X, typ_fvar Y =>
      if X == Y then
        (if o1 X then (if o2 X then False else pol = true)
                   else (if o2 X then pol = false else False))
      else True
  | typ_arrow A1 A2, typ_arrow B1 B2 =>
      compat o1 o2 (negb pol) A1 B1 /\ compat o1 o2 pol A2 B2
  | typ_mu A1, typ_mu B1 => compat o1 o2 pol A1 B1
  | _,_ => True
  end.

Lemma compat_closed : forall A B o1 o2 pol,
  (forall X, X \notin fv_tt A) ->
  (forall X, X \notin fv_tt B) ->
  compat o1 o2 pol A B.
Proof.
  induction A as [| |n|x|T IHT|A1 IHA1 A2 IHA2];
    intros B o1 o2 pol HA HB;
    destruct B as [| |m|y|BT|B1 B2]; simpl; try tauto.
  - exfalso. apply (HA x). simpl. fsetdec.
  - apply (IHT BT o1 o2 pol).
    + intros X HX. apply HA. simpl. exact HX.
    + intros X HX. apply HB. simpl. exact HX.
  - split.
    + apply (IHA1 B1 o1 o2 (negb pol)).
      * intros X HX. apply HA. simpl. fsetdec.
      * intros X HX. apply HB. simpl. fsetdec.
    + apply (IHA2 B2 o1 o2 pol).
      * intros X HX. apply HA. simpl. fsetdec.
      * intros X HX. apply HB. simpl. fsetdec.
Qed.

Lemma compat_flip : forall A B o1 o2 pol,
  compat o1 o2 pol A B <-> compat o2 o1 (negb pol) B A.
Proof.
  induction A as [| |n|x|T IHT|A1 IHA1 A2 IHA2];
  intros B o1 o2 pol.
  - destruct B as [| |m|y|BT|B1 B2]; simpl; tauto.
  - destruct B as [| |m|y|BT|B1 B2]; simpl; tauto.
  - destruct B as [| |m|y|BT|B1 B2]; simpl; tauto.
  - destruct B as [| |m|y|BT|B1 B2]; simpl.
    + tauto. + tauto. + tauto.
    + destruct (x == y) as [Heq|Hneq].
      * subst y. rewrite !eq_dec_refl. simpl.
        destruct (o1 x); destruct (o2 x); destruct pol; simpl; try (split; intros H); try reflexivity; try (inversion H); try discriminate; tauto; tauto.
      * destruct (y == x) as [Heq|Hneq2].
        -- subst y. exfalso. apply Hneq. reflexivity.
        -- tauto.
    + tauto. + tauto.
  - (* A = mu T *) destruct B as [| |m|y|BT|B1 B2]; simpl.
    + tauto. + tauto. + tauto. + tauto.
    + apply IHT.
    + tauto.
  - (* A = arrow *) destruct B as [| |m|y|BT|B1 B2]; simpl.
    + tauto. + tauto. + tauto. + tauto. + tauto.
    + destruct (IHA1 B1 o1 o2 (negb pol)) as [Hl Hr].
      destruct (IHA2 B2 o1 o2 pol) as [Hl2 Hr2].
      split; intros [H1 H2]; split.
      * apply Hl. exact H1.
      * apply Hl2. exact H2.
      * apply Hr. exact H1.
      * apply Hr2. exact H2.
Qed.

Lemma compat_flip_false : forall A B o1 o2,
  compat o1 o2 false A B -> compat o2 o1 true B A.
Proof. intros A B o1 o2 H. apply compat_flip. exact H. Qed.

Lemma open_tt_rec_inj : forall T U K X,
  X \notin fv_tt T -> X \notin fv_tt U ->
  open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T = open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) U -> T = U.
Proof.

Require Import AmberBase.
Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.
Require Import Program.Equality.
Require Import Lia.

Definition env_mode := list ( Mode).

Definition eqMode (a b: Mode)  : bool :=
  match a,b with
  | Pos, Pos => true
  | Neg, Neg => true
  | _,_ => false
  end.

Fixpoint amber_cov (Ea : env_amber) (Em : env_mode) (T:typ) (m:Mode) : typ :=
  match Ea, Em with
  | (X,Y)::E, m'::Em' => if (eqMode m' m) then amber_cov E Em' (subst_tt X Y T) m
                         else amber_cov E Em' T m
  | _,_ => T
  end.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Auxiliary definitions                                              *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint bindsub_atoms (E : env) : atoms :=
  match E with
  | nil => empty
  | (X, bind_sub) :: E' => add X (bindsub_atoms E')
  | (_, bind_typ _) :: E' => bindsub_atoms E'
  end.

Lemma in_bindsub_atoms : forall E X,
  X \in bindsub_atoms E <-> binds X bind_sub E.
Proof.
  induction E as [| [Y b] E IH]; intros X; simpl.
  - unfold binds. simpl. split; intros H.
    + fsetdec.
    + contradiction.
  - destruct b; simpl.
    + unfold binds. simpl.
      rewrite add_iff. rewrite IH.
      split; intros [H|H].
      * left. inversion H. reflexivity.
      * right. assumption.
      * left. inversion H. reflexivity.
      * right. assumption.
    + unfold binds. simpl.
      rewrite IH. split; intros H.
      * right; assumption.
      * destruct H as [H|H]; auto. inversion H.
Qed.

Fixpoint ren_tt (f : atom -> atom) (T : typ) : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_nat => typ_nat
  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar X => typ_fvar (f X)
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (ren_tt f T1) (ren_tt f T2)
  | typ_mu T => typ_mu (ren_tt f T)
  end.

Lemma ren_tt_id : forall T, ren_tt (fun X => X) T = T.
Proof. induction T; simpl; congruence. Qed.

Lemma ren_tt_ext : forall f g T,
  (forall X, X \in fv_tt T -> f X = g X) ->
  ren_tt f T = ren_tt g T.
Proof.
  intros f g T; induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; simpl; intros H.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - f_equal. apply H. simpl. fsetdec.
  - f_equal. apply IHT. intros X HX. apply H. simpl. exact HX.
  - f_equal.
    + apply IHT1. intros X HX. apply H. simpl. fsetdec.
    + apply IHT2. intros X HX. apply H. simpl. fsetdec.
Qed.

Lemma ren_tt_ren : forall f g T,
  ren_tt f (ren_tt g T) = ren_tt (fun X => f (g X)) T.
Proof.
  intros f g T; induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IH1 T2 IH2]; simpl; try reflexivity.
  - f_equal. exact IHT.
  - f_equal; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma ren_tt_open_rec : forall f T K X,
  ren_tt f (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T) =
  open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar (f X)) (ren_tt f T).
Proof.
  intros f T; induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros K X; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (K === n); reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHT. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHT1, IHT2. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ren_tt_open : forall f T X,
  ren_tt f (open_tt T (typ_fvar X)) = open_tt (ren_tt f T) (typ_fvar (f X)).
Proof. intros. unfold open_tt. apply ren_tt_open_rec. Qed.

(* locally closed types *)
Fixpoint lc_rec (d : nat) (T : typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_nat => True
  | typ_bvar J => J < d
  | typ_fvar X => True
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => lc_rec d T1 /\ lc_rec d T2
  | typ_mu T => lc_rec (S d) T
  end.

Definition lc_tt T := lc_rec 0 T.

Lemma lc_open_rec : forall T K X d,
  lc_rec d T -> lc_rec d (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T).
Proof.
  induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros K X d H; simpl in *.
  - exact I.
  - exact I.
  - destruct (K === n).
    + simpl. exact I.
    + simpl. exact H.
  - simpl. exact I.
  - simpl. exact (IHT (S K) X (S d) H).
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. simpl. split.
    + exact (IHT1 K X d H1).
    + exact (IHT2 K X d H2).
Qed.

Lemma lc_open_mu_body : forall T d X,
  lc_rec (S d) T -> lc_rec d (open_tt_rec d (typ_fvar X) T).
Proof.
  induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros d X' H; simpl in *.
  - exact I.
  - exact I.
  - (* bvar *) destruct (d === n).
    + simpl. exact I.
    + simpl. unfold lt in *. lia.
  - exact I.
  - apply IHT. exact H.
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. split.
    + exact (IHT1 d X' H1).
    + exact (IHT2 d X' H2).
Qed.



Lemma lc_open_rec_any : forall T K X, lc_rec K T -> lc_rec K (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T).
Proof.
  induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros K X' H; simpl in *.
  - exact I.
  - exact I.
  - destruct (K === n).
    + simpl. exact I.
    + exact H.
  - exact I.
  - apply IHT. exact H.
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. split.
    + exact (IHT1 K X' H1).
    + exact (IHT2 K X' H2).
Qed.

Lemma lc_open_tt : forall T X, lc_tt T -> lc_tt (open_tt T (typ_fvar X)).
Proof.
  intros T X H. unfold lc_tt, open_tt.
  exact (lc_open_rec_any T 0 X H).
Qed.

(* fv of open *)
Lemma fv_tt_open_rec : forall T K X,
  AtomSetImpl.Subset (fv_tt (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T)) (union (fv_tt T) {{X}}).
Proof.
  induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros K X'; simpl.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - destruct (K === n); simpl; intros z Hz; fsetdec.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - simpl. intros z Hz. exact (IHT (S K) X' z Hz).
  - simpl. intros z Hz. apply union_iff in Hz as [Hz|Hz].

(* ============== per-atom origin translation ======================= *)
Definition pick (o : atom -> bool) (f g : atom -> atom) : atom -> atom :=
  fun X => if o X then f X else g X.

Definition ren_pick (o : atom -> bool) (f g : atom -> atom) (T : typ) : typ :=
  ren_tt (pick o f g) T.

Lemma ren_pick_id : forall o T,
  ren_pick o (fun X => X) (fun X => X) T = T.
Proof.
  intros o T. unfold ren_pick.
  transitivity (ren_tt (fun X => X) T).
  - apply ren_tt_ext.
    intros X HX. unfold pick. destruct (o X); reflexivity.
  - apply ren_tt_id.
Qed.

(* compatibility: for every matched atom occurrence, the origins must be
   (false,true) at negative polarity or (true,false) at positive polarity *)
Fixpoint compat (o1 o2 : atom -> bool) (pol : bool) (A B : typ) : Prop :=
  match A, B with
  | typ_fvar X, typ_fvar Y =>
      if X == Y then
        (if o1 X then (if o2 X then False else pol = true)
                   else (if o2 X then pol = false else False))
      else True
  | typ_arrow A1 A2, typ_arrow B1 B2 =>
      compat o1 o2 (negb pol) A1 B1 /\ compat o1 o2 pol A2 B2
  | typ_mu A1, typ_mu B1 => compat o1 o2 pol A1 B1
  | _,_ => True
  end.

Lemma compat_closed : forall A B o1 o2 pol,
  (forall X, X \notin fv_tt A) ->
  (forall X, X \notin fv_tt B) ->
  compat o1 o2 pol A B.
Proof.
  induction A as [| |n|x|T IHT|A1 IHA1 A2 IHA2];
    intros B o1 o2 pol HA HB;
    destruct B as [| |m|y|BT|B1 B2]; simpl; try tauto.
  - exfalso. apply (HA x). simpl. fsetdec.
  - apply (IHT BT o1 o2 pol).
    + intros X HX. apply (HA X). simpl. exact HX.
    + intros X HX. apply (HB X). simpl. exact HX.
  - split.
    + apply (IHA1 B1 o1 o2 (negb pol)).
      * intros X HX. apply HA. simpl. fsetdec.
      * intros X HX. apply HB. simpl. fsetdec.
    + apply (IHA2 B2 o1 o2 pol).
      * intros X HX. apply HA. simpl. fsetdec.
      * intros X HX. apply HB. simpl. fsetdec.
Qed.

Require Import AmberBase.
Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.
Require Import Program.Equality.
Require Import Lia.

Definition env_mode := list ( Mode).

Definition eqMode (a b: Mode)  : bool :=
  match a,b with
  | Pos, Pos => true
  | Neg, Neg => true
  | _,_ => false
  end.

Fixpoint amber_cov (Ea : env_amber) (Em : env_mode) (T:typ) (m:Mode) : typ :=
  match Ea, Em with
  | (X,Y)::E, m'::Em' => if (eqMode m' m) then amber_cov E Em' (subst_tt X Y T) m
                         else amber_cov E Em' T m
  | _,_ => T
  end.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Auxiliary definitions                                              *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint bindsub_atoms (E : env) : atoms :=
  match E with
  | nil => empty
  | (X, bind_sub) :: E' => add X (bindsub_atoms E')
  | (_, bind_typ _) :: E' => bindsub_atoms E'
  end.

Lemma in_bindsub_atoms : forall E X,
  X \in bindsub_atoms E <-> binds X bind_sub E.
Proof.
  induction E as [| [Y b] E IH]; intros X; simpl.
  - unfold binds. simpl. split; intros H.
    + fsetdec.
    + contradiction.
  - destruct b; simpl.
    + unfold binds. simpl.
      rewrite add_iff. rewrite IH.
      split; intros [H|H].
      * left. inversion H. reflexivity.
      * right. assumption.
      * left. inversion H. reflexivity.
      * right. assumption.
    + unfold binds. simpl.
      rewrite IH. split; intros H.
      * right; assumption.
      * destruct H as [H|H]; auto. inversion H.
Qed.

Fixpoint ren_tt (f : atom -> atom) (T : typ) : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_nat => typ_nat
  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar X => typ_fvar (f X)
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (ren_tt f T1) (ren_tt f T2)
  | typ_mu T => typ_mu (ren_tt f T)
  end.

Lemma ren_tt_id : forall T, ren_tt (fun X => X) T = T.
Proof. induction T; simpl; congruence. Qed.

Lemma ren_tt_ext : forall f g T,
  (forall X, X \in fv_tt T -> f X = g X) ->
  ren_tt f T = ren_tt g T.
Proof.
  intros f g T; induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; simpl; intros H.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - f_equal. apply H. simpl. fsetdec.
  - f_equal. apply IHT. intros X HX. apply H. simpl. exact HX.
  - f_equal.
    + apply IHT1. intros X HX. apply H. simpl. fsetdec.
    + apply IHT2. intros X HX. apply H. simpl. fsetdec.
Qed.

Lemma ren_tt_ren : forall f g T,
  ren_tt f (ren_tt g T) = ren_tt (fun X => f (g X)) T.
Proof.
  intros f g T; induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IH1 T2 IH2]; simpl; try reflexivity.
  - f_equal. exact IHT.
  - f_equal; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma ren_tt_open_rec : forall f T K X,
  ren_tt f (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T) =
  open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar (f X)) (ren_tt f T).
Proof.
  intros f T; induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros K X; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (K === n); reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHT. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHT1, IHT2. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ren_tt_open : forall f T X,
  ren_tt f (open_tt T (typ_fvar X)) = open_tt (ren_tt f T) (typ_fvar (f X)).
Proof. intros. unfold open_tt. apply ren_tt_open_rec. Qed.

(* locally closed types *)
Fixpoint lc_rec (d : nat) (T : typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_nat => True
  | typ_bvar J => J < d
  | typ_fvar X => True
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => lc_rec d T1 /\ lc_rec d T2
  | typ_mu T => lc_rec (S d) T
  end.

Definition lc_tt T := lc_rec 0 T.

Lemma lc_open_rec : forall T K X d,
  lc_rec d T -> lc_rec d (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T).
Proof.
  induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros K X d H; simpl in *.
  - exact I.
  - exact I.
  - destruct (K === n).
    + simpl. exact I.
    + simpl. exact H.
  - simpl. exact I.
  - simpl. exact (IHT (S K) X (S d) H).
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. simpl. split.
    + exact (IHT1 K X d H1).
    + exact (IHT2 K X d H2).
Qed.

Lemma lc_open_mu_body : forall T d X,
  lc_rec (S d) T -> lc_rec d (open_tt_rec d (typ_fvar X) T).
Proof.
  induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros d X' H; simpl in *.
  - exact I.
  - exact I.
  - (* bvar *) destruct (d === n).
    + simpl. exact I.
    + simpl. unfold lt in *. lia.
  - exact I.
  - apply IHT. exact H.
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. split.
    + exact (IHT1 d X' H1).
    + exact (IHT2 d X' H2).
Qed.



Lemma lc_open_rec_any : forall T K X, lc_rec K T -> lc_rec K (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T).
Proof.
  induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros K X' H; simpl in *.
  - exact I.
  - exact I.
  - destruct (K === n).
    + simpl. exact I.
    + exact H.
  - exact I.
  - apply IHT. exact H.
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. split.
    + exact (IHT1 K X' H1).
    + exact (IHT2 K X' H2).
Qed.

Lemma lc_open_tt : forall T X, lc_tt T -> lc_tt (open_tt T (typ_fvar X)).
Proof.
  intros T X H. unfold lc_tt, open_tt.
  exact (lc_open_rec_any T 0 X H).
Qed.

(* fv of open *)
Lemma fv_tt_open_rec : forall T K X,
  AtomSetImpl.Subset (fv_tt (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T)) (union (fv_tt T) {{X}}).
Proof.
  induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros K X'; simpl.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - destruct (K === n); simpl; intros z Hz; fsetdec.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - simpl. intros z Hz. exact (IHT (S K) X' z Hz).
  - simpl. intros z Hz. apply union_iff in Hz as [Hz|Hz].
    + pose proof (IHT1 K X' _ Hz). fsetdec.
    + pose proof (IHT2 K X' _ Hz). fsetdec.
Qed.

Lemma fv_tt_open : forall T X,
  AtomSetImpl.Subset (fv_tt (open_tt T (typ_fvar X))) (union (fv_tt T) {{X}}).
Proof. intros. unfold open_tt. apply fv_tt_open_rec. Qed.

Lemma fv_tt_open_upper_rec : forall T K X,
  AtomSetImpl.Subset (fv_tt T) (fv_tt (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T)).
Proof.
  induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros K X'; simpl.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - intros z Hz. exact (IHT (S K) X' z Hz).
  - intros z Hz. apply union_iff in Hz as [Hz|Hz].
    + pose proof (IHT1 K X' z Hz). fsetdec.
    + pose proof (IHT2 K X' z Hz). fsetdec.
Qed.

Lemma fv_tt_open_upper : forall T X,
  AtomSetImpl.Subset (fv_tt T) (fv_tt (open_tt T (typ_fvar X))).
Proof. intros. unfold open_tt. apply fv_tt_open_upper_rec. Qed.

(* ===================== domA lemmas ================================= *)
Lemma in_domA_cons : forall X Y E z,
  z \in domA ((X,Y)::E) <-> z = X \/ z = Y \/ z \in domA E.
Proof.
  intros. simpl. split; intros H; fsetdec.
Qed.

Lemma in_domA_pair_1 : forall E X Y, In (X,Y) E -> X \in domA E.
Proof.
  induction E as [| [a b] E IH]; intros X Y Hin; simpl in *.
  - contradiction.
  - destruct Hin as [Hin|Hin].
    + inversion Hin; subst. apply in_domA_cons. left. reflexivity.
    + apply in_domA_cons. right. right. exact (IH X Y Hin).
Qed.

Lemma in_domA_pair_2 : forall E X Y, In (X,Y) E -> Y \in domA E.
Proof.
  induction E as [| [a b] E IH]; intros X Y Hin; simpl in *.
  - contradiction.
  - destruct Hin as [Hin|Hin].
    + inversion Hin; subst. apply in_domA_cons. right. left. reflexivity.
    + apply in_domA_cons. right. right. exact (IH X Y Hin).
Qed.

Lemma domA_member : forall E X,
  X \in domA E -> exists Y, In (X,Y) E \/ In (Y,X) E.
Proof.
  induction E as [| [a b] E IH]; intros X H; simpl in *.
  - fsetdec.
  - apply in_domA_cons in H. destruct H as [H|[H|H]].
    + subst. exists b. left. left. reflexivity.
    + subst. exists a. right. left. reflexivity.
    + apply IH in H. destruct H as [Y [HY|HY]].
      * exists Y. left. right. exact HY.
      * exists Y. right. right. exact HY.
Qed.

(* ============== sub implies WF on both sides ====================== *)
Lemma sub_wf : forall E A B, sub E A B -> WF E A /\ WF E B.
Proof.
  intros E A B H.
  induction H as
    [ E wfE
    | E X wfE Hb
    | E A0 wfE WFA
    | E A1 A2 B1 B2 s1 IH1 s2 IH2
    | L A1 A2 E p1 IH1 p2 IH2 ].
  - split; apply WF_nat.
  - split; apply WF_fvar; exact Hb.
  - split; [ exact WFA | apply WF_top ].
  - split; apply WF_arrow.
    + exact (proj2 IH1).
    + exact (proj1 IH2).
    + exact (proj1 IH1).
    + exact (proj2 IH2).
  - split; apply WF_rec with (L:=L).
    + intros X HX. exact (proj1 (IH1 X HX)).
    + intros X HX. exact (proj1 (IH2 X HX)).
    + intros X HX. exact (proj2 (IH1 X HX)).
    + intros X HX. exact (proj2 (IH2 X HX)).
Qed.

Lemma wf_amber_ren : forall E A, WF E A ->
  forall (f : atom -> atom) (Ea : env_amber),
  wfe_amber Ea ->
  (forall X, binds X bind_sub E -> f X \in domA Ea) ->
  AtomSetImpl.Subset (fv_tt A) (bindsub_atoms E) ->
  wf_amber Ea (ren_tt f A).
Proof.
  intros E A H. induction H as
    [ E
    | E
    | X E Hb
    | E A1 A2 WF1 IH1 WF2 IH2
    | L E A0 p1 IH1 p2 IH2 ]; intros f Ea Hwe Hcorr Hfv.
  - apply wfa_top. exact Hwe.
  - apply wfa_nat. exact Hwe.
  - simpl. pose proof (Hcorr X Hb) as Hd.
    pose proof (domA_member Ea (f X) Hd) as [Y [HY|HY]].
    + exact (wfa_fvarl Ea (f X) Y HY Hwe).
    + exact (wfa_fvarr Ea Y (f X) HY Hwe).
  - simpl. apply wfa_arrow.
    + apply IH1; auto. intros z Hz. apply Hfv. simpl. fsetdec.
    + apply IH2; auto. intros z Hz. apply Hfv. simpl. fsetdec.
  - simpl.
    apply wfa_rec with (L := domA Ea).
    intros X Y HX HY.
    destruct (atom_fresh (L \u fv_tt A0)) as [Z HZ].
    assert (HZL : Z \notin L) by (fsetdec).
    assert (HZfv : Z \notin fv_tt A0) by (fsetdec).
    assert (Hwe' : wfe_amber ((X,Y)::Ea)).
    { apply wfea_cons. exact HX. fsetdec. exact Hwe. }
    set (f' := fun W => if W == Z then X else f W).
    assert (Hcorr' : forall W, binds W bind_sub (Z ~ bind_sub ++ E) -> f' W \in domA ((X,Y)::Ea)).
    { intros W HW. unfold f'. destruct (W == Z) as [Heq|Hneq].
      - subst W. apply in_domA_cons. left. reflexivity.
      - apply in_domA_cons. right. right. apply Hcorr. unfold binds in *.
        simpl in HW. destruct HW as [HW|HW].
        + inversion HW. subst. exfalso. apply Hneq. reflexivity.
        + exact HW. }
    assert (Hfv' : AtomSetImpl.Subset (fv_tt (open_tt A0 (typ_fvar Z))) (bindsub_atoms (Z ~ bind_sub ++ E))).
    { intros w Hw. pose proof (fv_tt_open A0 Z w Hw) as Hw2.
      apply union_iff in Hw2 as [Hw2|Hw2].
      - simpl. rewrite add_iff. right. apply Hfv. exact Hw2.
      - assert (w = Z) by fsetdec. subst w. simpl. rewrite add_iff. left. reflexivity. }
    pose proof (IH1 Z HZL f' ((X,Y)::Ea) Hwe' Hcorr' Hfv') as Hwf.
    assert (Hren : ren_tt f' (open_tt A0 (typ_fvar Z)) = open_tt (ren_tt f A0) (typ_fvar X)).
    { rewrite ren_tt_open. f_equal.
      - apply ren_tt_ext. intros W HW. unfold f'.
        destruct (W == Z) as [Heq|Hneq].
        + subst W. exfalso. apply HZfv. exact HW.
        + reflexivity.
      - unfold f'. rewrite eq_dec_refl. reflexivity. }
    rewrite Hren in Hwf. exact Hwf.

Lemma wf_fv_bindsub : forall E A, WF E A ->
  AtomSetImpl.Subset (fv_tt A) (bindsub_atoms E).
Proof.
  intros E A H. induction H as
    [ E
    | E
    | X E Hb
    | E A1 A2 WF1 IH1 WF2 IH2
    | L E A0 p1 IH1 p2 IH2 ].
  - simpl. intros x Hx. fsetdec.
  - simpl. intros x Hx. fsetdec.
  - simpl. intros x Hx.
    assert (x = X) by fsetdec.
    subst. apply in_bindsub_atoms. exact Hb.
  - simpl. intros x Hx. apply union_iff in Hx as [Hx|Hx].
    + apply IH1. exact Hx.
    + apply IH2. exact Hx.
  - simpl.
    destruct (atom_fresh (L \u fv_tt A0)) as [X HX].
    assert (HXL : X \notin L) by fsetdec.
    assert (HXfv : X \notin fv_tt A0) by fsetdec.
    intros Y HY.
    pose proof (IH1 X HXL) as Hsub.
    pose proof (fv_tt_open_upper A0 X Y HY) as HYopen.
    pose proof (Hsub Y HYopen) as HYenv.
    simpl in HYenv. rewrite add_iff in HYenv.
    destruct HYenv as [Heq|Hin].
    + exfalso. subst Y. exact (HXfv HY).
    + exact Hin.

(* ============== per-atom origin translation ======================= *)
Definition pick (o : atom -> bool) (f g : atom -> atom) : atom -> atom :=
  fun X => if o X then f X else g X.

Definition ren_pick (o : atom -> bool) (f g : atom -> atom) (T : typ) : typ :=
  ren_tt (pick o f g) T.

Lemma ren_pick_id : forall o T,
  ren_pick o (fun X => X) (fun X => X) T = T.
Proof.
  intros o T. unfold ren_pick.
  transitivity (ren_tt (fun X => X) T).
  - apply ren_tt_ext.
    intros X HX. unfold pick. destruct (o X); reflexivity.
  - apply ren_tt_id.
Qed.

(* compatibility: for every matched atom occurrence, the origins must be
   (false,true) at negative polarity or (true,false) at positive polarity *)
Fixpoint compat (o1 o2 : atom -> bool) (pol : bool) (A B : typ) : Prop :=
  match A, B with
  | typ_fvar X, typ_fvar Y =>
      if X == Y then
        (if o1 X then (if o2 X then False else pol = true)
                   else (if o2 X then pol = false else False))
      else True
  | typ_arrow A1 A2, typ_arrow B1 B2 =>
      compat o1 o2 (negb pol) A1 B1 /\ compat o1 o2 pol A2 B2
  | typ_mu A1, typ_mu B1 => compat o1 o2 pol A1 B1
  | _,_ => True
  end.

Lemma compat_closed : forall A B o1 o2 pol,
  (forall X, X \notin fv_tt A) ->
  (forall X, X \notin fv_tt B) ->
  compat o1 o2 pol A B.
Proof.
  induction A as [| |n|x|T IHT|A1 IHA1 A2 IHA2];
    intros B o1 o2 pol HA HB;
    destruct B as [| |m|y|BT|B1 B2]; simpl; try tauto.
  - exfalso. apply (HA x). simpl. fsetdec.
  - apply (IHT BT o1 o2 pol).
    + intros X HX. exact (HA X (eq_refl_typ_mu_fv X HX)).
    + intros X HX. exact (HB X (eq_refl_typ_mu_fv X HX)).
  - split.
    + apply (IHA1 B1 o1 o2 (negb pol)).
      * intros X HX. exact (HA X (in_arrow_fv_1 X A1 A2 HX)).
      * intros X HX. exact (HB X (in_arrow_fv_1 X B1 B2 HX)).
    + apply (IHA2 B2 o1 o2 pol).
      * intros X HX. exact (HA X (in_arrow_fv_2 X A1 A2 HX)).
      * intros X HX. exact (HB X (in_arrow_fv_2 X B1 B2 HX)).
Qed.

Lemma compat_flip : forall A B o1 o2 pol,
  compat o1 o2 pol A B <-> compat o2 o1 (negb pol) B A.
Proof.
  induction A as [| |n|x|T IHT|A1 IHA1 A2 IHA2];
  intros B o1 o2 pol.
  - destruct B as [| |m|y|BT|B1 B2]; simpl; tauto.
  - destruct B as [| |m|y|BT|B1 B2]; simpl; tauto.
  - destruct B as [| |m|y|BT|B1 B2]; simpl; tauto.
  - destruct B as [| |m|y|BT|B1 B2]; simpl.
    + tauto. + tauto. + tauto.
    + destruct (x == y) as [Heq|Hneq].
      * subst y. rewrite !eq_dec_refl. simpl.
        destruct (o1 x); destruct (o2 x); destruct pol; simpl; try (split; intros H); try reflexivity; try (inversion H); try discriminate; tauto; tauto.
      * destruct (y == x) as [Heq|Hneq2].
        -- subst y. exfalso. apply Hneq. reflexivity.
        -- tauto.
    + tauto. + tauto.
  - (* A = mu T *) destruct B as [| |m|y|BT|B1 B2]; simpl.
    + tauto. + tauto. + tauto. + tauto.
    + apply IHT.
    + tauto.
  - (* A = arrow *) destruct B as [| |m|y|BT|B1 B2]; simpl.
    + tauto. + tauto. + tauto. + tauto. + tauto.
    + destruct (IHA1 B1 o1 o2 (negb pol)) as [Hl Hr].
      destruct (IHA2 B2 o1 o2 pol) as [Hl2 Hr2].
      split; intros [H1 H2]; split.
      * apply Hl. exact H1.
      * apply Hl2. exact H2.
      * apply Hr. exact H1.
      * apply Hr2. exact H2.
Qed.

Lemma compat_flip_false : forall A B o1 o2,
  compat o1 o2 false A B -> compat o2 o1 true B A.
Proof. intros A B o1 o2 H. apply compat_flip. exact H. Qed.


(* ============== opening injectivity =============================== *)

Lemma open_tt_rec_inj : forall T U K X,
  X \notin fv_tt T -> X \notin fv_tt U ->
  open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T = open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) U -> T = U.
Proof.
  induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2];
  intros U K X HT HU Heq;
  destruct U as [| |m|y|U0|U1 U2]; simpl in *;
  repeat match type of Heq with context [ if ?b then _ else _ ] => destruct b end;
  try discriminate; try reflexivity.
  - subst n. f_equal. exact e0.
  - inversion Heq. reflexivity.
  - exfalso. inversion Heq. subst y. apply HU. fsetdec.
  - exfalso. inversion Heq. subst x. apply HT. fsetdec.
  - inversion Heq. reflexivity.
  - injection Heq as Heq'. f_equal. apply IHT with (K:=S K) (X:=X).
    + exact HT.
    + exact HU.
    + exact Heq'.
  - injection Heq as E1 E2. f_equal.
    + apply IHT1 with (K:=K) (X:=X).
      * fsetdec. * fsetdec. * exact E1.
    + apply IHT2 with (K:=K) (X:=X).
      * fsetdec. * fsetdec. * exact E2.
Qed.

Lemma sub_antisym : forall E A B, sub E A B -> sub E B A -> A = B.
Proof.
  intros E A B H1. induction H1 as
    [ E0 wfE
    | E0 X wfE Hb
    | E0 A0 wfE WFA
    | E0 A1 A2 B1 B2 s1 IH1 s2 IH2
    | L A1 A2 E0 p1 IH1 p2 IH2 ]; intros H2.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - inversion H2. reflexivity.
  - inversion H2. pose proof (IH1 H4) as E1a. pose proof (IH2 H6) as E2a.
    subst. reflexivity.
  - inversion H2.
    destruct (atom_fresh (L \u L0 \u fv_tt A1 \u fv_tt A2)) as [X HX].
    assert (HXL : X \notin L) by fsetdec.
    assert (HXL0 : X \notin L0) by fsetdec.
    assert (HX1 : X \notin fv_tt A1) by fsetdec.
    assert (HX2 : X \notin fv_tt A2) by fsetdec.
    pose proof (IH1 X HXL (H3 X HXL0)) as Heq.
    assert (A1 = A2).
    { apply (open_tt_rec_inj A1 A2 0 X).
      - exact HX1.
      - exact HX2.
      - unfold open_tt in Heq. exact Heq. }
    subst. reflexivity.
Qed.

Require Import AmberBase.
Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.
Require Import Program.Equality.
Require Import Lia.

Definition env_mode := list ( Mode).

Definition eqMode (a b: Mode)  : bool :=
  match a,b with
  | Pos, Pos => true
  | Neg, Neg => true
  | _,_ => false
  end.

Fixpoint amber_cov (Ea : env_amber) (Em : env_mode) (T:typ) (m:Mode) : typ :=
  match Ea, Em with
  | (X,Y)::E, m'::Em' => if (eqMode m' m) then amber_cov E Em' (subst_tt X Y T) m
                         else amber_cov E Em' T m
  | _,_ => T
  end.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Auxiliary definitions                                              *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint bindsub_atoms (E : env) : atoms :=
  match E with
  | nil => empty
  | (X, bind_sub) :: E' => add X (bindsub_atoms E')
  | (_, bind_typ _) :: E' => bindsub_atoms E'
  end.

Lemma in_bindsub_atoms : forall E X,
  X \in bindsub_atoms E <-> binds X bind_sub E.
Proof.
  induction E as [| [Y b] E IH]; intros X; simpl.
  - unfold binds. simpl. split; intros H.
    + fsetdec.
    + contradiction.
  - destruct b; simpl.
    + unfold binds. simpl.
      rewrite add_iff. rewrite IH.
      split; intros [H|H].
      * left. inversion H. reflexivity.
      * right. assumption.
      * left. inversion H. reflexivity.
      * right. assumption.
    + unfold binds. simpl.
      rewrite IH. split; intros H.
      * right; assumption.
      * destruct H as [H|H]; auto. inversion H.
Qed.

Fixpoint ren_tt (f : atom -> atom) (T : typ) : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_nat => typ_nat
  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar X => typ_fvar (f X)
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (ren_tt f T1) (ren_tt f T2)
  | typ_mu T => typ_mu (ren_tt f T)
  end.

Lemma ren_tt_id : forall T, ren_tt (fun X => X) T = T.
Proof. induction T; simpl; congruence. Qed.

Lemma ren_tt_ext : forall f g T,
  (forall X, X \in fv_tt T -> f X = g X) ->
  ren_tt f T = ren_tt g T.
Proof.
  intros f g T; induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; simpl; intros H.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - f_equal. apply H. simpl. fsetdec.
  - f_equal. apply IHT. intros X HX. apply H. simpl. exact HX.
  - f_equal.
    + apply IHT1. intros X HX. apply H. simpl. fsetdec.
    + apply IHT2. intros X HX. apply H. simpl. fsetdec.
Qed.

Lemma ren_tt_ren : forall f g T,
  ren_tt f (ren_tt g T) = ren_tt (fun X => f (g X)) T.
Proof.
  intros f g T; induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IH1 T2 IH2]; simpl; try reflexivity.
  - f_equal. exact IHT.
  - f_equal; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma ren_tt_open_rec : forall f T K X,
  ren_tt f (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T) =
  open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar (f X)) (ren_tt f T).
Proof.
  intros f T; induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros K X; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (K === n); reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHT. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHT1, IHT2. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ren_tt_open : forall f T X,
  ren_tt f (open_tt T (typ_fvar X)) = open_tt (ren_tt f T) (typ_fvar (f X)).
Proof. intros. unfold open_tt. apply ren_tt_open_rec. Qed.

(* locally closed types *)
Fixpoint lc_rec (d : nat) (T : typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_nat => True
  | typ_bvar J => J < d
  | typ_fvar X => True
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => lc_rec d T1 /\ lc_rec d T2
  | typ_mu T => lc_rec (S d) T
  end.

Definition lc_tt T := lc_rec 0 T.

Lemma lc_open_rec : forall T K X d,
  lc_rec d T -> lc_rec d (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T).
Proof.
  induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros K X d H; simpl in *.
  - exact I.
  - exact I.
  - destruct (K === n).
    + simpl. exact I.
    + simpl. exact H.
  - simpl. exact I.
  - simpl. exact (IHT (S K) X (S d) H).
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. simpl. split.
    + exact (IHT1 K X d H1).
    + exact (IHT2 K X d H2).
Qed.

Lemma lc_open_mu_body : forall T d X,
  lc_rec (S d) T -> lc_rec d (open_tt_rec d (typ_fvar X) T).
Proof.
  induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros d X' H; simpl in *.
  - exact I.
  - exact I.
  - (* bvar *) destruct (d === n).
    + simpl. exact I.
    + simpl. unfold lt in *. lia.
  - exact I.
  - apply IHT. exact H.
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. split.
    + exact (IHT1 d X' H1).
    + exact (IHT2 d X' H2).
Qed.



Lemma lc_open_rec_any : forall T K X, lc_rec K T -> lc_rec K (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T).
Proof.
  induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros K X' H; simpl in *.
  - exact I.
  - exact I.
  - destruct (K === n).
    + simpl. exact I.
    + exact H.
  - exact I.
  - apply IHT. exact H.
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. split.
    + exact (IHT1 K X' H1).
    + exact (IHT2 K X' H2).
Qed.

Lemma lc_open_tt : forall T X, lc_tt T -> lc_tt (open_tt T (typ_fvar X)).
Proof.
  intros T X H. unfold lc_tt, open_tt.
  exact (lc_open_rec_any T 0 X H).
Qed.

(* fv of open *)
Lemma fv_tt_open_rec : forall T K X,
  AtomSetImpl.Subset (fv_tt (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T)) (union (fv_tt T) {{X}}).
Proof.
  induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros K X'; simpl.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - destruct (K === n); simpl; intros z Hz; fsetdec.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - simpl. intros z Hz. exact (IHT (S K) X' z Hz).
  - simpl. intros z Hz. apply union_iff in Hz as [Hz|Hz].
    + pose proof (IHT1 K X' _ Hz). fsetdec.
    + pose proof (IHT2 K X' _ Hz). fsetdec.
Qed.

Lemma fv_tt_open : forall T X,
  AtomSetImpl.Subset (fv_tt (open_tt T (typ_fvar X))) (union (fv_tt T) {{X}}).
Proof. intros. unfold open_tt. apply fv_tt_open_rec. Qed.

Lemma fv_tt_open_upper_rec : forall T K X,
  AtomSetImpl.Subset (fv_tt T) (fv_tt (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T)).
Proof.
  induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros K X'; simpl.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - intros z Hz. exact (IHT (S K) X' z Hz).
  - intros z Hz. apply union_iff in Hz as [Hz|Hz].
    + pose proof (IHT1 K X' z Hz). fsetdec.
    + pose proof (IHT2 K X' z Hz). fsetdec.
Qed.

Lemma fv_tt_open_upper : forall T X,
  AtomSetImpl.Subset (fv_tt T) (fv_tt (open_tt T (typ_fvar X))).
Proof. intros. unfold open_tt. apply fv_tt_open_upper_rec. Qed.

(* ===================== domA lemmas ================================= *)
Lemma in_domA_cons : forall X Y E z,
  z \in domA ((X,Y)::E) <-> z = X \/ z = Y \/ z \in domA E.
Proof.
  intros. simpl. split; intros H; fsetdec.
Qed.

Lemma in_domA_pair_1 : forall E X Y, In (X,Y) E -> X \in domA E.
Proof.
  induction E as [| [a b] E IH]; intros X Y Hin; simpl in *.
  - contradiction.
  - destruct Hin as [Hin|Hin].
    + inversion Hin; subst. apply in_domA_cons. left. reflexivity.
    + apply in_domA_cons. right. right. exact (IH X Y Hin).
Qed.

Lemma in_domA_pair_2 : forall E X Y, In (X,Y) E -> Y \in domA E.
Proof.
  induction E as [| [a b] E IH]; intros X Y Hin; simpl in *.
  - contradiction.
  - destruct Hin as [Hin|Hin].
    + inversion Hin; subst. apply in_domA_cons. right. left. reflexivity.
    + apply in_domA_cons. right. right. exact (IH X Y Hin).
Qed.

Lemma domA_member : forall E X,
  X \in domA E -> exists Y, In (X,Y) E \/ In (Y,X) E.
Proof.
  induction E as [| [a b] E IH]; intros X H; simpl in *.
  - fsetdec.
  - apply in_domA_cons in H. destruct H as [H|[H|H]].
    + subst. exists b. left. left. reflexivity.
    + subst. exists a. right. left. reflexivity.
    + apply IH in H. destruct H as [Y [HY|HY]].
      * exists Y. left. right. exact HY.
      * exists Y. right. right. exact HY.
Qed.

(* ===================== wf_amber from lc and fv ==================== *)


(* ============== sub implies WF on both sides ====================== *)
Lemma sub_wf : forall E A B, sub E A B -> WF E A /\ WF E B.
Proof.
  intros E A B H.
  induction H as
    [ E wfE
    | E X wfE Hb
    | E A0 wfE WFA
    | E A1 A2 B1 B2 s1 IH1 s2 IH2
    | L A1 A2 E p1 IH1 p2 IH2 ].
  - split; apply WF_nat.
  - split; apply WF_fvar; exact Hb.
  - split; [ exact WFA | apply WF_top ].
  - split; apply WF_arrow.
    + exact (proj2 IH1).
    + exact (proj1 IH2).
    + exact (proj1 IH1).
    + exact (proj2 IH2).
  - split; apply WF_rec with (L:=L).
    + intros X HX. exact (proj1 (IH1 X HX)).
    + intros X HX. exact (proj1 (IH2 X HX)).
    + intros X HX. exact (proj2 (IH1 X HX)).
    + intros X HX. exact (proj2 (IH2 X HX)).
Qed.

(* ============== WF renames to wf_amber ============================ *)
Lemma wf_amber_ren : forall E A, WF E A ->
  forall (f : atom -> atom) (Ea : env_amber),
  wfe_amber Ea ->
  (forall X, binds X bind_sub E -> f X \in domA Ea) ->
  AtomSetImpl.Subset (fv_tt A) (bindsub_atoms E) ->
  wf_amber Ea (ren_tt f A).
Proof.
  intros E A H. induction H as
    [ E
    | E
    | X E Hb
    | E A1 A2 WF1 IH1 WF2 IH2
    | L E A0 p1 IH1 p2 IH2 ]; intros f Ea Hwe Hcorr Hfv.
  - apply wfa_top. exact Hwe.
  - apply wfa_nat. exact Hwe.
  - simpl. pose proof (Hcorr X Hb) as Hd.
    pose proof (domA_member Ea (f X) Hd) as [Y [HY|HY]].
    + exact (wfa_fvarl Ea (f X) Y HY Hwe).
    + exact (wfa_fvarr Ea Y (f X) HY Hwe).
  - simpl. apply wfa_arrow.
    + apply IH1; auto. intros z Hz. apply Hfv. simpl. fsetdec.
    + apply IH2; auto. intros z Hz. apply Hfv. simpl. fsetdec.
  - simpl.
    apply wfa_rec with (L := domA Ea).
    intros X Y HX HY.
    destruct (atom_fresh (L \u fv_tt A0)) as [Z HZ].
    assert (HZL : Z \notin L) by (fsetdec).
    assert (HZfv : Z \notin fv_tt A0) by (fsetdec).
    assert (Hwe' : wfe_amber ((X,Y)::Ea)).
    { apply wfea_cons. exact HX. fsetdec. exact Hwe. }
    set (f' := fun W => if W == Z then X else f W).
    assert (Hcorr' : forall W, binds W bind_sub (Z ~ bind_sub ++ E) -> f' W \in domA ((X,Y)::Ea)).
    { intros W HW. unfold f'. destruct (W == Z) as [Heq|Hneq].
      - subst W. apply in_domA_cons. left. reflexivity.
      - apply in_domA_cons. right. right. apply Hcorr. unfold binds in *.
        simpl in HW. destruct HW as [HW|HW].
        + inversion HW. subst. exfalso. apply Hneq. reflexivity.
        + exact HW. }
    assert (Hfv' : AtomSetImpl.Subset (fv_tt (open_tt A0 (typ_fvar Z))) (bindsub_atoms (Z ~ bind_sub ++ E))).
    { intros w Hw. pose proof (fv_tt_open A0 Z w Hw) as Hw2.
      apply union_iff in Hw2 as [Hw2|Hw2].
      - simpl. rewrite add_iff. right. apply Hfv. exact Hw2.
      - assert (w = Z) by fsetdec. subst w. simpl. rewrite add_iff. left. reflexivity. }
    pose proof (IH1 Z HZL f' ((X,Y)::Ea) Hwe' Hcorr' Hfv') as Hwf.
    assert (Hren : ren_tt f' (open_tt A0 (typ_fvar Z)) = open_tt (ren_tt f A0) (typ_fvar X)).
    { rewrite ren_tt_open. f_equal.
      - apply ren_tt_ext. intros W HW. unfold f'.
        destruct (W == Z) as [Heq|Hneq].
        + subst W. exfalso. apply HZfv. exact HW.
        + reflexivity.
      - unfold f'. rewrite eq_dec_refl. reflexivity. }
    rewrite Hren in Hwf. exact Hwf.
Qed.
Lemma wf_fv_bindsub : forall E A, WF E A ->
  AtomSetImpl.Subset (fv_tt A) (bindsub_atoms E).
Proof.
  intros E A H. induction H as
    [ E
    | E
    | X E Hb
    | E A1 A2 WF1 IH1 WF2 IH2
    | L E A0 p1 IH1 p2 IH2 ].
  - simpl. intros x Hx. fsetdec.
  - simpl. intros x Hx. fsetdec.
  - simpl. intros x Hx.
    assert (x = X) by fsetdec.
    subst. apply in_bindsub_atoms. exact Hb.
  - simpl. intros x Hx. apply union_iff in Hx as [Hx|Hx].
    + apply IH1. exact Hx.
    + apply IH2. exact Hx.
  - simpl.
    destruct (atom_fresh (L \u fv_tt A0)) as [X HX].
    assert (HXL : X \notin L) by fsetdec.
    assert (HXfv : X \notin fv_tt A0) by fsetdec.
    intros Y HY.
    pose proof (IH1 X HXL) as Hsub.
    pose proof (fv_tt_open_upper A0 X Y HY) as HYopen.
    pose proof (Hsub Y HYopen) as HYenv.
    simpl in HYenv. rewrite add_iff in HYenv.
    destruct HYenv as [Heq|Hin].
    + exfalso. subst Y. exact (HXfv HY).
    + exact Hin.
Qed.

(* ============== per-atom origin translation ======================= *)
Definition pick (o : atom -> bool) (f g : atom -> atom) : atom -> atom :=
  fun X => if o X then f X else g X.

Definition ren_pick (o : atom -> bool) (f g : atom -> atom) (T : typ) : typ :=
  ren_tt (pick o f g) T.

Lemma ren_pick_id : forall o T,
  ren_pick o (fun X => X) (fun X => X) T = T.
Proof.
  intros o T. unfold ren_pick.
  transitivity (ren_tt (fun X => X) T).
  - apply ren_tt_ext.
    intros X HX. unfold pick. destruct (o X); reflexivity.
  - apply ren_tt_id.
Qed.

(* compatibility: for every matched atom occurrence, the origins must be
   (false,true) at negative polarity or (true,false) at positive polarity *)
Fixpoint compat (o1 o2 : atom -> bool) (pol : bool) (A B : typ) : Prop :=
  match A, B with
  | typ_fvar X, typ_fvar Y =>
      if X == Y then
        (if o1 X then (if o2 X then False else pol = true)
                   else (if o2 X then pol = false else False))
      else True
  | typ_arrow A1 A2, typ_arrow B1 B2 =>
      compat o1 o2 (negb pol) A1 B1 /\ compat o1 o2 pol A2 B2
  | typ_mu A1, typ_mu B1 => compat o1 o2 pol A1 B1
  | _,_ => True
  end.

Lemma compat_closed : forall A B o1 o2 pol,
  (forall X, X \notin fv_tt A) ->
  (forall X, X \notin fv_tt B) ->
  compat o1 o2 pol A B.
Proof.
  induction A as [| |n|x|T IHT|A1 IHA1 A2 IHA2];
    intros B o1 o2 pol HA HB;
    destruct B as [| |m|y|BT|B1 B2]; simpl; try tauto.
  - exfalso. apply (HA x). simpl. fsetdec.
  - apply (IHT BT o1 o2 pol).
    + intros X HX. assert (Hin : X \in fv_tt (typ_mu T)). { simpl. exact HX. }
      exact (HA X Hin).
    + intros X HX. assert (Hin : X \in fv_tt (typ_mu BT)). { simpl. exact HX. }
      exact (HB X Hin).
  - split.
    + apply (IHA1 B1 o1 o2 (negb pol)).
      * intros X HX. assert (Hin : X \in fv_tt (typ_arrow A1 A2)). { simpl. fsetdec. }
        exact (HA X Hin).
      * intros X HX. assert (Hin : X \in fv_tt (typ_arrow B1 B2)). { simpl. fsetdec. }
        exact (HB X Hin).
    + apply (IHA2 B2 o1 o2 pol).

Require Import AmberBase.
Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.
Require Import Program.Equality.
Require Import Lia.

Definition env_mode := list ( Mode).

Definition eqMode (a b: Mode)  : bool :=
  match a,b with
  | Pos, Pos => true
  | Neg, Neg => true
  | _,_ => false
  end.

Fixpoint amber_cov (Ea : env_amber) (Em : env_mode) (T:typ) (m:Mode) : typ :=
  match Ea, Em with
  | (X,Y)::E, m'::Em' => if (eqMode m' m) then amber_cov E Em' (subst_tt X Y T) m
                         else amber_cov E Em' T m
  | _,_ => T
  end.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Auxiliary definitions                                              *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint bindsub_atoms (E : env) : atoms :=
  match E with
  | nil => empty
  | (X, bind_sub) :: E' => add X (bindsub_atoms E')
  | (_, bind_typ _) :: E' => bindsub_atoms E'
  end.

Lemma in_bindsub_atoms : forall E X,
  X \in bindsub_atoms E <-> binds X bind_sub E.
Proof.
  induction E as [| [Y b] E IH]; intros X; simpl.
  - unfold binds. simpl. split; intros H.
    + fsetdec.
    + contradiction.
  - destruct b; simpl.
    + unfold binds. simpl.
      rewrite add_iff. rewrite IH.
      split; intros [H|H].
      * left. inversion H. reflexivity.
      * right. assumption.
      * left. inversion H. reflexivity.
      * right. assumption.
    + unfold binds. simpl.
      rewrite IH. split; intros H.
      * right; assumption.
      * destruct H as [H|H]; auto. inversion H.
Qed.

Fixpoint ren_tt (f : atom -> atom) (T : typ) : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_nat => typ_nat
  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar X => typ_fvar (f X)
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (ren_tt f T1) (ren_tt f T2)
  | typ_mu T => typ_mu (ren_tt f T)
  end.

Lemma ren_tt_id : forall T, ren_tt (fun X => X) T = T.
Proof. induction T; simpl; congruence. Qed.

Lemma ren_tt_ext : forall f g T,
  (forall X, X \in fv_tt T -> f X = g X) ->
  ren_tt f T = ren_tt g T.
Proof.
  intros f g T; induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; simpl; intros H.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - f_equal. apply H. simpl. fsetdec.
  - f_equal. apply IHT. intros X HX. apply H. simpl. exact HX.
  - f_equal.
    + apply IHT1. intros X HX. apply H. simpl. fsetdec.
    + apply IHT2. intros X HX. apply H. simpl. fsetdec.
Qed.

Lemma ren_tt_ren : forall f g T,
  ren_tt f (ren_tt g T) = ren_tt (fun X => f (g X)) T.
Proof.
  intros f g T; induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IH1 T2 IH2]; simpl; try reflexivity.
  - f_equal. exact IHT.
  - f_equal; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma ren_tt_open_rec : forall f T K X,
  ren_tt f (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T) =
  open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar (f X)) (ren_tt f T).
Proof.
  intros f T; induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros K X; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (K === n); reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHT. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHT1, IHT2. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ren_tt_open : forall f T X,
  ren_tt f (open_tt T (typ_fvar X)) = open_tt (ren_tt f T) (typ_fvar (f X)).
Proof. intros. unfold open_tt. apply ren_tt_open_rec. Qed.

(* locally closed types *)
Fixpoint lc_rec (d : nat) (T : typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_nat => True
  | typ_bvar J => J < d
  | typ_fvar X => True
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => lc_rec d T1 /\ lc_rec d T2
  | typ_mu T => lc_rec (S d) T
  end.

Definition lc_tt T := lc_rec 0 T.

Lemma lc_open_rec : forall T K X d,
  lc_rec d T -> lc_rec d (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T).
Proof.
  induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros K X d H; simpl in *.
  - exact I.
  - exact I.
  - destruct (K === n).
    + simpl. exact I.
    + simpl. exact H.
  - simpl. exact I.
  - simpl. exact (IHT (S K) X (S d) H).
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. simpl. split.
    + exact (IHT1 K X d H1).
    + exact (IHT2 K X d H2).
Qed.

Lemma lc_open_mu_body : forall T d X,
  lc_rec (S d) T -> lc_rec d (open_tt_rec d (typ_fvar X) T).
Proof.
  induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros d X' H; simpl in *.
  - exact I.
  - exact I.
  - (* bvar *) destruct (d === n).
    + simpl. exact I.
    + simpl. unfold lt in *. lia.
  - exact I.
  - apply IHT. exact H.
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. split.
    + exact (IHT1 d X' H1).
    + exact (IHT2 d X' H2).
Qed.



Lemma lc_open_rec_any : forall T K X, lc_rec K T -> lc_rec K (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T).
Proof.
  induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros K X' H; simpl in *.
  - exact I.
  - exact I.
  - destruct (K === n).
    + simpl. exact I.
    + exact H.
  - exact I.
  - apply IHT. exact H.
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. split.
    + exact (IHT1 K X' H1).
    + exact (IHT2 K X' H2).
Qed.

Lemma lc_open_tt : forall T X, lc_tt T -> lc_tt (open_tt T (typ_fvar X)).
Proof.
  intros T X H. unfold lc_tt, open_tt.
  exact (lc_open_rec_any T 0 X H).
Qed.

(* fv of open *)
Lemma fv_tt_open_rec : forall T K X,
  AtomSetImpl.Subset (fv_tt (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T)) (union (fv_tt T) {{X}}).
Proof.
  induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros K X'; simpl.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - destruct (K === n); simpl; intros z Hz; fsetdec.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - simpl. intros z Hz. exact (IHT (S K) X' z Hz).
  - simpl. intros z Hz. apply union_iff in Hz as [Hz|Hz].
    + pose proof (IHT1 K X' _ Hz). fsetdec.
    + pose proof (IHT2 K X' _ Hz). fsetdec.
Qed.

Lemma fv_tt_open : forall T X,
  AtomSetImpl.Subset (fv_tt (open_tt T (typ_fvar X))) (union (fv_tt T) {{X}}).
Proof. intros. unfold open_tt. apply fv_tt_open_rec. Qed.

Lemma fv_tt_open_upper_rec : forall T K X,
  AtomSetImpl.Subset (fv_tt T) (fv_tt (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T)).
Proof.
  induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros K X'; simpl.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - intros z Hz. fsetdec.
  - intros z Hz. exact (IHT (S K) X' z Hz).
  - intros z Hz. apply union_iff in Hz as [Hz|Hz].
    + pose proof (IHT1 K X' z Hz). fsetdec.
    + pose proof (IHT2 K X' z Hz). fsetdec.
Qed.

Lemma fv_tt_open_upper : forall T X,
  AtomSetImpl.Subset (fv_tt T) (fv_tt (open_tt T (typ_fvar X))).
Proof. intros. unfold open_tt. apply fv_tt_open_upper_rec. Qed.

(* ===================== domA lemmas ================================= *)
Lemma in_domA_cons : forall X Y E z,
  z \in domA ((X,Y)::E) <-> z = X \/ z = Y \/ z \in domA E.
Proof.
  intros. simpl. split; intros H; fsetdec.
Qed.

Lemma in_domA_pair_1 : forall E X Y, In (X,Y) E -> X \in domA E.
Proof.
  induction E as [| [a b] E IH]; intros X Y Hin; simpl in *.
  - contradiction.
  - destruct Hin as [Hin|Hin].
    + inversion Hin; subst. apply in_domA_cons. left. reflexivity.
    + apply in_domA_cons. right. right. exact (IH X Y Hin).
Qed.

Lemma in_domA_pair_2 : forall E X Y, In (X,Y) E -> Y \in domA E.
Proof.
  induction E as [| [a b] E IH]; intros X Y Hin; simpl in *.
  - contradiction.
  - destruct Hin as [Hin|Hin].
    + inversion Hin; subst. apply in_domA_cons. right. left. reflexivity.
    + apply in_domA_cons. right. right. exact (IH X Y Hin).
Qed.

Lemma domA_member : forall E X,
  X \in domA E -> exists Y, In (X,Y) E \/ In (Y,X) E.
Proof.
  induction E as [| [a b] E IH]; intros X H; simpl in *.
  - fsetdec.
  - apply in_domA_cons in H. destruct H as [H|[H|H]].
    + subst. exists b. left. left. reflexivity.
    + subst. exists a. right. left. reflexivity.
    + apply IH in H. destruct H as [Y [HY|HY]].
      * exists Y. left. right. exact HY.
      * exists Y. right. right. exact HY.
Qed.

(* ===================== wf_amber from lc and fv ==================== *)


(* ============== sub implies WF on both sides ====================== *)
Lemma sub_wf : forall E A B, sub E A B -> WF E A /\ WF E B.
Proof.
  intros E A B H.
  induction H as
    [ E wfE
    | E X wfE Hb
    | E A0 wfE WFA
    | E A1 A2 B1 B2 s1 IH1 s2 IH2
    | L A1 A2 E p1 IH1 p2 IH2 ].
  - split; apply WF_nat.
  - split; apply WF_fvar; exact Hb.
  - split; [ exact WFA | apply WF_top ].
  - split; apply WF_arrow.
    + exact (proj2 IH1).
    + exact (proj1 IH2).
    + exact (proj1 IH1).
    + exact (proj2 IH2).
  - split; apply WF_rec with (L:=L).
    + intros X HX. exact (proj1 (IH1 X HX)).
    + intros X HX. exact (proj1 (IH2 X HX)).
    + intros X HX. exact (proj2 (IH1 X HX)).
    + intros X HX. exact (proj2 (IH2 X HX)).
Qed.

(* ============== WF renames to wf_amber ============================ *)
Lemma wf_amber_ren : forall E A, WF E A ->
  forall (f : atom -> atom) (Ea : env_amber),
  wfe_amber Ea ->
  (forall X, binds X bind_sub E -> f X \in domA Ea) ->
  AtomSetImpl.Subset (fv_tt A) (bindsub_atoms E) ->
  wf_amber Ea (ren_tt f A).
Proof.
  intros E A H. induction H as
    [ E
    | E
    | X E Hb
    | E A1 A2 WF1 IH1 WF2 IH2
    | L E A0 p1 IH1 p2 IH2 ]; intros f Ea Hwe Hcorr Hfv.
  - apply wfa_top. exact Hwe.
  - apply wfa_nat. exact Hwe.
  - simpl. pose proof (Hcorr X Hb) as Hd.
    pose proof (domA_member Ea (f X) Hd) as [Y [HY|HY]].
    + exact (wfa_fvarl Ea (f X) Y HY Hwe).
    + exact (wfa_fvarr Ea Y (f X) HY Hwe).
  - simpl. apply wfa_arrow.
    + apply IH1; auto. intros z Hz. apply Hfv. simpl. fsetdec.
    + apply IH2; auto. intros z Hz. apply Hfv. simpl. fsetdec.
  - simpl.
    apply wfa_rec with (L := domA Ea).
    intros X Y HX HY.
    destruct (atom_fresh (L \u fv_tt A0)) as [Z HZ].
    assert (HZL : Z \notin L) by (fsetdec).
    assert (HZfv : Z \notin fv_tt A0) by (fsetdec).
    assert (Hwe' : wfe_amber ((X,Y)::Ea)).
    { apply wfea_cons. exact HX. fsetdec. exact Hwe. }
    set (f' := fun W => if W == Z then X else f W).
    assert (Hcorr' : forall W, binds W bind_sub (Z ~ bind_sub ++ E) -> f' W \in domA ((X,Y)::Ea)).
    { intros W HW. unfold f'. destruct (W == Z) as [Heq|Hneq].
      - subst W. apply in_domA_cons. left. reflexivity.
      - apply in_domA_cons. right. right. apply Hcorr. unfold binds in *.
        simpl in HW. destruct HW as [HW|HW].
        + inversion HW. subst. exfalso. apply Hneq. reflexivity.
        + exact HW. }
    assert (Hfv' : AtomSetImpl.Subset (fv_tt (open_tt A0 (typ_fvar Z))) (bindsub_atoms (Z ~ bind_sub ++ E))).
    { intros w Hw. pose proof (fv_tt_open A0 Z w Hw) as Hw2.
      apply union_iff in Hw2 as [Hw2|Hw2].
      - simpl. rewrite add_iff. right. apply Hfv. exact Hw2.
      - assert (w = Z) by fsetdec. subst w. simpl. rewrite add_iff. left. reflexivity. }

    assert (Hren : ren_tt f' (open_tt A0 (typ_fvar Z)) = open_tt (ren_tt f A0) (typ_fvar X)).

Lemma wf_fv_bindsub : forall E A, WF E A ->
  AtomSetImpl.Subset (fv_tt A) (bindsub_atoms E).
Proof.
  intros E A H. induction H as
    [ E
    | E
    | X E Hb
    | E A1 A2 WF1 IH1 WF2 IH2
    | L E A0 p1 IH1 p2 IH2 ].
  - simpl. intros x Hx. fsetdec.
  - simpl. intros x Hx. fsetdec.
  - simpl. intros x Hx.
    assert (x = X) by fsetdec.
    subst. apply in_bindsub_atoms. exact Hb.
  - simpl. intros x Hx. apply union_iff in Hx as [Hx|Hx].
    + apply IH1. exact Hx.
    + apply IH2. exact Hx.
  - simpl.

    assert (HXL : X \notin L) by fsetdec.
    assert (HXfv : X \notin fv_tt A0) by fsetdec.
    intros Y HY.
    pose proof (IH1 X HXL) as Hsub.
    pose proof (fv_tt_open_upper A0 X Y HY) as HYopen.
    pose proof (Hsub Y HYopen) as HYenv.
    simpl in HYenv. rewrite add_iff in HYenv.
    destruct HYenv as [Heq|Hin].
