(* Reversed joint projection.  It is the companion-orientation mirror  *)
(* of compose_pullback_self.  It follows immediately from the original *)
(* engine by exchanging the roles of S and U: the companion hypothesis *)
(* of the original at (U, S) is exactly the reversed companion at      *)
(* (S, U), and the [mpar] branch is then already the required mirror.  *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
Lemma compose_pullback_self_rev : forall p T,
  mocc p T T ->
  forall E W S U,
    lc_tt S -> lc_tt U ->
    sub E T T ->
    sub E (subst_tt W U T) (subst_tt W S T) ->
    forall L0 : atoms,
    exists ats Ecur A,
      Ecur = atoms_env ats E /\
      (forall Z, In Z ats -> Z \notin L0 /\ Z <> W) /\
      follow ats p T T = Some (A, A) /\
      sub Ecur A A /\
      (if mpar p
       then sub Ecur (subst_tt W S A) (subst_tt W U A)
       else sub Ecur (subst_tt W U A) (subst_tt W S A)).
Proof.
  intros p T Hmo E W S U HlcS HlcU Hself Hcomp L0.
  destruct (compose_pullback_self p T Hmo E W U S HlcU HlcS Hself Hcomp L0)
    as [ats [Ecur [A [HEq [Hfresh [Hfollow [HselfA HcompA]]]]]]].
  exists ats, Ecur, A. split; [exact HEq|]. split; [exact Hfresh|].
  split; [exact Hfollow|]. split; [exact HselfA|]. exact HcompA.
Qed.

(* orientation of the companion at T0.  The proof splits on [par].     *)
(* The par = false branch is the untangled corollary.  In the par =    *)
(* true branch the reversed engine projects the companion; at the      *)
(* selected leaf its orientation is flipped by [mpar p], so the        *)
(* battery is applied with parity [negb (mpar p)] in order to match    *)
(* the leaf companion premise.  The forward derivation sub S U is      *)
(* always used in the same direction (lifted by sub_mono).             *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
Theorem deep_equal_mu_excluded_path_par :
  forall E C Z W S U (T0 : typ) (p : mpath) (B0 : typ) (par : bool),
    bindsub_only (Z ~ bind_sub ++ E) ->
    wf_env (Z ~ bind_sub ++ E) ->
    lc_tt S -> lc_tt U -> S <> U ->
    W <> Z -> Z \notin fv_tt C -> W \in fv_tt C ->
    T0 = open_tt C (open_tt C (typ_fvar Z)) ->
    sub (Z ~ bind_sub ++ E) T0 T0 ->
    (if par
     then sub (Z ~ bind_sub ++ E) (subst_tt W U T0) (subst_tt W S T0)
     else sub (Z ~ bind_sub ++ E) (subst_tt W S T0) (subst_tt W U T0)) ->
    sub (Z ~ bind_sub ++ E) S U ->
    at_path p T0 (typ_mu B0) ->
    bvoccT true 0 B0 ->
    W \in fv_tt B0 ->
    False.
Proof.
  intros E C Z W S U T0 p B0 par Hbs Hwf HlcS HlcU Hne HWZ HZC HWC HT0
         Hself Hcomp Hfwd Hpath Hb HbW.
  destruct par; simpl in Hcomp.
  - (* par = true : reversed companion at T0 *)

Require Import TaskBase8.
Require Import AmberBase.
Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.
Require Import Program.Equality.
Require Import Lia.
Require Import Deep.
Require Import Deep2.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Deep3: syntactic search, frozen predicate, and the Assembly plug.   *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Decidable tests.                                                    *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma fv_dec : forall (W : atom) (T : typ),
  {W \in fv_tt T} + {~ W \in fv_tt T}.
Proof.
  intros W T.
  destruct (AtomSetImpl.mem W (fv_tt T)) eqn:E.
  - left. apply AtomSetImpl.mem_2. exact E.
  - right. intro H. apply AtomSetImpl.mem_1 in H. rewrite H in E. discriminate E.
Qed.

Lemma outer_occ_sumbool : forall K T,
  {(exists q, bvoccT q K T)} + {~ (exists q, bvoccT q K T)}.
Proof.
  intros K T.
  destruct (bvoccT_dec true K T) as [H|H].
  - left. exists true. exact H.
  - destruct (bvoccT_dec false K T) as [H0|H0].
    + left. exists false. exact H0.
    + right. intros [q Hq]. destruct q.
      * exact (H Hq).
      * exact (H0 Hq).
Qed.

(* [bad_at W K D] says D is a mu body with the odd own-binder occurrence *)
(* and either W free in D or an occurrence of the outer binder at the   *)
(* depth one below the current absolute depth [K].                      *)
Definition bad_at (W : atom) (K : nat) (D : typ) : Prop :=
  bvoccT true 0 D /\
  (W \in fv_tt D \/ (exists q, bvoccT q (S K) D)).

Lemma bad_at_dec : forall W K D,
  {bad_at W K D} + {~ bad_at W K D}.
Proof.
  intros W K D. unfold bad_at.
  destruct (bvoccT_dec true 0 D) as [Hb|Hb].
  - destruct (fv_dec W D) as [Hf|Hf].
    + left. split; [exact Hb|left; exact Hf].
    + destruct (outer_occ_sumbool (S K) D) as [Ho|Ho].
      * left. split; [exact Hb|right; exact Ho].
      * right. intros [Hb' [Hf'|Ho']].
        -- exact (Hf Hf').
        -- exact (Ho Ho').
  - right. intros [Hb' _]. exact (Hb Hb').
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Syntactic search.  [K] is the absolute depth (number of mu          *)
(* constructors outside the current subterm).  A bad mu at the current *)
(* node is returned with the context relative to the searched term;    *)
(* the absolute depth of the returned leaf is K + ctx_depth c.         *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
Fixpoint find_bad (C : typ) (W : atom) (K : nat) {struct C}
  : option (tctx * typ) :=
  match C with
  | typ_top => None
  | typ_nat => None
  | typ_bvar _ => None
  | typ_fvar _ => None
  | typ_arrow A B =>
      match find_bad A W K with
      | Some (c, D) => Some (tc_arrow_l c B, D)
      | None =>
          match find_bad B W K with
          | Some (c, D) => Some (tc_arrow_r A c, D)
          | None => None
          end
      end
  | typ_mu Dbody =>
      if bad_at_dec W K Dbody
      then Some (tc_hole, Dbody)
      else
        match find_bad Dbody W (S K) with
        | Some (c, D) => Some (tc_mu c, D)
        | None => None
        end
  end.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Soundness.                                                          *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
Lemma find_bad_sound : forall C W K c D,
  find_bad C W K = Some (c, D) ->
  C = plug c (typ_mu D) /\ bad_at W (K + ctx_depth c) D.
Proof.
  induction C as [| |n|X|Dbody IHD|A IHA B IHB];
    intros W K c D H; simpl in H.
  - discriminate H.
  - discriminate H.
  - discriminate H.
  - discriminate H.
  - (* mu *)
    destruct (bad_at_dec W K Dbody) as [Hb|Hb]; simpl in H.
    + injection H as Hc HD. subst c D.
      split; [reflexivity|]. simpl.
      replace (K + 0) with K by lia. exact Hb.
    + destruct (find_bad Dbody W (S K)) as [[c0 D0]|] eqn:E; simpl in H.
      * injection H as Hc HD. subst c D.
        destruct (IHD W (S K) c0 D0 E) as [HEq Hbad].
        split.
        -- simpl. rewrite HEq. reflexivity.
        -- simpl. replace (K + S (ctx_depth c0)) with (S K + ctx_depth c0) by lia.
           exact Hbad.
      * discriminate H.
  - (* arrow A B *)
    destruct (find_bad A W K) as [[c0 D0]|] eqn:EA; simpl in H.
    + injection H as Hc HD. subst c D.
      destruct (IHA W K c0 D0 EA) as [HEq Hbad].
      split.
      * simpl. rewrite HEq. reflexivity.
      * simpl. exact Hbad.
    + destruct (find_bad B W K) as [[c0 D0]|] eqn:EB; simpl in H.
      * injection H as Hc HD. subst c D.
        destruct (IHB W K c0 D0 EB) as [HEq Hbad].
        split.
        -- simpl. rewrite HEq. reflexivity.
        -- simpl. exact Hbad.
      * discriminate H.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* The frozen predicate: at absolute depth [K] no mu subterm is bad.   *)
(* At a mu node this means exactly: the body is not [bad_at W K] and   *)
(* the body is frozen at depth S K.  Arrows preserve the depth.        *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
Fixpoint frozen_under (C : typ) (W : atom) (K : nat) : Prop :=
  match C with
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_nat => True
  | typ_bvar _ => True
  | typ_fvar _ => True
  | typ_arrow A B => frozen_under A W K /\ frozen_under B W K
  | typ_mu Dbody => ~ bad_at W K Dbody /\ frozen_under Dbody W (S K)
  end.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* None case: no bad leaf means frozen everywhere.                     *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
Lemma find_bad_none_frozen : forall C W K,
  find_bad C W K = None -> frozen_under C W K.
Proof.
  induction C as [| |n|X|Dbody IHD|A IHA B IHB]; intros W K H; simpl in H.
  - simpl. exact I.
  - simpl. exact I.
  - simpl. exact I.
  - simpl. exact I.
  - (* mu *)
    destruct (bad_at_dec W K Dbody) as [Hb|Hb]; simpl in H.
    + discriminate H.
    + destruct (find_bad Dbody W (S K)) as [[c0 D0]|] eqn:E; simpl in H.
      * discriminate H.
      * simpl. split; [exact Hb|]. apply IHD. exact H.
  - (* arrow *)
    destruct (find_bad A W K) as [[c0 D0]|] eqn:EA; simpl in H.
    + discriminate H.
    + destruct (find_bad B W K) as [[c0 D0]|] eqn:EB; simpl in H.
      * discriminate H.
      * simpl. split.
        -- apply IHA. exact EA.
        -- apply IHB. exact EB.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Frozen-at-depth interface: every context decomposition of a bad mu  *)
(* is excluded at the corresponding absolute depth.                    *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
Lemma frozen_under_bad_leaf : forall C W K c D,
  frozen_under C W K ->
  C = plug c (typ_mu D) ->
  ~ bad_at W (K + ctx_depth c) D.
Proof.

  Fixpoint pok (P:nat->bool) (d:nat) (q:bool) (C:typ) : Prop :=
    match C with
    | typ_bvar n => if n < d then True else q = negb (P (n-d))
    | typ_top => True | typ_nat => True | typ_fvar _ => True

(* WF is monotone in the bind_sub part of the environment. *)
Lemma wf_mono : forall E A, WF E A ->
  forall E',
    (forall X, binds X bind_sub E -> binds X bind_sub E') ->
    WF E' A.
Proof.
  intros E A H. induction H as
    [ E0 | E0 | X E0 Hb | E0 A1 A2 W1 IH1 W2 IH2
    | L E0 A0 p1 IH1 p2 IH2 ]; intros E' Hle.
  - apply WF_top.
  - apply WF_nat.
  - apply WF_fvar. exact (Hle X Hb).
  - apply WF_arrow.
    + apply IH1. exact Hle.
    + apply IH2. exact Hle.
  - apply WF_rec with (L := L).
    + intros Y HY. apply (IH1 Y HY (Y ~ bind_sub ++ E')).
      intros Z HZ. unfold binds in *. simpl in *.
      destruct HZ as [Heq|HZ].
      * left. exact Heq.
      * right. exact (Hle Z HZ).
    + intros Y HY. apply (IH2 Y HY (Y ~ bind_sub ++ E')).
      intros Z HZ. unfold binds in *. simpl in *.
      destruct HZ as [Heq|HZ].
      * left. exact Heq.
      * right. exact (Hle Z HZ).
Qed.

(* ===== derivation-position pull-back (arrow segment) ===== *)
(* ================================================================== *)
(* Arrow-only positions and derivation pull-back.                      *)
(* A path is a list of arrow domain/codomain steps.  [par] is the      *)
(* parity: true means an odd number of domain steps.                   *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive apath : Set :=
| a_here : apath
| a_dom : apath -> apath
| a_cod : apath -> apath.

Fixpoint apar (rho : apath) : bool :=
  match rho with
  | a_here => false
  | a_dom rho' => negb (apar rho')
  | a_cod rho' => apar rho'
  end.

(* Original-orientation occurrence.  At a domain step the child leaf is
   recorded swapped, so the head leaf (A,B) is always in the original
   (U,V) orientation. *)
Inductive oat : apath -> typ -> typ -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| oat_here : forall A B, oat a_here A B A B
| oat_cod : forall rho U1 U2 V1 V2 A B,
    oat rho U2 V2 A B ->
    oat (a_cod rho) (typ_arrow U1 U2) (typ_arrow V1 V2) A B
| oat_dom : forall rho U1 U2 V1 V2 A B,
    oat rho V1 U1 B A ->
    oat (a_dom rho) (typ_arrow U1 U2) (typ_arrow V1 V2) A B.

(* The pull-back: the subderivation at the leaf, in the direction fixed
   by the path parity. *)
Lemma sub_oat_par : forall rho E U V, sub E U V ->
  forall A B, oat rho U V A B ->
  if apar rho then sub E B A else sub E A B.
Proof.
  intros rho E U V D A B Hat. revert E D.
  induction Hat as
    [ A0 B0
    | rho U1 U2 V1 V2 A0 B0 Hchild IH
    | rho U1 U2 V1 V2 A0 B0 Hchild IH ];
    intros E D.
  - simpl. exact D.
  - simpl.
    destruct (inv_arrow_l E U1 U2 (typ_arrow V1 V2) D) as
        [[Heq _] | [C1 [C2 [Heq [H1 H2]]]]].
    + discriminate Heq.
    + inversion Heq; subst. apply IH. exact H2.
  - simpl.
    destruct (inv_arrow_l E U1 U2 (typ_arrow V1 V2) D) as
        [[Heq _] | [C1 [C2 [Heq [H1 H2]]]]].
    + discriminate Heq.
    + inversion Heq; subst.
      specialize (IH E H1).
      destruct (apar rho); simpl in *; assumption.
Qed.

(* Substituted occurrence: the two sides are substituted by possibly
   different types S and T.  At a domain step both the side orientation
   and the substitution types swap. *)
Inductive oatS : apath -> typ -> typ -> typ -> typ -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| oatS_here : forall S T A B, oatS a_here S T A B A B
| oatS_cod : forall rho S T U1 U2 V1 V2 A B,
    oatS rho S T U2 V2 A B ->
    oatS (a_cod rho) S T (typ_arrow U1 U2) (typ_arrow V1 V2) A B
| oatS_dom : forall rho S T U1 U2 V1 V2 A B,
    oatS rho T S V1 U1 B A ->
    oatS (a_dom rho) S T (typ_arrow U1 U2) (typ_arrow V1 V2) A B.

(* Pull-back through a substitution: from a derivation of the substituted
   types, the leaf comparison is the substituted leaf, with the direction
   flipped by parity. *)
Lemma sub_oatS_par : forall rho S T E W U V,
  sub E (subst_tt W S U) (subst_tt W T V) ->
  forall A B, oatS rho S T U V A B ->
  if apar rho
  then sub E (subst_tt W T B) (subst_tt W S A)
  else sub E (subst_tt W S A) (subst_tt W T B).
Proof.
  intros rho S T E W U V D A B Hat. revert E D.
  induction Hat as
    [ S0 T0 A0 B0
    | rho S0 T0 U1 U2 V1 V2 A0 B0 Hchild IH
    | rho S0 T0 U1 U2 V1 V2 A0 B0 Hchild IH ];
    intros E D.
  - simpl. exact D.
  - simpl. simpl in D.
    destruct (inv_arrow_l E (subst_tt W S0 U1) (subst_tt W S0 U2)
               (typ_arrow (subst_tt W T0 V1) (subst_tt W T0 V2)) D) as
        [[Heq _] | [C1 [C2 [Heq [H1 H2]]]]].
    + discriminate Heq.
    + inversion Heq; subst. apply IH. exact H2.
  - simpl. simpl in D.
    destruct (inv_arrow_l E (subst_tt W S0 U1) (subst_tt W S0 U2)
               (typ_arrow (subst_tt W T0 V1) (subst_tt W T0 V2)) D) as
        [[Heq _] | [C1 [C2 [Heq [H1 H2]]]]].
    + discriminate Heq.
    + inversion Heq; subst.
      specialize (IH E H1).
      destruct (apar rho); simpl in *; assumption.
Qed.


(* Composed-mu push: opening a substituted mu comparison at a fresh atom. *)
Lemma pullback_mu_push : forall E W S T C1 C2,
  lc_tt S -> lc_tt T ->
  sub E (typ_mu (subst_tt W S C1)) (typ_mu (subst_tt W T C2)) ->
  forall L0, exists X,
    X \notin L0 /\ X <> W /\
    sub (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (subst_tt W S (open_tt C1 (typ_fvar X)))
                            (subst_tt W T (open_tt C2 (typ_fvar X))).
Proof.
  intros E W S T C1 C2 HlcS HlcT HD L0.
  destruct (inv_mu_mu E (subst_tt W S C1) (subst_tt W T C2) HD) as [L [H1 _]].
  destruct (atom_fresh (L \u L0 \u {{W}})) as [X HX].
  assert (HXL : X \notin L) by fsetdec.
  assert (HXW : X <> W) by fsetdec.
  exists X. split; [fsetdec|]. split; [fsetdec|].
  specialize (H1 X HXL). unfold open_tt in H1.
  rewrite <- (subst_tt_open_atom_lc_rec W S C1 0 X HlcS HXW) in H1.
  rewrite <- (subst_tt_open_atom_lc_rec W T C2 0 X HlcT HXW) in H1.
  exact H1.
Qed.

Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* One-hole type contexts, their path, and the number of encompassing  *)
(* mu binders.  [plug c D] fills the hole with D; [ctx_path c] is the  *)
(* corresponding mpath; [ctx_depth c] is the number of mu constructors *)
(* on the path from the root to the hole.                              *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
Inductive tctx : Set :=
| tc_hole : tctx
| tc_arrow_l : tctx -> typ -> tctx
| tc_arrow_r : typ -> tctx -> tctx
| tc_mu : tctx -> tctx.

Fixpoint plug (c : tctx) (D : typ) : typ :=
  match c with
  | tc_hole => D
  | tc_arrow_l c' B => typ_arrow (plug c' D) B
  | tc_arrow_r A c' => typ_arrow A (plug c' D)
  | tc_mu c' => typ_mu (plug c' D)
  end.

Fixpoint ctx_path (c : tctx) : mpath :=
  match c with
  | tc_hole => mp_here
  | tc_arrow_l c' _ => mp_dom (ctx_path c')
  | tc_arrow_r _ c' => mp_cod (ctx_path c')
  | tc_mu c' => mp_mu (ctx_path c')
  end.

Fixpoint ctx_depth (c : tctx) : nat :=
  match c with
  | tc_hole => 0
  | tc_arrow_l c' _ => ctx_depth c'
  | tc_arrow_r _ c' => ctx_depth c'
  | tc_mu c' => S (ctx_depth c')
  end.

(* Opening the filled context descends to the hole with shift equal to *)
(* the number of mus on the path.                                      *)
Lemma at_path_open_plug : forall c D K U,
  at_path (ctx_path c)
    (open_tt_rec K U (plug c D))
    (open_tt_rec (K + ctx_depth c) U D).
Proof.
  induction c as [|c IH B|A c IH|c IH]; intros D K U; simpl.
  - replace (K + 0) with K by lia. apply ap_here.
  - apply ap_dom. apply IH.
  - apply ap_cod. apply IH.
  - replace (K + S (ctx_depth c)) with (S K + ctx_depth c) by lia.
    apply ap_mu. apply IH.
Qed.

(* The map from a context to its hole is a valid syntactic path. *)
Lemma at_path_plug : forall c D, at_path (ctx_path c) (plug c D) D.
Proof.
  induction c as [|c IH B|A c IH|c IH]; intros D; simpl.
  - apply ap_here.
  - apply ap_dom. apply IH.
  - apply ap_cod. apply IH.
  - apply ap_mu. apply IH.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Certificate: a bad mu subterm D = mu Dbody of C, together with an   *)
(* occurrence of C's own binder inside Dbody (at depth [ctx_depth c + *)
(* 1], or with W occurring directly in Dbody), yields, after the       *)
(* double opening, a syntactic path to a mu leaf whose body has the    *)
(* odd own-binder occurrence and contains W.                           *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* The leaf is exactly the image of D under the opening, at the path   *)
---
  C = plug c (typ_mu D) ->
  bvoccT true 0 D ->
  ~ (W \in fv_tt D \/
     (exists q, bvoccT q (S (K + ctx_depth c)) D)).
Proof.
  intros C W K c D Hnone HEq Hb.
  pose proof (frozen_under_bad_leaf c C W K D
                (find_bad_none_frozen C W K Hnone) HEq) as Hno.
  intro H. apply Hno. unfold bad_at. split; [exact Hb|exact H].
Qed.

(* The frozen condition the covariance worker uses at top level.       *)
Definition frozen_cov (C : typ) (W : atom) : Prop :=
  forall c D,
    C = plug c (typ_mu D) ->
    bvoccT true 0 D ->
    W \notin fv_tt D /\ (forall q, ~ bvoccT q (S (ctx_depth c)) D).

Corollary find_bad_frozen_cov : forall C W,
  find_bad C W 0 = None -> frozen_cov C W.
Proof.
  intros C W Hnone c D HEq Hb.
  pose proof (frozen_under_bad_leaf c C W 0 D
                (find_bad_none_frozen C W 0 Hnone) HEq) as Hno.
  split.
  - intro HW. apply Hno. unfold bad_at. split; [exact Hb|left; exact HW].
  - intros q Hq. apply Hno. unfold bad_at. split; [exact Hb|right].
    exists q. replace (0 + ctx_depth c) with (ctx_depth c) by lia. exact Hq.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Assembly plug: the search result feeds bad_leaf_certificate, which  *)
(* feeds the parameterized deep exclusion.                             *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
Corollary find_bad_deep_exclusion :
  forall E C Z W s u (T0 : typ) (par : bool) (c : tctx) (Dbody : typ),
    bindsub_only (Z ~ bind_sub ++ E) ->
    wf_env (Z ~ bind_sub ++ E) ->
    lc_tt s -> lc_tt u -> s <> u -> W <> Z ->
    Z \notin fv_tt C -> W \in fv_tt C ->
    T0 = open_tt C (open_tt C (typ_fvar Z)) ->
    sub (Z ~ bind_sub ++ E) T0 T0 ->
    (if par
     then sub (Z ~ bind_sub ++ E) (subst_tt W u T0) (subst_tt W s T0)
     else sub (Z ~ bind_sub ++ E) (subst_tt W s T0) (subst_tt W u T0)) ->
    sub (Z ~ bind_sub ++ E) s u ->
    find_bad C W 0 = Some (c, Dbody) ->
    False.
Proof.
  intros E C Z W s u T0 par c Dbody Hbs Hwf Hlcs Hlcu Hne HWZ HZC HWC HT0
         Hself Hcomp Hfwd Hfind.
  destruct (find_bad_sound C W 0 c Dbody Hfind) as [HEq Hbad].
  unfold bad_at in Hbad. destruct Hbad as [Hb Hocc].
  assert (Hocc' : W \in fv_tt Dbody \/
                  (exists q, bvoccT q (S (ctx_depth c)) Dbody)).
  { destruct Hocc as [Hf|Ho]; [left; exact Hf|right].
    destruct Ho as [q Hq]. exists q.
    replace (0 + ctx_depth c) with (ctx_depth c) in Hq by lia. exact Hq. }
  destruct (bad_leaf_certificate C Z W c Dbody HEq Hb Hocc' HWC)
    as [p0 [B0 [Hpath [Hb0 HW0]]]].
  rewrite <- HT0 in Hpath.
  exact (deep_equal_mu_excluded_path_par E C Z W s u T0 p0 B0 par
           Hbs Hwf Hlcs Hlcu Hne HWZ HZC HWC HT0 Hself Hcomp Hfwd
           Hpath Hb0 HW0).
Qed.

Require Import TaskBase8.
Require Import AmberBase.
Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.
Require Import Program.Equality.
Require Import Lia.
Require Import Deep.
Require Import Deep2.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Deep3: syntactic search, frozen predicate, and the Assembly plug.   *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Decidable tests.                                                    *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma fv_dec : forall (W : atom) (T : typ),
  {W \in fv_tt T} + {~ W \in fv_tt T}.
Proof.
  intros W T.
  destruct (AtomSetImpl.mem W (fv_tt T)) eqn:E.
  - left. apply AtomSetImpl.mem_2. exact E.
  - right. intro H. apply AtomSetImpl.mem_1 in H. rewrite H in E. discriminate E.
Qed.

Lemma outer_occ_sumbool : forall K T,
  {(exists q, bvoccT q K T)} + {~ (exists q, bvoccT q K T)}.
Proof.
  intros K T.
  destruct (bvoccT_dec true K T) as [H|H].
  - left. exists true. exact H.
  - destruct (bvoccT_dec false K T) as [H0|H0].
    + left. exists false. exact H0.
    + right. intros [q Hq]. destruct q.
      * exact (H Hq).
      * exact (H0 Hq).
Qed.

(* [bad_at W K D] says D is a mu body with the odd own-binder occurrence *)
(* and either W free in D or an occurrence of the outer binder at the   *)
(* depth one below the current absolute depth [K].                      *)
Definition bad_at (W : atom) (K : nat) (D : typ) : Prop :=
  bvoccT true 0 D /\
  (W \in fv_tt D \/ (exists q, bvoccT q (S K) D)).

Lemma bad_at_dec : forall W K D,
  {bad_at W K D} + {~ bad_at W K D}.
Proof.
  intros W K D. unfold bad_at.
  destruct (bvoccT_dec true 0 D) as [Hb|Hb].
  - destruct (fv_dec W D) as [Hf|Hf].
    + left. split; [exact Hb|left; exact Hf].
    + destruct (outer_occ_sumbool (S K) D) as [Ho|Ho].
      * left. split; [exact Hb|right; exact Ho].
      * right. intros [Hb' [Hf'|Ho']].
        -- exact (Hf Hf').
        -- exact (Ho Ho').
  - right. intros [Hb' _]. exact (Hb Hb').
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Syntactic search.  [K] is the absolute depth (number of mu          *)
(* constructors outside the current subterm).  A bad mu at the current *)
(* node is returned with the context relative to the searched term;    *)
(* the absolute depth of the returned leaf is K + ctx_depth c.         *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
Fixpoint find_bad (C : typ) (W : atom) (K : nat) {struct C}
  : option (tctx * typ) :=
  match C with
  | typ_top => None
  | typ_nat => None
  | typ_bvar _ => None
  | typ_fvar _ => None
  | typ_arrow A B =>
      match find_bad A W K with
      | Some (c, D) => Some (tc_arrow_l c B, D)
      | None =>
          match find_bad B W K with
          | Some (c, D) => Some (tc_arrow_r A c, D)
          | None => None
          end
      end
  | typ_mu Dbody =>
      if bad_at_dec W K Dbody
      then Some (tc_hole, Dbody)
      else
        match find_bad Dbody W (S K) with
        | Some (c, D) => Some (tc_mu c, D)
        | None => None
        end
  end.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Soundness.                                                          *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
Lemma find_bad_sound : forall C W K c D,

        destruct (IHB W K c0 D0 EB) as [HEq Hbad].
        split.
        -- simpl. rewrite HEq. reflexivity.
        -- simpl. exact Hbad.
      * discriminate H.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* The frozen predicate: at absolute depth [K] no mu subterm is bad.   *)
(* At a mu node this means exactly: the body is not [bad_at W K] and   *)
(* the body is frozen at depth S K.  Arrows preserve the depth.        *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
Fixpoint frozen_under (C : typ) (W : atom) (K : nat) : Prop :=
  match C with
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_nat => True
  | typ_bvar _ => True
  | typ_fvar _ => True
  | typ_arrow A B => frozen_under A W K /\ frozen_under B W K
  | typ_mu Dbody => ~ bad_at W K Dbody /\ frozen_under Dbody W (S K)
  end.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* None case: no bad leaf means frozen everywhere.                     *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
Lemma find_bad_none_frozen : forall C W K,
  find_bad C W K = None -> frozen_under C W K.
Proof.
  induction C as [| |n|X|Dbody IHD|A IHA B IHB]; intros W K H; simpl in H.
  - simpl. exact I.
  - simpl. exact I.
  - simpl. exact I.
  - simpl. exact I.
  - (* mu *)
    destruct (bad_at_dec W K Dbody) as [Hb|Hb]; simpl in H.
    + discriminate H.
    + destruct (find_bad Dbody W (S K)) as [[c0 D0]|] eqn:E; simpl in H.
      * discriminate H.
      * simpl. split; [exact Hb|]. apply IHD. exact E.
  - (* arrow *)
    destruct (find_bad A W K) as [[c0 D0]|] eqn:EA; simpl in H.
    + discriminate H.
    + destruct (find_bad B W K) as [[c0 D0]|] eqn:EB; simpl in H.
      * discriminate H.
      * simpl. split.
        -- apply IHA. exact EA.
        -- apply IHB. exact EB.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Frozen-at-depth interface: every context decomposition of a bad mu  *)
(* is excluded at the corresponding absolute depth.                    *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
Lemma frozen_under_bad_leaf : forall c C W K D,
  frozen_under C W K ->
  C = plug c (typ_mu D) ->
  ~ bad_at W (K + ctx_depth c) D.
Proof.
  induction c as [|c IH B|A c IH|c IH]; intros C W K D Hf HEq; simpl in *.
  - subst C. simpl in Hf. destruct Hf as [Hbad _].
    replace (K + 0) with K by lia. exact Hbad.
  - subst C. simpl in Hf. destruct Hf as [HfA _].
    exact (IH (plug c (typ_mu D)) W K D HfA eq_refl).
  - subst C. simpl in Hf. destruct Hf as [_ HfB].
    exact (IH (plug c (typ_mu D)) W K D HfB eq_refl).
  - subst C. simpl in Hf. destruct Hf as [_ HfD].
    replace (K + S (ctx_depth c)) with (S K + ctx_depth c) by lia.
    exact (IH (plug c (typ_mu D)) W (S K) D HfD eq_refl).
Qed.

(* Combined interface: no bad leaf from the search, and any bad mu      *)
(* subterm reached through a context decomposition is frozen.          *)
Corollary find_bad_none_ctx : forall C W K c D,
  find_bad C W K = None ->
  C = plug c (typ_mu D) ->
  bvoccT true 0 D ->
  ~ (W \in fv_tt D \/
     (exists q, bvoccT q (S (K + ctx_depth c)) D)).
Proof.
  intros C W K c D Hnone HEq Hb.
  pose proof (frozen_under_bad_leaf c C W K D
                (find_bad_none_frozen C W K Hnone) HEq) as Hno.
  intro H. apply Hno. unfold bad_at. split; [exact Hb|exact H].
Qed.

(* The frozen condition the covariance worker uses at top level.       *)
Definition frozen_cov (C : typ) (W : atom) : Prop :=
  forall c D,
    C = plug c (typ_mu D) ->
    bvoccT true 0 D ->
    W \notin fv_tt D /\ (forall q, ~ bvoccT q (S (ctx_depth c)) D).

Corollary find_bad_frozen_cov : forall C W,
  find_bad C W 0 = None -> frozen_cov C W.
Proof.
  intros C W Hnone c D HEq Hb.
  pose proof (frozen_under_bad_leaf c C W 0 D
                (find_bad_none_frozen C W 0 Hnone) HEq) as Hno.
  split.
  - intro HW. apply Hno. unfold bad_at. split; [exact Hb|left; exact HW].
  - intros q Hq. apply Hno. unfold bad_at. split; [exact Hb|right].
    exists q. replace (0 + ctx_depth c) with (ctx_depth c) by lia. exact Hq.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Assembly plug: the search result feeds bad_leaf_certificate, which  *)
(* feeds the parameterized deep exclusion.                             *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
Corollary find_bad_deep_exclusion :
  forall E C Z W s u (T0 : typ) (par : bool) (c : tctx) (Dbody : typ),
    bindsub_only (Z ~ bind_sub ++ E) ->
    wf_env (Z ~ bind_sub ++ E) ->
    lc_tt s -> lc_tt u -> s <> u -> W <> Z ->
    Z \notin fv_tt C -> W \in fv_tt C ->
    T0 = open_tt C (open_tt C (typ_fvar Z)) ->
    sub (Z ~ bind_sub ++ E) T0 T0 ->
    (if par
     then sub (Z ~ bind_sub ++ E) (subst_tt W u T0) (subst_tt W s T0)
     else sub (Z ~ bind_sub ++ E) (subst_tt W s T0) (subst_tt W u T0)) ->
    sub (Z ~ bind_sub ++ E) s u ->
    find_bad C W 0 = Some (c, Dbody) ->
    False.
Proof.
  intros E C Z W s u T0 par c Dbody Hbs Hwf Hlcs Hlcu Hne HWZ HZC HWC HT0
         Hself Hcomp Hfwd Hfind.
  destruct (find_bad_sound C W 0 c Dbody Hfind) as [HEq Hbad].
  unfold bad_at in Hbad. destruct Hbad as [Hb Hocc].
  assert (Hocc' : W \in fv_tt Dbody \/
                  (exists q, bvoccT q (S (ctx_depth c)) Dbody)).
  { destruct Hocc as [Hf|Ho]; [left; exact Hf|right].
    destruct Ho as [q Hq]. exists q.
    replace (0 + ctx_depth c) with (ctx_depth c) in Hq by lia. exact Hq. }
  destruct (bad_leaf_certificate C Z W c Dbody HEq Hb Hocc' HWC)

Lemma fill_ctx_comp : forall K1 K2 T,
  fill (ctx_comp K1 K2) T = fill K1 (fill K2 T).
Proof.
  induction K1 as [| | |n|X|K1 IH1 K2' IH2|K0 IH];
    intros K2 T; simpl; try reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH1, IH2. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* locally closed types *)
Fixpoint lc_rec (d : nat) (T : typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_nat => True
  | typ_bvar J => J < d
  | typ_fvar X => True
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => lc_rec d T1 /\ lc_rec d T2
  | typ_mu T => lc_rec (S d) T
  end.

Definition lc_tt T := lc_rec 0 T.

Lemma lc_open_rec : forall T K X d,
  lc_rec d T -> lc_rec d (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T).
Proof.
  induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; intros K X d H; simpl in *.
  - exact I.
  - exact I.
  - destruct (K === n).
    + simpl. exact I.
    + simpl. exact H.
  - simpl. exact I.
  - simpl. exact (IHT (S K) X (S d) H).
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. simpl. split.
    + exact (IHT1 K X d H1).
    + exact (IHT2 K X d H2).
Qed.

Lemma lc_open_mu_body : forall T d X,
  lc_rec (S d) T -> lc_rec d (open_tt_rec d (typ_fvar X) T).
Proof.

Lemma lc_open_tt : forall T X, lc_tt T -> lc_tt (open_tt T (typ_fvar X)).
Proof.
  intros T X H. unfold lc_tt, open_tt.
  exact (lc_open_rec_any T 0 X H).
Qed.

(* Opening a locally closed type at any level is the identity. *)
Lemma lc_open_rec_id : forall T d, lc_rec d T ->
  forall K, K >= d -> forall X, open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T = T.
Proof.
  intros T. induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IH1 T2 IH2];
    intros d Hlc K HK X; simpl in *.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (K === n); [|reflexivity].
    exfalso. lia.
  - reflexivity.
  - apply f_equal. apply IHT with (d := S d) (K := S K).
    + exact Hlc.
    + lia.
  - destruct Hlc as [H1 H2]. f_equal.
    + exact (IH1 d H1 K HK X).
    + exact (IH2 d H2 K HK X).
Qed.

(* Opening a locally closed type with any type at any level is the identity. *)
Lemma lc_open_any_id : forall T d, lc_rec d T ->
  forall K W, K >= d -> open_tt_rec K W T = T.
Proof.
  intros T. induction T as [| |n|x|T IHT|T1 IH1 T2 IH2];
    intros d Hlc K W HK; simpl in *.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (K === n); [|reflexivity].
    exfalso. lia.
  - reflexivity.
  - apply f_equal. apply (IHT (S d) Hlc (S K) W). lia.
  - destruct Hlc as [H1 H2]. f_equal.
    + exact (IH1 d H1 K W HK).
    + exact (IH2 d H2 K W HK).
Qed.

(* Substitution commutes with opening with a type. *)
Lemma subst_tt_open_ty_rec : forall Z S C U K,
  lc_tt S ->
  subst_tt Z S (open_tt_rec K U C) =
  open_tt_rec K (subst_tt Z S U) (subst_tt Z S C).
Proof.
  intros Z S C. induction C as [| |n|y|C IHC|C1 IH1 C2 IH2];
    intros U K HS; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (K === n); simpl; reflexivity.
  - destruct (y == Z) as [Heq|Hneq]; simpl.
    + subst y. simpl.
      rewrite (lc_open_any_id S 0 HS K (subst_tt Z S U) (Nat.le_0_l K)).
      reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHC; [reflexivity | exact HS].
  - rewrite IH1, IH2; [reflexivity | exact HS | exact HS].
Qed.

(* Commuting substitution of a (fresh, distinct) atom with opening, when
   the substituted type is locally closed.  Needed for the companion
   derivation's fresh-atom step. *)
Lemma subst_tt_open_atom_lc_rec : forall W A0 C K V,
  lc_tt A0 -> V <> W ->
  subst_tt W A0 (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar V) C) =
  open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar V) (subst_tt W A0 C).
Proof.
  intros W A0 C. induction C as [| |n|y|C IHC|C1 IH1 C2 IH2];
    intros K V Hlc HVW; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (K === n); simpl.
    + destruct (V == W) as [Heq|Hneq].
      * exfalso. exact (HVW Heq).
      * reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
  - destruct (y == W) as [Heq|Hneq]; simpl.
    + rewrite (lc_open_rec_id A0 0 Hlc K (Nat.le_0_l K) V).
      reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHC; [reflexivity | exact Hlc | exact HVW].
  - rewrite IH1, IH2.
    + reflexivity.
    + exact Hlc. + exact HVW.
    + exact Hlc. + exact HVW.
Qed.

Lemma subst_tt_open_atom_lc : forall W A0 C V,
  lc_tt A0 -> V <> W ->
  subst_tt W A0 (open_tt C (typ_fvar V)) =
  open_tt (subst_tt W A0 C) (typ_fvar V).
Proof.
  intros. unfold open_tt. apply subst_tt_open_atom_lc_rec; assumption.
Qed.

(* The double unfolding commutes with substituting a distinct atom. *)
Lemma subst_tt_open_open_ty : forall Z S C Y,
  lc_tt S -> Y <> Z ->
  subst_tt Z S (open_tt C (open_tt C (typ_fvar Y))) =
  open_tt (subst_tt Z S C) (open_tt (subst_tt Z S C) (typ_fvar Y)).
Proof.
  intros Z S C Y HS HYZ. unfold open_tt.
  rewrite (subst_tt_open_ty_rec Z S C (open_tt_rec 0 (typ_fvar Y) C) 0 HS).
  rewrite (subst_tt_open_atom_lc_rec Z S C 0 Y HS HYZ).
  reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Inverting opening for locally closed types: if an opened body is
   locally closed, the body is closed under its binder. *)
Lemma lc_open_body_inv : forall T d X,
  lc_rec d (open_tt_rec d (typ_fvar X) T) -> lc_rec (S d) T.
Proof.
  induction T as [| |n|y|T IHT|T1 IH1 T2 IH2];
    intros d X H; simpl in *.
  - exact I.
  - exact I.
  - destruct (d === n).
    + simpl. unfold lt. lia.
    + simpl in H. unfold lt in *. lia.
  - exact I.
  - apply (IHT (S d) X). exact H.
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. split.
    + exact (IH1 d X H1).
    + exact (IH2 d X H2).
Qed.

(* ============== per-atom origin translation ======================= *)
Definition pick (o : atom -> bool) (f g : atom -> atom) : atom -> atom :=
  fun X => if o X then f X else g X.

Definition ren_pick (o : atom -> bool) (f g : atom -> atom) (T : typ) : typ :=
  ren_tt (pick o f g) T.

Lemma ren_pick_id : forall o T,
  ren_pick o (fun X => X) (fun X => X) T = T.
Proof.
  intros o T. unfold ren_pick.
  transitivity (ren_tt (fun X => X) T).
  - apply ren_tt_ext.
    intros X HX. unfold pick. destruct (o X); reflexivity.
  - apply ren_tt_id.
Qed.

(* compatibility: for every matched atom occurrence, the origins must be
   (false,true) at negative polarity or (true,false) at positive polarity *)
Fixpoint compat (o1 o2 : atom -> bool) (pol : bool) (A B : typ) : Prop :=
  match A, B with
  | typ_fvar X, typ_fvar Y =>
      if X == Y then
        (if o1 X then (if o2 X then False else pol = true)
                   else (if o2 X then pol = false else False))
      else True
  | typ_arrow A1 A2, typ_arrow B1 B2 =>
      compat o1 o2 (negb pol) A1 B1 /\ compat o1 o2 pol A2 B2
  | typ_mu A1, typ_mu B1 => compat o1 o2 pol A1 B1
  | _,_ => True
  end.

| c_fvar   : atom -> ctx

Fixpoint fill (K : ctx) (T : typ) : typ :=
  match K with
  | c_hole       => T
  | c_top        => typ_top
  | c_nat        => typ_nat
  | c_bvar n     => typ_bvar n
  | c_fvar X     => typ_fvar X
  | c_arrow K1 K2 => typ_arrow (fill K1 T) (fill K2 T)
  | c_mu K0      => typ_mu (fill K0 T)
  end.

Fixpoint ctx_fv (K : ctx) : atoms :=
  match K with
  | c_hole        => empty
  | c_top         => empty
  | c_nat         => empty
  | c_bvar _      => empty
  | c_fvar X      => {{X}}
  | c_arrow K1 K2 => union (ctx_fv K1) (ctx_fv K2)
  | c_mu K0       => ctx_fv K0
  end.

Lemma fill_subst : forall K Z U T,
  Z \notin ctx_fv K ->
  fill K (subst_tt Z U T) = subst_tt Z U (fill K T).
Proof.

    intros Z U T H; simpl in *.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - assert (HX : X <> Z) by (intro; subst; fsetdec).
    destruct (X == Z) as [Heq|Hneq];
      [exfalso; exact (HX Heq) | reflexivity].
  - assert (H1 : Z \notin ctx_fv K1) by fsetdec.
    assert (H2 : Z \notin ctx_fv K2) by fsetdec.
    rewrite IH1; [| exact H1]. rewrite IH2; [| exact H2].
    reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH; [reflexivity | exact H].

  | c_top         => c_top
  | c_nat         => c_nat

Lemma lc_open_body_inv : forall T d X,
  lc_rec d (open_tt_rec d (typ_fvar X) T) -> lc_rec (S d) T.
Proof.
  induction T as [| |n|y|T IHT|T1 IH1 T2 IH2];
    intros d X H; simpl in *.
  - exact I.
  - exact I.

  - exact I.

    + exact (IH1 d X H1).

(* corresponding mpath; [ctx_depth c] is the number of mu constructors *)
(* on the path from the root to the hole.                              *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
Inductive tctx : Set :=
| tc_hole : tctx
| tc_arrow_l : tctx -> typ -> tctx
| tc_arrow_r : typ -> tctx -> tctx
| tc_mu : tctx -> tctx.

Fixpoint plug (c : tctx) (D : typ) : typ :=
  match c with
  | tc_hole => D
  | tc_arrow_l c' B => typ_arrow (plug c' D) B
  | tc_arrow_r A c' => typ_arrow A (plug c' D)
  | tc_mu c' => typ_mu (plug c' D)
  end.

Fixpoint ctx_path (c : tctx) : mpath :=
  match c with
  | tc_hole => mp_here
  | tc_arrow_l c' _ => mp_dom (ctx_path c')
  | tc_arrow_r _ c' => mp_cod (ctx_path c')
  | tc_mu c' => mp_mu (ctx_path c')
  end.

Fixpoint ctx_depth (c : tctx) : nat :=
  match c with
  | tc_hole => 0
  | tc_arrow_l c' _ => ctx_depth c'
  | tc_arrow_r _ c' => ctx_depth c'
  | tc_mu c' => S (ctx_depth c')
  end.

(* Opening the filled context descends to the hole with shift equal to *)
(* the number of mus on the path.                                      *)

  at_path (ctx_path c)
    (open_tt_rec K U (plug c D))
    (open_tt_rec (K + ctx_depth c) U D).
Proof.

  - replace (K + 0) with K by lia. apply ap_here.
  - apply ap_dom. apply IH.
  - apply ap_cod. apply IH.
  - replace (K + S (ctx_depth c)) with (S K + ctx_depth c) by lia.

                (find_bad_none_frozen C W K Hnone) HEq) as Hno.
  intro H. apply Hno. unfold bad_at. split; [exact Hb|exact H].

    bvoccT true 0 D ->

Require Import Lia.

(* Frozen predicate: every bad mu subterm of C has no occurrence of C's
   own binder at the depth-shifted index, so opening C does not change it. *)
Definition frozen (C : typ) : Prop :=
  forall (c : tctx) (D : typ),
    C = plug c (typ_mu D) ->
    bvoccT true 0 D ->
    forall q, ~ bvoccT q (S (ctx_depth c)) D.

(* The covariance/item corollary supplied by the safe-body worker. *)
Definition CovPos : Prop :=
  forall (E : env) (C : typ) (X : atom),
    frozen C ->
    ~ bvoccT true 0 C ->
    X \notin fv_tt C ->
    X \notin dom E ->
    (forall W, W \in fv_tt C -> binds W bind_sub E) ->
    wf_env E ->
    lc_tt (open_tt C (typ_fvar X)) ->
    sub (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt C (typ_fvar X)) typ_top ->
    sub (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt C (open_tt C (typ_fvar X)))
                           (open_tt C typ_top).

                          HbsZ HwfZ Hlcs Hlct Hne' HZW' HZfv HWfv Hp1Z Hp2Z
                          Hq1 Hq2 HfwdZ Hbv).
              ** simpl in Hq1. simpl in Hq2.
                 unfold open_tt in Hq1.
                 rewrite <- (subst_tt_open_atom_lc_rec Wd sd A1 0 Z Hlcs HZW) in Hq1.
                 rewrite <- (subst_tt_open_atom_lc_rec Wd td A1 0 Z Hlct HZW) in Hq1.
                 rewrite <- (subst_tt_open_open_ty Wd sd A1 Z Hlcs HZW) in Hq2.
                 rewrite <- (subst_tt_open_open_ty Wd td A1 Z Hlct HZW) in Hq2.
                 exact (equal_mu_excluded_par E0 A1 Z Wd sd td false
                          HbsZ HwfZ Hlcs Hlct Hne' HZW' HZfv HWfv Hp1Z Hp2Z
                          Hq1 Hq2 HfwdZ Hbv).
           ++ (* own binder even: search for a certified bad leaf *)
              destruct (find_bad A1 Wd 0) as [[c Dbody]|] eqn:Hfind.
              ** (* bad leaf carrying W or the binder: deep exclusion *)
                 exfalso.
                 destruct pard.
                 { simpl in Hq2.
                   unfold open_tt in Hq2.
                   rewrite <- (subst_tt_open_atom_lc_rec Wd td A1 0 Z Hlct HZW) in Hq2.
                   rewrite <- (subst_tt_open_atom_lc_rec Wd sd A1 0 Z Hlcs HZW) in Hq2.
                   rewrite <- (subst_tt_open_open_ty Wd td A1 Z Hlct HZW) in Hq2.
                   rewrite <- (subst_tt_open_open_ty Wd sd A1 Z Hlcs HZW) in Hq2.
                   exact (find_bad_deep_exclusion E0 A1 Z Wd sd td
                            (open_tt A1 (open_tt A1 (typ_fvar Z))) true c Dbody
                            HbsZ HwfZ Hlcs Hlct Hne' HZW' HZfv HWfv eq_refl Hp2Z
                            Hq2 HfwdZ Hfind). }
                 { simpl in Hq2.
                   unfold open_tt in Hq2.
                   rewrite <- (subst_tt_open_atom_lc_rec Wd sd A1 0 Z Hlcs HZW) in Hq2.
                   rewrite <- (subst_tt_open_atom_lc_rec Wd td A1 0 Z Hlct HZW) in Hq2.
                   rewrite <- (subst_tt_open_open_ty Wd sd A1 Z Hlcs HZW) in Hq2.
                   rewrite <- (subst_tt_open_open_ty Wd td A1 Z Hlct HZW) in Hq2.
                   exact (find_bad_deep_exclusion E0 A1 Z Wd sd td
                            (open_tt A1 (open_tt A1 (typ_fvar Z))) false c Dbody
                            HbsZ HwfZ Hlcs Hlct Hne' HZW' HZfv HWfv eq_refl Hp2Z
                            Hq2 HfwdZ Hfind). }
              ** (* no certified leaf: frozen; descend with item (X, U, top) *)
                 assert (Hfrozen : frozen A1).
                 { intros c0 D0 HC0 Hb0 q Hq0.
                   pose proof (find_bad_frozen_cov A1 Wd Hfind c0 D0 HC0 Hb0) as [HWD0 Hbq0].
                   exact (Hbq0 q Hq0). }
                 destruct (project_items_mu E0 A1 A1 L Hok) as [Lproj Hproj].
                 set (Lbig := L0 \u Lproj \u dom E0 \u domA Ea \u fv_tt A1).
                 apply (sam_rec Ea (amber_cov Ea Em A1 (sideA flag))
                                  (amber_cov Ea Em A1 (sideB flag)) Lbig).
                 intros X Y HX HXY.
                 assert (HX0 : X \notin L0) by (unfold Lbig in HX; fsetdec).
                 assert (HXdomE : X \notin dom E0) by (unfold Lbig in HX; fsetdec).
                 assert (HXdomA : X \notin domA Ea) by (unfold Lbig in HX; fsetdec).
                 assert (HXA1 : X \notin fv_tt A1) by (unfold Lbig in HX; fsetdec).
                 assert (HXproj : X \notin Lproj) by (unfold Lbig in HX; fsetdec).
                 assert (HYdomA : Y \notin domA Ea) by (unfold Lbig in HXY; fsetdec).
                 assert (HYX : Y <> X) by (unfold Lbig in HXY; fsetdec).
                 set (U := open_tt A1 (typ_fvar X)).
                 assert (Hp1 : sub (X ~ bind_sub ++ E0) U U).
                 { unfold U. apply (p1 X HX0). }
                 assert (Hbs' : bindsub_only (X ~ bind_sub ++ E0)).
                 { apply bindsub_only_cons. exact Hbs. }
                 assert (HwfE' : wf_env (X ~ bind_sub ++ E0)).
                 { exact (sub_wf_env (X ~ bind_sub ++ E0) U U Hp1). }
                 assert (HWFU : WF (X ~ bind_sub ++ E0) U).
                 { exact (proj1 (sub_wf (X ~ bind_sub ++ E0) U U Hp1)). }
                 assert (HlcU : lc_tt U).
                 { apply (wf_lc (X ~ bind_sub ++ E0) U). exact HWFU. }
                 assert (HlcTop : lc_tt typ_top) by (simpl; exact I).
                 assert (HUt : sub (X ~ bind_sub ++ E0) U typ_top).
                 { apply sa_top; [ exact HwfE' | exact HWFU ]. }
                 assert (HfvB : forall Z0, Z0 \in fv_tt A1 -> binds Z0 bind_sub E0).
                 { intros Z0 HZ0.
                   assert (HZmu : Z0 \in fv_tt (typ_mu A1)) by (simpl; exact HZ0).
                   pose proof (wf_fv_bindsub E0 (typ_mu A1) HWF Z0 HZmu) as Hbin.
                   exact (proj1 (in_bindsub_atoms E0 Z0) Hbin). }
                 assert (HD2 : sub (X ~ bind_sub ++ E0)
                                   (open_tt A1 U) (open_tt A1 typ_top)).
                 { unfold U.
                   exact (Hcov E0 A1 X Hfrozen Hnb HXA1 HXdomE HfvB HwfE'
                            (wf_lc (X ~ bind_sub ++ E0) (open_tt A1 (typ_fvar X)) HWFU)
                            (open_tt A1 (typ_fvar X))). }
                 (* fix HD2's S argument: CovPos gives sub E (open C (open C X))
                    (open C top); the goal's U is exactly open C X. *)
                 assert (HUtop : U <> typ_top).
                 { intro Heq. apply HcovNe.
                   assert (HA1top : A1 = typ_top).
                   { apply (open_tt_fvar_top_inv A1 X). unfold U in Heq. exact Heq. }
                   rewrite HA1top. rewrite !amber_cov_top. reflexivity. }
                 set (newd := {| gd_w := X; gd_s := U; gd_t := typ_top; gd_par := false |}).
                 set (L2 := newd :: L).
                 assert (HokNew : gen_spec (X ~ bind_sub ++ E0) U U newd).
                 { unfold gen_spec, newd. simpl.
                   split; [| split; [| split; [| split]]].
                   - unfold U.
                     rewrite (subst_tt_open_same X (open_tt A1 (typ_fvar X)) A1 HXA1).
                     rewrite (subst_tt_fresh X (open_tt A1 (typ_fvar X)) A1 HXA1).
                     rewrite (subst_tt_open_same X typ_top A1 HXA1).
                     rewrite (subst_tt_fresh X typ_top A1 HXA1).
                     exact HD2.
                   - exact HUt.
                   - exact HUtop.
                   - exact HlcU.
                   - exact HlcTop. }
                 assert (Hok2 : items_ok (X ~ bind_sub ++ E0) U U L2).
                 { unfold items_ok in *. intros d Hin. unfold L2 in Hin. simpl in Hin.
                   destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
                   - subst d. exact HokNew.
                   - apply (Hproj X HXproj HXdomE). exact Hin. }
                 assert (Hcover2 : items_cover (X ~ bind_sub ++ E0) L2).
                 { unfold items_cover in *. intros Z0 Hb0. simpl in Hb0.
                   destruct Hb0 as [HeqIn|Hin].
                   - inversion HeqIn. subst Z0. exists newd. split; [left; reflexivity|reflexivity].
                   - destruct (Hcover Z0 Hin) as [d [Hin2 Hw2]]. exists d.
                     split; [right; exact Hin2 | exact Hw2]. }
                 assert (Hdom2 : items_ok_dom (X ~ bind_sub ++ E0) L2).
                 { unfold items_ok_dom in *. intros d Hin. unfold L2 in Hin. simpl in Hin.
                   destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
                   - subst d. unfold newd. simpl. unfold dom. simpl. fsetdec.
                   - apply Hdom in Hin. unfold dom. simpl. fsetdec. }
                 assert (Hnp : npol false X U U).
                 { apply (proj2 (npol_self_false X U)). intro Hh.
                   apply Hnb. unfold U in Hh.
                   exact (proj1 (hasp_open_fvar_same A1 X true HXA1) Hh). }
                 assert (Hwea' : wfe_amber ((X,Y)::Ea)).
                 { apply wfea_cons.
                   - exact HXdomA.
                   - unfold Lbig in HXY. fsetdec.
                   - exact Hwe. }
                 assert (Hpair' : forall Z0, binds Z0 bind_sub (X ~ bind_sub ++ E0) ->
                                            exists Y0, In (Z0,Y0) ((X,Y)::Ea)).
                 { intros Z0 Hb0. simpl in Hb0. destruct Hb0 as [HeqIn|Hin].
                   - inversion HeqIn. subst Z0. exists Y. left. reflexivity.
                   - destruct (Hpair Z0 Hin) as [Y0 HY0]. exists Y0. right. exact HY0. }
                 assert (Hmo' : modes_ok flag ((X,Y)::Ea) ((sideB flag)::Em) U U).
                 { apply (modes_ok_open_rec false flag Ea Em X Y A1 A1 0 Hmo HXA1 HXA1).
                   unfold U, open_tt. exact Hnp. }
                 pose proof (IH1 X HX0 Hbs' HwfE' flag ((X,Y)::Ea) ((sideB flag)::Em) L2
                               Hwea' Hpair' Hmo' Hok2 Hcover2 Hdom2) as Hres.
                 rewrite <- (amber_cov_mu_left Ea Em X Y A1 flag HXA1 HXdomA HYdomA).
                 rewrite <- (amber_cov_mu_right Ea Em X Y A1 flag HXA1 HXdomA HYdomA).
                 unfold U in Hres. exact Hres.
        -- (* no fvars: cov images are both A1 *)
           apply HcovNe.
           rewrite (amber_cov_no_fv Ea Em A1 (sideA flag)
                      (typ_fvar_witness_none A1 HW)).
           rewrite (amber_cov_no_fv Ea Em A1 (sideB flag)
                      (typ_fvar_witness_none A1 HW)).
           reflexivity.
    + (* distinct bodies *)
      destruct (project_items_mu E0 A1 A2 L Hok) as [Lproj Hproj].
      set (Lbig := L0 \u Lproj \u dom E0 \u domA Ea \u fv_tt A1 \u fv_tt A2).
      apply (sam_rec Ea (amber_cov Ea Em A1 (sideA flag)) (amber_cov Ea Em A2 (sideB flag)) Lbig).
      intros X Y HX HXY.
      assert (HX0 : X \notin L0) by (unfold Lbig in HX; fsetdec).
      assert (HXdomE : X \notin dom E0) by (unfold Lbig in HX; fsetdec).
      assert (HXdomA : X \notin domA Ea) by (unfold Lbig in HX; fsetdec).
      assert (HXA1 : X \notin fv_tt A1) by (unfold Lbig in HX; fsetdec).
      assert (HXA2 : X \notin fv_tt A2) by (unfold Lbig in HX; fsetdec).
      assert (HXproj : X \notin Lproj) by (unfold Lbig in HX; fsetdec).
      assert (HYdomA : Y \notin domA Ea) by (unfold Lbig in HXY; fsetdec).
      assert (HYX : Y <> X) by (unfold Lbig in HXY; fsetdec).
      set (U := open_tt A1 (typ_fvar X)).
      set (V := open_tt A2 (typ_fvar X)).
      assert (Hp1 : sub (X ~ bind_sub ++ E0) U V).
      { unfold U, V. apply (p1 X HX0). }
      assert (HUV : U <> V).
      { intro Heq. apply HneA. apply (open_tt_rec_inj A1 A2 0 X HXA1 HXA2).
        unfold U in Heq. unfold V in Heq. unfold open_tt in Heq. exact Heq. }
      assert (Hbs' : bindsub_only (X ~ bind_sub ++ E0)).
      { apply bindsub_only_cons. exact Hbs. }
      assert (HwfE' : wf_env (X ~ bind_sub ++ E0)).
      { exact (sub_wf_env (X ~ bind_sub ++ E0) U V Hp1). }
      assert (HlcU : lc_tt U).
      { apply (wf_lc (X ~ bind_sub ++ E0) U). exact (proj1 (sub_wf (X ~ bind_sub ++ E0) U V Hp1)). }
      assert (HlcV : lc_tt V).
      { apply (wf_lc (X ~ bind_sub ++ E0) V). exact (proj2 (sub_wf (X ~ bind_sub ++ E0) U V Hp1)). }
      assert (Hp2rew : sub (X ~ bind_sub ++ E0) (subst_tt X U U) (subst_tt X V V)).
      { unfold U, V.
        rewrite <- (open_open_subst A1 X HXA1).
        rewrite <- (open_open_subst A2 X HXA2).
        exact (p2 X HX0). }
      assert (Hnp : npol false X U V).
      { exact (purity (X ~ bind_sub ++ E0) U V X Hbs' HwfE' HlcU HlcV Hp1 Hp2rew HUV). }
      assert (Hwea' : wfe_amber ((X,Y)::Ea)).
      { apply wfea_cons.
        - exact HXdomA.
        - unfold Lbig in HXY. fsetdec.
        - exact Hwe. }
      assert (Hpair' : forall Z0, binds Z0 bind_sub (X ~ bind_sub ++ E0) ->
                                 exists Y0, In (Z0,Y0) ((X,Y)::Ea)).
      { intros Z0 Hb0. simpl in Hb0. destruct Hb0 as [HeqIn|Hin].
        - inversion HeqIn. subst Z0. exists Y. left. reflexivity.
        - destruct (Hpair Z0 Hin) as [Y0 HY0]. exists Y0. right. exact HY0. }
      assert (Hmo' : modes_ok flag ((X,Y)::Ea) ((sideB flag)::Em) U V).
      { apply (modes_ok_open_rec false flag Ea Em X Y A1 A2 0 Hmo HXA1 HXA2).
        unfold U, V, open_tt. exact Hnp. }
      assert (HokProj : items_ok (X ~ bind_sub ++ E0) U V L).
      { unfold U, V. apply (Hproj X HXproj HXdomE). }
      set (newd := {| gd_w := X; gd_s := U; gd_t := V; gd_par := false |}).
      set (L2 := newd :: L).
      assert (HokNew : gen_spec (X ~ bind_sub ++ E0) U V newd).
      { unfold gen_spec, newd. simpl.
        split; [| split; [| split; [| split]]].
        - exact Hp2rew.
        - exact Hp1.
        - exact HUV.
        - exact HlcU.
        - exact HlcV. }
      assert (Hok2 : items_ok (X ~ bind_sub ++ E0) U V L2).
      { unfold items_ok in *. intros d Hin. unfold L2 in Hin. simpl in Hin.
        destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
        - subst d. exact HokNew.
        - apply HokProj. exact Hin. }
      assert (Hcover2 : items_cover (X ~ bind_sub ++ E0) L2).
      { unfold items_cover in *. intros Z0 Hb0. simpl in Hb0.
        destruct Hb0 as [HeqIn|Hin].
        - inversion HeqIn. subst Z0. exists newd. split; [left; reflexivity|reflexivity].
        - destruct (Hcover Z0 Hin) as [d [Hin2 Hw2]]. exists d.
          split; [right; exact Hin2 | exact Hw2]. }
      assert (Hdom2 : items_ok_dom (X ~ bind_sub ++ E0) L2).
      { unfold items_ok_dom in *. intros d Hin. unfold L2 in Hin. simpl in Hin.
        destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
        - subst d. unfold newd. simpl. unfold dom. simpl. fsetdec.
        - apply Hdom in Hin. unfold dom. simpl. fsetdec. }
      pose proof (IH1 X HX0 Hbs' HwfE' flag ((X,Y)::Ea) ((sideB flag)::Em) L2
                    Hwea' Hpair' Hmo' Hok2 Hcover2 Hdom2) as Hres.
      rewrite <- (amber_cov_mu_left Ea Em X Y A1 flag HXA1 HXdomA HYdomA).
      rewrite <- (amber_cov_mu_right Ea Em X Y A2 flag HXA2 HXdomA HYdomA).
      unfold U, V in Hres. exact Hres.

Require Import TaskBase10.
Require Import Rules.
Require Import AmberBase.
Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.
Require Import Program.Equality.
Require Import Lia.

(* Frozen predicate: every bad mu subterm of C has no occurrence of C's
   own binder at the depth-shifted index, so opening C does not change it. *)
Definition frozen (C : typ) : Prop :=
  forall (c : tctx) (D : typ),
    C = plug c (typ_mu D) ->
    bvoccT true 0 D ->
    forall q, ~ bvoccT q (S (ctx_depth c)) D.

(* The covariance/item corollary supplied by the safe-body worker. *)
Definition CovPos : Prop :=
  forall (E : env) (C : typ) (X : atom),
    frozen C ->
    ~ bvoccT true 0 C ->
    X \notin fv_tt C ->
    X \notin dom E ->
    (forall W, W \in fv_tt C -> binds W bind_sub E) ->
    wf_env E ->
    lc_tt (open_tt C (typ_fvar X)) ->
    sub (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt C (typ_fvar X)) typ_top ->
    sub (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt C (open_tt C (typ_fvar X)))
                           (open_tt C typ_top).

Lemma Assembly_of_Cov : CovPos -> Assembly.
Proof.
  intros Hcov E A B Hsub.
  induction Hsub as
    [ E0 HwfE
    | E0 X0 HwfE Hb
    | E0 A0 HwfE WFA
    | E0 A1 A2 B1 B2 s1 IH1 s2 IH2
    | L0 A1 A2 E0 p1 IH1 p2 IH2 ];
    intros Hbs Hwf flag Ea Em L Hwe Hpair Hmo Hok Hcover Hdom.
  - (* sa_nat *)
    rewrite amber_cov_nat. rewrite amber_cov_nat.
    apply sam_nat. exact Hwe.
  - (* sa_fvar *)
    simpl in Hmo.
    destruct (X0 == X0) as [Heq|Hne].
    + destruct (mode_of X0 Ea Em) as [m|] eqn:HmoEq.
      { apply polar_ok_eq_sideB in Hmo.
        destruct (Hpair X0 Hb) as [Y Hin].
        rewrite (amber_cov_fvar_val Ea Em X0 (sideA flag) Hwe).
        rewrite (amber_cov_fvar_val Ea Em X0 (sideB flag) Hwe).
        assert (HcA : cov_fun Ea Em (sideA flag) X0 = X0)
          by (rewrite (cov_fun_pair Ea Em X0 Y m (sideA flag) Hwe Hin HmoEq);
              rewrite Hmo; rewrite (eqMode_sideB_sideA flag); reflexivity).
        assert (HcB : cov_fun Ea Em (sideB flag) X0 = Y)
          by (rewrite (cov_fun_pair Ea Em X0 Y m (sideB flag) Hwe Hin HmoEq);
              rewrite Hmo; rewrite (eqMode_refl (sideB flag)); reflexivity).
        rewrite HcA, HcB.
        apply sam_fvar; [ exact Hin | exact Hwe ]. }
      { exfalso. exact Hmo. }
    + exfalso. apply Hne. reflexivity.
  - (* sa_top *)
    rewrite amber_cov_top.
    apply sam_top.
    + apply (wf_amber_cov E0 A0 Ea Em (sideA flag) Hwe WFA Hpair).
      apply (wf_fv_bindsub E0 A0 WFA).
    + exact Hwe.
  - (* sa_arrow *)
    rewrite amber_cov_arrow. rewrite amber_cov_arrow.
    simpl in Hmo.
    pose proof (proj1 Hmo) as HmoD.
    pose proof (proj2 Hmo) as HmoC.
    apply sam_arrow.
    + (* domain *)
      pose (Ld := List.map gd_dom L).
      rewrite <- (sideA_negb flag). rewrite <- (sideB_negb flag).
      apply (IH1 Hbs Hwf (negb flag) Ea Em Ld Hwe Hpair).
      * apply modes_ok_sym. exact HmoD.
      * unfold Ld. eapply project_items_dom. exact Hok.
      * unfold Ld. apply items_cover_map_dom. exact Hcover.
      * unfold Ld. apply items_ok_dom_map_dom. exact Hdom.
    + (* cod *)
      pose (Lc := List.map gd_cod L).
      apply (IH2 Hbs Hwf flag Ea Em Lc Hwe Hpair HmoC).
      * unfold Lc. eapply project_items_cod. exact Hok.
      * unfold Lc. apply items_cover_map_cod. exact Hcover.
      * unfold Lc. apply items_ok_dom_map_cod. exact Hdom.
  - (* sa_rec *)
    rewrite amber_cov_mu. rewrite amber_cov_mu.
    simpl in Hmo.
    destruct (typ_eq_dec A1 A2) as [HeqA|HneA].
    + (* equal bodies *)
      subst A2.
      pose proof (sa_rec L0 A1 A1 E0 p1 p2) as Hsub0.
      destruct (typ_eq_dec (amber_cov Ea Em A1 (sideA flag))
                           (amber_cov Ea Em A1 (sideB flag))) as [HcovEq|HcovNe].
      * rewrite HcovEq. apply sam_refl.
        -- exact Hwe.
        -- rewrite <- HcovEq. rewrite <- amber_cov_mu.
           apply (wf_amber_cov E0 (typ_mu A1) Ea Em (sideA flag) Hwe
                    (proj1 (sub_wf E0 (typ_mu A1) (typ_mu A1) Hsub0)) Hpair
                    (wf_fv_bindsub E0 (typ_mu A1)
                       (proj1 (sub_wf E0 (typ_mu A1) (typ_mu A1) Hsub0)))).
      * (* cov images differ *)
        destruct (typ_fvar_witness A1) as [W|] eqn:HW.
        -- (* a free atom W in A1 *)
           assert (HWfv : W \in fv_tt A1) by (apply (typ_fvar_witness_some A1 W); exact HW).
           assert (HWF : WF E0 (typ_mu A1)) by exact (proj1 (sub_wf E0 (typ_mu A1) (typ_mu A1) Hsub0)).
           assert (HWb : binds W bind_sub E0).
           { assert (HWmu : W \in fv_tt (typ_mu A1)) by (simpl; exact HWfv).
             pose proof (wf_fv_bindsub E0 (typ_mu A1) HWF W HWmu) as Hbin.
             exact (proj1 (in_bindsub_atoms E0 W) Hbin). }
           (* set up the witness item at a fresh Z *)
           destruct (Hcover W HWb) as [d [Hin Hw]].
           assert (Hspec : gen_spec E0 (typ_mu A1) (typ_mu A1) d).
           { apply Hok. exact Hin. }
           unfold gen_spec in Hspec.
           destruct Hspec as [Hd2 [Hfwd [Hne' [Hlcs Hlct]]]].
           destruct d as [Wd sd td pard]. simpl in *.
           subst W.
           simpl in Hd2.
           destruct (inv_mu_mu E0 (subst_tt Wd (if pard then td else sd) A1)
                        (subst_tt Wd (if pard then sd else td) A1) Hd2)
             as [Lm [Hd2a Hd2b]].
           destruct (atom_fresh (L0 \u Lm \u fv_tt A1 \u dom E0 \u domA Ea \u {{Wd}}))
             as [Z HZ].
           assert (HZL0 : Z \notin L0) by fsetdec.
           assert (HZLm : Z \notin Lm) by fsetdec.
           assert (HZfv : Z \notin fv_tt A1) by fsetdec.
           assert (HZdomE : Z \notin dom E0) by fsetdec.
           assert (HZW : Z <> Wd) by fsetdec.
           assert (HZW' : Wd <> Z) by (intro Heq; apply HZW; symmetry; exact Heq).
           pose proof (Hd2a Z HZLm) as Hq1.
           pose proof (Hd2b Z HZLm) as Hq2.
           assert (HbsZ : bindsub_only (Z ~ bind_sub ++ E0)).
           { apply bindsub_only_cons. exact Hbs. }
           assert (HwfZ : wf_env (Z ~ bind_sub ++ E0)).
           { apply wf_env_sub; [ exact Hwf | exact HZdomE ]. }
           assert (Hp1Z : sub (Z ~ bind_sub ++ E0) (open_tt A1 (typ_fvar Z))
                                                    (open_tt A1 (typ_fvar Z))).
           { apply (p1 Z HZL0). }
           assert (Hp2Z : sub (Z ~ bind_sub ++ E0)
                             (open_tt A1 (open_tt A1 (typ_fvar Z)))
                             (open_tt A1 (open_tt A1 (typ_fvar Z)))).
           { apply (p2 Z HZL0). }
           assert (HfwdZ : sub (Z ~ bind_sub ++ E0) sd td).
           { apply (sub_mono E0 sd td Hfwd (Z ~ bind_sub ++ E0) HwfZ).
             intros X Hb. unfold binds in *. right. exact Hb. }
           destruct (bvoccT_dec true 0 A1) as [Hbv|Hnb].
           ++ (* own binder odd: four-case exclusion battery *)
              exfalso.
              destruct pard.
              ** simpl in Hq1. simpl in Hq2.
                 unfold open_tt in Hq1.

Require Import TaskBase10.
Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.
Require Import Program.Equality.
Require Import Lia.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Frozen covariance: definitions and a counterexample.               *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* [frozen C] is the second component of [frozen_cov] (the part that   *)
(* matters for covariance): every bad mu subterm body has no occurrence *)
(* of the distinguished binder C's free level 0, at any parity.        *)
Definition frozen (C : typ) : Prop :=
  forall c D,
    C = plug c (typ_mu D) ->
    bvoccT true 0 D ->
    forall q, ~ bvoccT q (S (ctx_depth c)) D.

Lemma frozen_cov_frozen : forall C W, frozen_cov C W -> frozen C.
Proof.
  intros C W H c D HEq Hb q Hq.
  destruct (H c D HEq Hb) as [_ Hno].
  exact (Hno q Hq).
Qed.

(* Positivity of the distinguished binder: no odd occurrence. *)
Definition pos_even (C : typ) : Prop := ~ bvoccT true 0 C.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Counterexample.                                                     *)
(*                                                                     *)
(*   Dbody = (0 -> (1 -> top))                                         *)
(*   Dsub  = mu Dbody                                                  *)
(*   D     = (Dsub -> 1)                                               *)
(*   Cex   = mu D                                                      *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* The nested mu [Dsub] has an odd occurrence of its own binder (0 is  *)
(* in the domain of [Dbody]); the distinguished binder of [Cex] is     *)
(* [1] inside [Dbody], and [Dbody] has no [2], so frozen holds.        *)
(* The root mu body [D] is not bad.                                    *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition cex_body : typ :=
  typ_arrow (typ_bvar 0) (typ_arrow (typ_bvar 1) typ_top).
Definition cex_sub : typ := typ_mu cex_body.
Definition cex_D : typ := typ_arrow cex_sub (typ_bvar 1).
Definition cex_C : typ := typ_mu cex_D.

(* The search finds no bad leaf: the only bad mu is [cex_sub], whose    *)
(* body is W-free and has no occurrence of the distinguished level.     *)
Lemma cex_find_bad : forall W, find_bad cex_C W 0 = None.
Proof. intros W. cbn. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma cex_frozen : frozen cex_C.
Proof.
  apply frozen_cov_frozen with (W := AtomSetImpl.empty_1).
  apply find_bad_frozen_cov. apply cex_find_bad.
Qed.

Lemma cex_pos : pos_even cex_C.
Proof. unfold pos_even. cbn. intros H. exact H. Qed.

Lemma cex_lc : lc_rec 1 cex_C.
Proof. cbn. repeat split; lia. Qed.

(* Opening reductions for the two instantiations [nat] and [top].      *)
Lemma cex_open_nat :
  open_tt cex_C typ_nat = typ_mu (typ_arrow cex_sub typ_nat).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma cex_open_top :
  open_tt cex_C typ_top = typ_mu (typ_arrow cex_sub typ_top).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Definition cex_MY (Y : atom) : typ :=
  typ_mu (typ_arrow (typ_bvar 0) (typ_arrow (typ_fvar Y) typ_top)).
Definition cex_B (V : typ) : typ :=
  typ_arrow (typ_bvar 0) (typ_arrow V typ_top).

Lemma cex_open_arrow_Y : forall (S : typ) (Y : atom),
  open_tt (typ_arrow cex_sub S) (typ_fvar Y) =
  typ_arrow (cex_MY Y) S.
Proof. intros S Y. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma cex_open_arrow_V : forall (S V : typ),
  open_tt (typ_arrow cex_sub S) V =
  typ_arrow (typ_mu (cex_B V)) S.
Proof. intros S V. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma cex_open_B_W : forall (V : typ) (W : atom),
  open_tt (cex_B V) (typ_fvar W) =
  typ_arrow (typ_fvar W) (typ_arrow V typ_top).
Proof. intros V W. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma cex_open_B_open : forall (V U : typ),
  open_tt (cex_B V) U =
  typ_arrow U (typ_arrow V typ_top).
Proof. intros V U. reflexivity. Qed.
EOF

Lemma sub_arrow_inv : forall E A1 A2 B1 B2,
  sub E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2) ->
  sub E B1 A1 /\ sub E A2 B2.
Proof.
  intros E A1 A2 B1 B2 H. inversion H; subst; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma sub_top_nat_absurd : forall E, sub E typ_top typ_nat -> False.
Proof.
  intros E H. pose proof (inv_top_l E typ_nat H). discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma cex_open_B_twice : forall (V : typ) (W : atom),
  lc_tt V ->
  open_tt (cex_B V) (open_tt (cex_B V) (typ_fvar W)) =
  typ_arrow (typ_arrow (typ_fvar W) (typ_arrow V typ_top))
            (typ_arrow V typ_top).
Proof.
  intros V W HV.
  rewrite (cex_open_B_W V W HV).
  rewrite (cex_open_B_open V (typ_arrow (typ_fvar W) (typ_arrow V typ_top)) HV).
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma cex_not_cov :
  ~ sub empty (open_tt cex_C typ_nat) (open_tt cex_C typ_top).
Proof.
  intro H.
  rewrite cex_open_nat, cex_open_top in H.
  destruct (inv_mu_mu empty (typ_arrow cex_sub typ_nat)

  specialize (Hp2 Y HY).

  rewrite (cex_open_arrow_Y typ_nat Y Hlc_nat) in Hp2.

  assert (HVnat : lc_tt (typ_arrow (cex_MY Y) typ_nat))

  rewrite (cex_open_arrow_V typ_nat (typ_arrow (cex_MY Y) typ_nat)
             Hlc_nat HVnat) in Hp2.
  rewrite (cex_open_arrow_V typ_top (typ_arrow (cex_MY Y) typ_top)
             Hlc_top HVtop) in Hp2.
  destruct (sub_arrow_inv _ _ _ _ _ Hp2) as [_ Hdom].
  destruct (inv_mu_mu _ _ _ Hdom) as [L' [Hq1 Hq2]].
  destruct (atom_fresh L') as [W HW].
  specialize (Hq2 W HW).
  rewrite (cex_open_B_twice (typ_arrow (cex_MY Y) typ_top) W HVtop) in Hq2.
  rewrite (cex_open_B_twice (typ_arrow (cex_MY Y) typ_nat) W HVnat) in Hq2.
  destruct (sub_arrow_inv _ _ _ _ _ Hq2) as [Hd2 _].
  destruct (sub_arrow_inv _ _ _ _ _ Hd2) as [_ Hc2].
  destruct (sub_arrow_inv _ _ _ _ _ Hc2) as [Hf1 _].
  destruct (sub_arrow_inv _ _ _ _ _ Hf1) as [_ Hbad].
  exfalso. exact (sub_top_nat_absurd _ Hbad).
Qed.
EOF

Lemma cex_lc : lc_rec 1 cex_C.
Proof. cbn. repeat split; lia. Qed.

(* Opening reductions for the two instantiations [nat] and [top].      *)
Lemma cex_open_nat :
  open_tt cex_C typ_nat = typ_mu (typ_arrow cex_sub typ_nat).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma cex_open_top :
  open_tt cex_C typ_top = typ_mu (typ_arrow cex_sub typ_top).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Definition cex_MY (Y : atom) : typ :=
  typ_mu (typ_arrow (typ_bvar 0) (typ_arrow (typ_fvar Y) typ_top)).
Definition cex_B (V : typ) : typ :=
  typ_arrow (typ_bvar 0) (typ_arrow V typ_top).

Lemma cex_open_arrow_Y : forall (S : typ) (Y : atom),
  lc_tt S ->
  open_tt (typ_arrow cex_sub S) (typ_fvar Y) =
  typ_arrow (cex_MY Y) S.
Proof.
  intros S Y HS. unfold cex_sub, cex_body, cex_MY. cbn.
  rewrite (lc_open_any_id S 0 HS 0 (typ_fvar Y) (Nat.le_0_l 0)).
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma cex_open_arrow_V : forall (S V : typ),
  lc_tt S -> lc_tt V ->
  open_tt (typ_arrow cex_sub S) V =
  typ_arrow (typ_mu (cex_B V)) S.
Proof.
  intros S V HS HV. unfold cex_sub, cex_body, cex_B. cbn.
  rewrite (lc_open_any_id S 0 HS 0 V (Nat.le_0_l 0)).
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma cex_not_cov :
  ~ sub nil (open_tt cex_C typ_nat) (open_tt cex_C typ_top).
Proof.
  intro H.
  rewrite cex_open_nat, cex_open_top in H.
  destruct (inv_mu_mu nil (typ_arrow cex_sub typ_nat)
                 (typ_arrow cex_sub typ_top) H) as [L [Hp1 Hp2]].
  destruct (atom_fresh L) as [Y HY].
  specialize (Hp2 Y HY).
  assert (Hlc_nat : lc_tt typ_nat) by (cbn; auto).
  assert (Hlc_top : lc_tt typ_top) by (cbn; auto).
  rewrite (cex_open_arrow_Y typ_nat Y Hlc_nat) in Hp2.
  rewrite (cex_open_arrow_Y typ_top Y Hlc_top) in Hp2.
  assert (HVnat : lc_tt (typ_arrow (cex_MY Y) typ_nat))
    by (apply cex_V_lc; exact Hlc_nat).
  assert (HVtop : lc_tt (typ_arrow (cex_MY Y) typ_top))
    by (apply cex_V_lc; exact Hlc_top).
  rewrite (cex_open_arrow_V typ_nat (typ_arrow (cex_MY Y) typ_nat)
             Hlc_nat HVnat) in Hp2.
  rewrite (cex_open_arrow_V typ_top (typ_arrow (cex_MY Y) typ_top)
             Hlc_top HVtop) in Hp2.
  destruct (sub_arrow_inv _ _ _ _ _ Hp2) as [Hdom _].
  destruct (inv_mu_mu _ _ _ Hdom) as [L' [Hq1 Hq2]].
  destruct (atom_fresh L') as [W HW].
  specialize (Hq2 W HW).
  rewrite (cex_open_B_twice (typ_arrow (cex_MY Y) typ_top) W HVtop) in Hq2.
  rewrite (cex_open_B_twice (typ_arrow (cex_MY Y) typ_nat) W HVnat) in Hq2.
  destruct (sub_arrow_inv _ _ _ _ _ Hq2) as [Hd2 _].
  destruct (sub_arrow_inv _ _ _ _ _ Hd2) as [_ Hc2].

(* Free-binder occurrence at depth K, at absolute parity q. *)
Fixpoint bvoccT (q : bool) (K : nat) (T : typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => False
  | typ_nat => False
  | typ_bvar J => J = K /\ q = false
  | typ_fvar _ => False
  | typ_arrow A B => bvoccT (negb q) K A \/ bvoccT q K B
  | typ_mu A => bvoccT q (S K) A
  end.

Lemma negb_invol : forall b, negb (negb b) = b.
Proof. destruct b; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma xorb_eq_false : forall p q, xorb p q = false <-> p = q.
Proof. destruct p, q; simpl; split; congruence. Qed.

Lemma xorb_neg_l : forall p q, xorb (negb p) q = xorb p (negb q).
Proof. destruct p, q; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma xorb_neg_neg : forall p q, xorb (negb p) (negb q) = xorb p q.
Proof. destruct p, q; reflexivity. Qed.
Qed.

(* [bad_at W K D] says D is a mu body with the odd own-binder occurrence *)
(* and either W free in D or an occurrence of the outer binder at the   *)
(* depth one below the current absolute depth [K].                      *)
Definition bad_at (W : atom) (K : nat) (D : typ) : Prop :=
  bvoccT true 0 D /\
  (W \in fv_tt D \/ (exists q, bvoccT q (S K) D)).

Lemma bad_at_dec : forall W K D,
  {bad_at W K D} + {~ bad_at W K D}.
Proof.
  intros W K D. unfold bad_at.
  destruct (bvoccT_dec true 0 D) as [Hb|Hb].
  - destruct (fv_dec W D) as [Hf|Hf].
    + left. split; [exact Hb|left; exact Hf].
    + destruct (outer_occ_sumbool (S K) D) as [Ho|Ho].
      * left. split; [exact Hb|right; exact Ho].
      * right. intros [Hb' [Hf'|Ho']].
        -- exact (Hf Hf').
        -- exact (Ho Ho').
  C = plug c (typ_mu D) ->
  bvoccT true 0 D ->
  ~ (W \in fv_tt D \/
     (exists q, bvoccT q (S (K + ctx_depth c)) D)).
Proof.
  intros C W K c D Hnone HEq Hb.
  pose proof (frozen_under_bad_leaf c C W K D
                (find_bad_none_frozen C W K Hnone) HEq) as Hno.
  intro H. apply Hno. unfold bad_at. split; [exact Hb|exact H].
Qed.

(* The frozen condition the covariance worker uses at top level.       *)
Definition frozen_cov (C : typ) (W : atom) : Prop :=
  forall c D,
    C = plug c (typ_mu D) ->
    bvoccT true 0 D ->
    W \notin fv_tt D /\ (forall q, ~ bvoccT q (S (ctx_depth c)) D).

Corollary find_bad_frozen_cov : forall C W,
  find_bad C W 0 = None -> frozen_cov C W.
Proof.
  intros C W Hnone c D HEq Hb.
  pose proof (frozen_under_bad_leaf c C W 0 D
                (find_bad_none_frozen C W 0 Hnone) HEq) as Hno.
  split.
  - intro HW. apply Hno. unfold bad_at. split; [exact Hb|left; exact HW].
  - intros q Hq. apply Hno. unfold bad_at. split; [exact Hb|right].
    exists q. replace (0 + ctx_depth c) with (ctx_depth c) by lia. exact Hq.
Qed.

Lemma binds_cex_head : forall Y E, binds Y bind_sub (Y ~ bind_sub ++ E).
Proof. intros Y E. unfold binds. simpl. auto. Qed.

Lemma binds_cex_cons : forall X Y E,
  binds X bind_sub E -> binds X bind_sub (Y ~ bind_sub ++ E).
Proof. intros X Y E H. unfold binds in *. simpl in *. right. exact H. Qed.

Lemma cex_MY_wf : forall E Y, binds Y bind_sub E -> WF E (cex_MY Y).
Proof.
  intros E Y HY. unfold cex_MY.

      * apply WF_top.

Lemma cex_B_mu_wf : forall E V, WF E V -> WF E (typ_mu (cex_B V)).
Proof.

    + apply WF_arrow.
      * apply (wf_mono E V HV (Z ~ bind_sub ++ E)).

  C = plug c (typ_mu D) -> bvoccT true 0 D -> lc_rec 1 D.
